        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY site_id
            ORDER BY start_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('core_site_period_legacy') }}

),

period_latest AS (

    SELECT
        site_id,
        start_date,
        end_date
    FROM period_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1

),

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- zeus_site_meta: MIN(createdon) per TG legacy site from Zeus ccp_site.
-- ccp_legacysitenumber stores the TG site_id on the Zeus site record.
-- Used as lost_date for no-PCN sites ("manual entry date when the data
-- record starts in Zeus" per client).
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
zeus_site_meta AS (

    SELECT
        TRIM(UPPER(CAST(ccp_legacysitenumber AS VARCHAR(50)))) AS tg_site_id,
        MIN(createdon)                                         AS min_createdon
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }}
    WHERE ccp_legacysitenumber IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TRIM(UPPER(CAST(ccp_legacysitenumber AS VARCHAR(50))))

),

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- zeus_global_meta: Earliest record date in Zeus sites source
-- ("first records min date in the zeus source related to sites").
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
zeus_global_meta AS (

    SELECT
        MIN(createdon) AS global_min_createdon
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }}

),

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- pcn_site_ids: TG site_ids that have at least one PCN issued.
-- In violators, the site column holds the TG site code/id.
-- Sites absent from this CTE have zero PCNs in violators.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
pcn_site_ids AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT
        {{ pcn_key('site') }} AS site_id
    FROM {{ ref('violators') }}
    WHERE site IS NOT NULL

),

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- site_base: one row per site with all resolved dates + attributes.
-- Extended with zeus_min_createdon, zeus_global_min_createdon,
-- and has_pcn flag (1 = has at least one PCN in violators, 0 = none).
-- Sites with no PCNs in TG and not disabled in TG are ignored if
-- they are not found in Zeus (ccp_site.ccp_legacysitenumber).
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
site_base AS (

    SELECT
        s.site_sk,
        CAST(s.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))        AS site_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.disabled_letter,
        s.revenue_share_pct,
        s.free_cancellation_limit,
        s.site_nature,
        s.site_rule_type,
        s.business_category,
        s.disabled                             AS processed_status,
        s.tablet_type,
        s.monthly_free_cancel_budget,
        -- resolved dates (COALESCE already applied in core_site_legacy)
        s.contract_start_date,
        s.golive_date,
        s.lost_date,
        p.start_date                           AS period_start_date,
        p.end_date                             AS period_end_date,
        -- Zeus meta (for no-PCN lost_date fallback)
        CAST(z.min_createdon AS DATE)          AS zeus_min_createdon,
        CAST(zg.global_min_createdon AS DATE)  AS zeus_global_min_createdon,
        CASE WHEN pcn.site_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_pcn
    FROM {{ ref('core_site_legacy') }} AS s
    CROSS JOIN zeus_global_meta AS zg
    LEFT JOIN period_latest AS p
        ON p.site_id = s.site_id
    LEFT JOIN zeus_site_meta AS z
        ON z.tg_site_id = s.site_id
    LEFT JOIN pcn_site_ids AS pcn
        ON pcn.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE NOT (
        -- If site has no PCNs in TG and is not disabled in TG,
        -- ignore it if not found in Zeus (ccp_site.ccp_legacysitenumber)
        CASE WHEN pcn.site_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 0
        AND s.disabled = 0
        AND z.tg_site_id IS NULL
    )

)

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Event 1: 'New' — site acquisition / contract start
-- Always emitted; event_date = contract_start_date -> golive_date fallback.
-- site_lifecycle_id: SHA2-256 hash of site_id|NEW|event_date -- identical
-- pattern to generate_bk usage across this workspace (see macros/generate_bk.sql).
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT
    {{ generate_bk("CONCAT(CAST(s.site_id AS VARCHAR(50)), '|NEW|', CAST(COALESCE(s.contract_start_date, s.golive_date) AS VARCHAR(20)))") }} AS site_lifecycle_id,
    CAST(s.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                         AS site_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))                                               AS site_number,
    CAST(s.customer_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS customer_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS contract_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS contract_type,

    CAST(COALESCE(s.contract_start_date, s.golive_date) AS DATE)           AS event_date,
    CAST('New' AS VARCHAR(150))                                             AS event_type,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS is_blackout_flag,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS blackout_days_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                                      AS blackout_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))                                             AS contract_length_years,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))                                               AS quality_tier_at_event,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS churn_type,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255))                                              AS churn_reason,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS is_regrettable,

    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS spaces,
    CAST(s.period_start_date AS DATE)                                       AS contract_start_date,
    CAST(s.period_end_date AS DATE)                                         AS contract_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                                      AS renewal_date,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS revenue_share_model,
    CAST(s.revenue_share_pct AS DECIMAL(5,2))                               AS revenue_share_pct,
    CAST(s.free_cancellation_limit AS INT)                                  AS free_cancellation_limit,
    CAST(s.site_nature AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS site_nature,
    CAST(s.site_rule_type AS VARCHAR(100))                                  AS site_rule_type,
    CAST(s.business_category AS VARCHAR(100))                               AS business_category,
    CAST(s.processed_status AS VARCHAR(100))                                AS processed_status,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS responsible_team,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS site_technology,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS tariff_technology,
    CAST(s.tablet_type AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS tablet_type,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS tablet_status,
    CAST(s.monthly_free_cancel_budget AS DECIMAL(18,2))                     AS monthly_free_cancel_budget

FROM site_base s

UNION ALL

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Event 2: 'Live' — site go-live (first operational day)
-- Only emitted when golive_date resolves non-NULL.
-- golive_date = COALESCE(live_date, pcn.MIN(issue_date)) [upstream]
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT
    {{ generate_bk("CONCAT(CAST(s.site_id AS VARCHAR(50)), '|LIVE|', CAST(s.golive_date AS VARCHAR(20)))") }} AS site_lifecycle_id,
    CAST(s.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                         AS site_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))                                               AS site_number,
    CAST(s.customer_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS customer_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS contract_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS contract_type,

    CAST(s.golive_date AS DATE)                                             AS event_date,
    CAST('Live' AS VARCHAR(150))                                            AS event_type,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS is_blackout_flag,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS blackout_days_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                                      AS blackout_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))                                             AS contract_length_years,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))                                               AS quality_tier_at_event,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS churn_type,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255))                                              AS churn_reason,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS is_regrettable,

    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS spaces,
    CAST(s.period_start_date AS DATE)                                       AS contract_start_date,
    CAST(s.period_end_date AS DATE)                                         AS contract_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                                      AS renewal_date,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS revenue_share_model,
    CAST(s.revenue_share_pct AS DECIMAL(5,2))                               AS revenue_share_pct,
    CAST(s.free_cancellation_limit AS INT)                                  AS free_cancellation_limit,
    CAST(s.site_nature AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS site_nature,
    CAST(s.site_rule_type AS VARCHAR(100))                                  AS site_rule_type,
    CAST(s.business_category AS VARCHAR(100))                               AS business_category,
    CAST(s.processed_status AS VARCHAR(100))                                AS processed_status,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS responsible_team,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS site_technology,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS tariff_technology,
    CAST(s.tablet_type AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS tablet_type,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS tablet_status,
    CAST(s.monthly_free_cancel_budget AS DECIMAL(18,2))                     AS monthly_free_cancel_budget

FROM site_base s
WHERE s.golive_date IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Event 3: 'Lost' — site churn / deactivation
-- Only emitted when lost_date resolves non-NULL.
-- lost_date = COALESCE(site_disabled_event, pcn.MAX(issue_date)) [upstream]
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT
    {{ generate_bk("CONCAT(CAST(s.site_id AS VARCHAR(50)), '|LOST|', CAST(s.lost_date AS VARCHAR(20)))") }} AS site_lifecycle_id,
    CAST(s.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                         AS site_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))                                               AS site_number,
    CAST(s.customer_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS customer_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS contract_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS contract_type,

    CAST(s.lost_date AS DATE)                                               AS event_date,
    CAST('Lost' AS VARCHAR(150))                                            AS event_type,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS is_blackout_flag,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS blackout_days_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                                      AS blackout_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))                                             AS contract_length_years,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))                                               AS quality_tier_at_event,
    CAST(s.disabled_letter AS VARCHAR(100))                                 AS churn_type,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255))                                              AS churn_reason,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS is_regrettable,

    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS spaces,
    CAST(s.period_start_date AS DATE)                                       AS contract_start_date,
    CAST(s.period_end_date AS DATE)                                         AS contract_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                                      AS renewal_date,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS revenue_share_model,
    CAST(s.revenue_share_pct AS DECIMAL(5,2))                               AS revenue_share_pct,
    CAST(s.free_cancellation_limit AS INT)                                  AS free_cancellation_limit,
    CAST(s.site_nature AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS site_nature,
    CAST(s.site_rule_type AS VARCHAR(100))                                  AS site_rule_type,
    CAST(s.business_category AS VARCHAR(100))                               AS business_category,
    CAST(s.processed_status AS VARCHAR(100))                                AS processed_status,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS responsible_team,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS site_technology,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS tariff_technology,
    CAST(s.tablet_type AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS tablet_type,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS tablet_status,
    CAST(s.monthly_free_cancel_budget AS DECIMAL(18,2))                     AS monthly_free_cancel_budget

FROM site_base s
WHERE s.lost_date IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Event 4 (Synthetic): 'Lost' for non-disabled, zero-PCN TG sites
-- that ARE registered in Zeus (found via ccp_legacysitenumber).
--
-- These sites were operationally set up in Zeus (CRM record created)
-- but never issued a single PCN in TrafficGuard. They are not formally
-- disabled (disabled = 0 in TG) yet have no real activity. Per client
-- guidance: treat them as Lost using the manual entered date when the
-- data record starts in Zeus system (MIN(ccp_site.createdon)), with
-- fallback to the earliest record min date in Zeus sites.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT
    {{ generate_bk("CONCAT(CAST(s.site_id AS VARCHAR(50)), '|LOST|', CAST(COALESCE(s.zeus_min_createdon, s.zeus_global_min_createdon) AS VARCHAR(20)))") }} AS site_lifecycle_id,
    CAST(s.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                         AS site_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))                                               AS site_number,
    CAST(s.customer_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS customer_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS contract_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS contract_type,

    -- Lost date: manual entered date when record starts in Zeus, fallback to earliest zeus min date
    CAST(COALESCE(
        s.zeus_min_createdon,
        s.zeus_global_min_createdon
    ) AS DATE)                                                              AS event_date,
    CAST('Lost' AS VARCHAR(150))                                            AS event_type,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS is_blackout_flag,
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS blackout_days_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                                      AS blackout_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))                                             AS contract_length_years,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))                                               AS quality_tier_at_event,
    CAST(s.disabled_letter AS VARCHAR(100))                                 AS churn_type,
    CAST('No PCN Activity' AS VARCHAR(255))                                 AS churn_reason,
    CAST(0 AS INT)                                                          AS is_regrettable,

    CAST(NULL AS INT)                                                       AS spaces,
    CAST(s.period_start_date AS DATE)                                       AS contract_start_date,
    CAST(s.period_end_date AS DATE)                                         AS contract_end_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                                      AS renewal_date,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS revenue_share_model,
    CAST(s.revenue_share_pct AS DECIMAL(5,2))                               AS revenue_share_pct,
    CAST(s.free_cancellation_limit AS INT)                                  AS free_cancellation_limit,
    CAST(s.site_nature AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS site_nature,
    CAST(s.site_rule_type AS VARCHAR(100))                                  AS site_rule_type,
    CAST(s.business_category AS VARCHAR(100))                               AS business_category,
    CAST(s.processed_status AS VARCHAR(100))                                AS processed_status,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS responsible_team,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS site_technology,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS tariff_technology,
    CAST(s.tablet_type AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS tablet_type,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                              AS tablet_status,
    CAST(s.monthly_free_cancel_budget AS DECIMAL(18,2))                     AS monthly_free_cancel_budget

FROM site_base s
WHERE s.has_pcn = 0                      -- zero PCNs in TG violators
  AND s.processed_status = 0             -- not disabled (disabled = 0 in TG)
  AND s.zeus_min_createdon IS NOT NULL   -- found in Zeus via ccp_legacysitenumber
  AND s.lost_date IS NULL                -- not already emitted by Event 3

model.ccp.core_site_month_legacy.name: core_site_month_legacy
model.ccp.core_site_month_legacy.raw_code:
{{ config(
    alias        = 'core_site_month_legacy',
    tags         = ['core', 'legacy', 'site']
) }}

-- =========================================================================
-- Entity: core_site_month_legacy
-- Grain : 1 row per legacy (TrafficGuard) site_id x calendar month
--
-- is_live is ACTIVITY-BASED, not golive_date/contract-date-based.
--
-- Why: golive_date and firstpcnsentdate are far too sparse in TrafficGuard
-- to be trusted as a live signal (49% and 75% NULL respectively). Tracing
-- the client's OWN "live sites" logic (the livesites /
-- livesitesbypcnsent2 / calendarm_reportbypcnsent2 stored-proc family) led
-- to dbo.Calendarmbypcnsent: a site is live for a month if it generated
-- real PCN activity (numberofviolators > 0) in that month or the one
-- before it (a one-month reporting-lag grace window). Validated within
-- 0.6-0.7% against the client's own Aug-2023 (1,708) and Sep-2023 (1,744)
-- figures -- by far the closest of everything tried.
--
-- SUPERSEDES the previous siteissues reason-code approach (git history),
-- which reached only ~1.2-2.7% on those same two months. That approach was
-- briefly preferred because the COMBINED Fabric total looked closer with
-- it -- but that comparison was invalid: the Legacy count was being added
-- ON TOP of Zeus's retroactive count for the same physical sites, double
-- counting them. With correct system-ownership precedence in
-- fact_site_month (TG owns months before a site's Zeus record existed,
-- Zeus owns after), the activity-based measure is clearly better --
-- mean absolute error across 2023-05..2024-12 drops from ~33 to ~14.
--
-- Do NOT union this with contract-date-based coverage -- tested, and it
-- overshoots by 500+ sites.
--
-- lost_this_month is sourced separately, from the lifecycle event stream
-- (site_lost_months below) rather than from activity, so month-level churn
-- attribution matches the CCP reported figure and the live model's
-- identical flag.
-- Full walkthrough: context/queries/site_live_and_qr_audit_check_TRAFFICGUARD.sql
-- =========================================================================

WITH
-- Mirrors dim_site.sql / fact_site_lifecycle.sql: exclude TG sites that
-- migrated to Zeus. Without this, a migrated site is counted once under
-- Legacy and again under Live in fact_site_month, and can be "lost" twice
-- in two different months.
-- Queries raw ccp_site, not core_site: core_site filters out rows where
-- ccp_businesscategorylookup IS NULL, whose TG counterparts would then slip
-- through the NOT EXISTS as if they were TG-only.
live_site_legacy_numbers AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT
        TRIM(UPPER(CAST(ccp_legacysitenumber AS VARCHAR(50)))) AS legacy_site_number
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }}
    WHERE ccp_legacysitenumber IS NOT NULL

),

lifecycle_pivoted AS (

    -- Informational attributes only (contract dates, site_nature, spaces).
    -- No longer used to gate is_live or to generate month_spine.
    SELECT
        site_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'Live' THEN event_date END)  AS go_live_date,
        MAX(contract_start_date)                                 AS contract_start_date,
        MAX(contract_end_date)                                   AS contract_end_date,
        MAX(CAST(spaces AS INT))                                 AS spaces,
        MAX(site_nature)                                         AS site_nature,
        -- Retained ONLY to cap the month spine and to drive the cumulative
        -- is_live / live_days guards. Month-level churn attribution now comes
        -- from site_lost_months below, which keeps every lost event rather
        -- than collapsing to one date per site.
        -- Widened from event_type = 'Lost' to the full CCP churn vocabulary.
        MAX(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('Lost','Uninstalled','Uninstall')
                 THEN event_date END)                            AS last_lost_event_date
    FROM {{ ref('core_site_lifecycle_legacy') }} csl
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM live_site_legacy_numbers ln
        WHERE ln.legacy_site_number = TRIM(UPPER(CAST(csl.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))))
    )
    GROUP BY site_id

),

-- Lost events from the lifecycle stream -- the agreed CCP definition
-- (event_type IN ('Lost','Uninstalled','Uninstall')), identical to the
-- live model's own site_lost_months CTE.
--
-- Grain: 1 row per site per month in which a lost event occurred.
-- GROUP BY collapses same-month duplicates (matching the CCP query's
-- COUNT(DISTINCT site_id)) while preserving a site lost in two different
-- months as two rows -- which the previous MAX() collapsed into one.
--
-- core_site_lifecycle_legacy emits 'Lost' only (Events 3 and 4), but the
-- full IN-list is used so both sides stay identical if that model later
-- emits 'Uninstalled'.
site_lost_months AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(csl.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))                              AS site_id,
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(csl.event_date), MONTH(csl.event_date), 1)  AS lost_month
    FROM {{ ref('core_site_lifecycle_legacy') }} csl
    WHERE csl.event_type IN ('Lost', 'Uninstalled', 'Uninstall')
      AND csl.event_date IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM live_site_legacy_numbers ln
          WHERE ln.legacy_site_number = TRIM(UPPER(CAST(csl.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))))
      )
    GROUP BY
        CAST(csl.site_id AS VARCHAR(100)),
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(csl.event_date), MONTH(csl.event_date), 1)

),

activity_months AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT
        {{ pcn_key('site') }} AS site_id,
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(calendar_date), MONTH(calendar_date), 1) AS activity_month
    FROM {{ ref('calendarmbypcnsent') }}
    WHERE numberofviolators > 0

),

-- month_spine covers two kinds of month:
--   is_activity_month = 1 -- the site had PCN activity that month or the
--                           one before (the reporting-lag grace window).
--                           These are the LIVE months.
--   is_activity_month = 0 -- a month carrying only a lifecycle churn event.
--
-- The second kind matters: a site stops issuing PCNs when it dies but is
-- only formally marked Lost later, so the loss month usually has no
-- activity. Without these rows the event has nothing to attach to --
-- confirmed live: 242 of 352 Legacy lost events (69%) were being dropped.
-- They are spine rows only; is_live / is_live_eom / is_live_active and
-- live_days stay 0 for them, so liveness is unchanged.
spine_union AS (

    SELECT site_id, activity_month                     AS month_roll, 1 AS is_activity_month
    FROM activity_months

    UNION ALL

    SELECT site_id, DATEADD(month, 1, activity_month)  AS month_roll, 1 AS is_activity_month
    FROM activity_months

    UNION ALL

    SELECT site_id, lost_month                         AS month_roll, 0 AS is_activity_month
    FROM site_lost_months

),

month_spine AS (

    SELECT
        site_id,
        month_roll,
        MAX(is_activity_month) AS is_activity_month
    FROM spine_union
    GROUP BY site_id, month_roll

)

SELECT
    CAST(ms.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))        AS site_id,
    CAST(ms.month_roll AS DATE)             AS month_roll,

    CAST(ms.is_activity_month AS INT)       AS is_live,

    -- The activity signal is monthly, not day-granular, so there is no
    -- intra-month loss date to distinguish on -- is_live_eom matches
    -- is_live here. (On the Zeus side these differ, because there a site
    -- lost mid-month still counts as live for that month.)
    CAST(ms.is_activity_month AS INT)       AS is_live_eom,

    -- is_live_active: on the Zeus side this strips long-dormant sites. Here
    -- it matches is_live -- a TG site-month counts as live only when it had
    -- real PCN activity that month or the one before, so it can never be
    -- dormant.
    CAST(ms.is_activity_month AS INT)       AS is_live_active,

    -- NEW: lost_this_month -- 1 if a lifecycle churn event falls in this
    -- month_roll. Sourced from the event stream, not a resolved date, so it
    -- matches the CCP reported figure and the live model's identical flag.
    CAST(CASE WHEN slm.site_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS lost_this_month,

    -- Typed NULL: new_this_month on the live side keys off
    -- ccp_firstpcnprinteddate gated to >= 2024-06 (post-migration), a window
    -- TrafficGuard does not overlap. Present only so both sides of the
    -- fact_site_month UNION carry the same column list.
    CAST(NULL AS INT)                       AS new_this_month,

    -- live_days / uptime_days: a live month counts as fully live; a
    -- lost-event-only month contributes none (no camera data in legacy
    -- either way).
    CAST(CASE WHEN ms.is_activity_month = 1
              THEN DATEDIFF(day, ms.month_roll, EOMONTH(ms.month_roll)) + 1
              ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS live_days,
    CAST(CASE WHEN ms.is_activity_month = 1
              THEN DATEDIFF(day, ms.month_roll, EOMONTH(ms.month_roll)) + 1
              ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS uptime_days,

    CAST(NULL AS INT)                       AS spaces,            -- not in TrafficGuard

    -- Remaining Contract Tenure in Years (0.00 if expired or sentinel date)
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN lp.contract_end_date IS NOT NULL
             AND lp.contract_end_date > ms.month_roll
             AND YEAR(lp.contract_end_date) < 9000
            THEN DATEDIFF(day, ms.month_roll, lp.contract_end_date) / 365.25
            ELSE 0.00
        END
    AS DECIMAL(10,2))                       AS contract_years_remaining,

    CAST(lp.site_nature AS VARCHAR(50))                             AS quality_tier,

    CAST(
        CASE lp.site_nature
            WHEN 'Bronze'        THEN 1
            WHEN 'Low Performer' THEN 0
            WHEN 'Silver'        THEN 2
            WHEN 'Gold'          THEN 3
            WHEN 'Platinum'      THEN 4
            ELSE NULL
        END
    AS INT)                                                         AS quality_tier_rank,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN lp.contract_end_date IS NOT NULL
             AND ms.month_roll BETWEEN DATEADD(month,-1,lp.contract_end_date) AND lp.contract_end_date
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
    AS INT)                                 AS is_renewal_due,

    CAST(NULL AS INT)                       AS is_renewed,        -- no renewal data in legacy

    CAST(COALESCE(lp.go_live_date, cs.golive_date, lp.contract_start_date) AS DATE) AS go_live_date,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(lp.go_live_date, cs.golive_date, lp.contract_start_date) IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE
                CASE
                    WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, COALESCE(lp.go_live_date, cs.golive_date, lp.contract_start_date), ms.month_roll)
                         - CASE WHEN DAY(ms.month_roll) < DAY(COALESCE(lp.go_live_date, cs.golive_date, lp.contract_start_date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END < 0
                    THEN 0
                    ELSE DATEDIFF(MONTH, COALESCE(lp.go_live_date, cs.golive_date, lp.contract_start_date), ms.month_roll)
                         - CASE WHEN DAY(ms.month_roll) < DAY(COALESCE(lp.go_live_date, cs.golive_date, lp.contract_start_date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                END
        END
    AS INT)                                 AS months_since_go_live

FROM month_spine ms
LEFT JOIN lifecycle_pivoted lp
    ON lp.site_id = ms.site_id
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('core_site_legacy') }} cs
    ON cs.site_id = ms.site_id

LEFT JOIN site_lost_months slm
    ON ms.site_id    = slm.site_id
   AND ms.month_roll = slm.lost_month

   AND ms.month_roll = slm.lost_month

model.ccp.core_site_period_legacy.name: core_site_period_legacy
model.ccp.core_site_period_legacy.raw_code:
-- Core site period entity (Built from Traffic Guard siteterms ALONE -- the
-- only genuine period-grained site history available). Grain = 1 per status
-- period per site. Per context.md §6.1 core__site_period.
--
-- Naming: TrafficGuard/NewLogic (legacy-system) core entity -- see the naming
-- note in core_claim_legacy.sql.
--
-- Null end_date means still open (81.4% of sites have terms; context.md §9
-- rule 4) -- not missing data, do not fill it. Keep separate from
-- core_site_legacy (a current-state snapshot) -- this is what gives
-- fact_site_lifecycle a real period grain.

{{ config(
    alias = 'core_site_period_legacy',
    tags = ['core', 'site']
) }}

SELECT
    id                          AS site_period_id,
    {{ pcn_key('site_code') }}  AS site_id,
    start_date,
    end_date
FROM {{ ref('site_terms') }}
WHERE site_code IS NOT NULL
  AND site_code <> ''

model.ccp.core_site_status_legacy.name: core_site_status_legacy
model.ccp.core_site_status_legacy.raw_code:
{{ config(
    alias = 'core_site_status_legacy',
    tags = ['core', 'legacy', 'site_status']
) }}

WITH period_ranked AS (

    SELECT
        site_id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY site_id
            ORDER BY start_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('core_site_period_legacy') }}

),

period_latest AS (

    SELECT
        site_id,
        start_date,
        end_date
    FROM period_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1

)

SELECT
    CAST(s.site_sk AS VARCHAR(100)) AS site_status_id,
    s.site_id,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    CAST(s.disabled AS VARCHAR(50)) AS status,
    s.disabled_letter AS status_reason,
    s.status_sub_reason
FROM {{ ref('core_site_legacy') }} s
LEFT JOIN period_latest p
    ON p.site_id = s.site_id

model.ccp.core_stream_legacy.name: core_stream_legacy
model.ccp.core_stream_legacy.raw_code:
-- Core stream entity (Built from NewLogic plate_images, year-sharded 
-- 2018-2025, UNIONed directly here). 
-- Grain = 1 per camera read. 
-- 
-- This model is fact-ready: 
--   - stream-to-pair resolution completed here (stream_pair_lookup) 
--   - pair match attributes joined here (match_method, anpr_confidence_tier) 
--   - ai_corrected_flag is NOT derived here any more -- its only source is a 
--     163-row one-time batch from Aug-Nov 2018. See the note on the column. 
-- The downstream fact only conforms datatypes and UNIONs with the live core. 
-- 
-- (record_type / permit / process_name notes retained from prior header.) 
 
{{ config( 
    materialized = 'table', 
    alias = 'core_stream_legacy', 
    tags = ['core', 'legacy', 'stream'] 
) }} 
 
WITH unioned AS ( 
 
    -- Restricted to 2023-2025 (2026-09-02, confirmed decision): fact_stream/ 
    -- fact_pv only need April-2023 onward (see rpt_fact_stream/rpt_fact_pv's 
    -- date filters), and the full 2018-2025 UNION was taking 60+ minutes to 
    -- build. fact_stream_legacy/fact_pv_legacy (context.md 7.5/7.6, full 
    -- history by design) lose 2018-2022 coverage as an accepted trade-off of 
    -- this change -- confirmed, not an oversight. 
    SELECT id, pi_site, pi_camera_name, pi_plate, pi_date, pi_date_inserted, record_type, step, permit_id, permit_accuracy, permit_plate, permit, process_name, time_created, time_updated, 2023 AS source_year FROM {{ ref('plate_images_2023') }} 
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT id, pi_site, pi_camera_name, pi_plate, pi_date, pi_date_inserted, record_type, step, permit_id, permit_accuracy, permit_plate, permit, process_name, time_created, time_updated, 2024 AS source_year FROM {{ ref('plate_images_2024') }} 
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT id, pi_site, pi_camera_name, pi_plate, pi_date, pi_date_inserted, record_type, step, permit_id, permit_accuracy, permit_plate, permit, process_name, time_created, time_updated, 2025 AS source_year FROM {{ ref('plate_images_2025') }} 
 
), 

-- ========================================================================
-- 1. VIOLATOR FREQUENCY AGGREGATION
-- ========================================================================
-- Groups the violators table by Registration to determine if a vehicle 
-- is a 'Multiple' (>= 4 violations) or 'Single' offender.
violator_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        UPPER(TRIM(registration)) AS registration_cleaned,
        COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(pcn))) AS violation_count
    FROM {{ ref('violators') }}
    WHERE registration IS NOT NULL 
      AND registration <> ''
      AND pcn IS NOT NULL
      AND pcn <> ''
    GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(registration))
),
 
-- 2. Stream-to-pair resolution: a stream can be the entry OR exit half of a 
--    pair, so both sides are UNIONed into a single lookup, then deduped to one 
--    pair per stream. Pair attributes (match_method, confidence) are attached. 
stream_pair_lookup AS ( 
 
    SELECT 
        stream1_id AS stream_id, 
        pair_id, 
        match_method, 
        fuzzy_ready_flag 
    FROM {{ ref('core_stream_pair_legacy') }} 
    WHERE stream1_id IS NOT NULL 
 
    UNION ALL 
 
    SELECT 
        stream2_id AS stream_id, 
        pair_id, 
        match_method, 
        fuzzy_ready_flag 
    FROM {{ ref('core_stream_pair_legacy') }} 
    WHERE stream2_id IS NOT NULL 
 
), 
 
stream_pair_ranked AS ( 
 
    SELECT 
        stream_id, 
        pair_id, 
        match_method, 
        fuzzy_ready_flag, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( 
            PARTITION BY stream_id 
            ORDER BY pair_id DESC 
        ) AS row_num 
    FROM stream_pair_lookup 
 
), 
 
stream_pair_latest AS ( 
 
    SELECT 
        stream_id, 
        pair_id, 
        match_method, 
        fuzzy_ready_flag 
    FROM stream_pair_ranked 
    WHERE row_num = 1 
 
), 
 
base_stream AS ( 
 
    SELECT 
        id                                                  AS stream_id, 
        {{ pcn_key('pi_site') }}                            AS site_id, 
        pi_camera_name                                      AS camera_id, 
        pi_plate                                            AS anpr_plate_raw, 
        pi_date                                             AS capture_date, 
        pi_date_inserted                                    AS date_inserted, 
        record_type, 
        CAST(CASE WHEN record_type = 'DUPLICATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS duplicate_flag, 
        CAST(CASE WHEN record_type = 'SINGLE'    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS anpr_single_flag, 
        CAST(CASE WHEN record_type IN ('FUZZY','FUZZYNOPARK') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS fuzzy_match_applied_flag, 
        CAST(NULL AS BIT)                                   AS numeric_flag, 
        record_type                                         AS match_type, 
        process_name                                        AS processed_status, 
        step, 
        NULLIF(TRIM(permit), '')                                              AS permit_raw, 
        CAST(CASE WHEN TRIM(permit) IN ('PERMIT','PERMITC')       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS permit_flag, 
        CASE WHEN TRIM(permit) IN ('PERMIT','PERMITC')       THEN TRIM(permit) END          AS permit_type, 
        CAST(CASE WHEN TRIM(permit) IN ('EXEMPTION','EXEMPTIOND') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS exempt_flag, 
        CASE WHEN TRIM(permit) IN ('EXEMPTION','EXEMPTIOND') THEN TRIM(permit) END          AS exemption_category, 
        CAST(CASE WHEN TRIM(permit) = 'BLACKOUT'                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS blackout_flag, 
        CAST(CASE WHEN permit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)        AS permit_id_present_flag, 
        permit_accuracy, 
        permit_plate, 
        time_created                                        AS processed_date, 
        time_updated, 
        source_year 
    FROM unioned 
 
),

final_stream AS (

    SELECT 
        bs.stream_id, 
        bs.site_id, 
        bs.camera_id, 
        bs.anpr_plate_raw, 
        bs.capture_date, 
        bs.date_inserted, 
        bs.record_type, 
        bs.duplicate_flag, 
        bs.numeric_flag, 
        bs.match_type, 
        bs.processed_status, 
        bs.processed_date, 
        bs.step, 
        bs.time_updated, 
        bs.permit_flag, 
        bs.permit_type, 
        bs.exempt_flag, 
        bs.exemption_category, 
        bs.blackout_flag, 
        bs.permit_id_present_flag, 
        bs.permit_raw, 
        bs.permit_accuracy, 
        bs.permit_plate, 
        bs.anpr_single_flag, 
        bs.fuzzy_match_applied_flag, 
        spl.pair_id, 
        spl.match_method, 
        spl.fuzzy_ready_flag, 
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20))                  AS anpr_confidence_tier, 
        CAST(NULL AS BIT)                          AS ai_corrected_flag, 
        bs.source_year 
    FROM base_stream bs 
    LEFT JOIN stream_pair_latest spl 
        ON spl.stream_id = bs.stream_id 
        
),

ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pair_id
            ORDER BY
                time_updated DESC,
                date_inserted DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM final_stream
)

SELECT 
    -- ====================================================
    -- FACT CONFORMED COLUMNS & CASTS
    -- ====================================================
    CAST(r.stream_id AS VARCHAR(100))           AS stream_id, 
    CAST(r.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))             AS site_id, 
    CAST(r.camera_id AS VARCHAR(100))           AS camera_id, 
    CAST(r.pair_id AS VARCHAR(100))             AS pair_id, 
    
    CAST(r.date_inserted AS DATETIME2(6))       AS stream_datetime, 
    CAST(r.capture_date AS DATE)                AS stream_date, 
    
    CAST(r.duplicate_flag AS BIT)               AS duplicate_flag, 
    CAST(r.numeric_flag AS BIT)                 AS numeric_flag, 
    CAST(r.match_type AS VARCHAR(100))          AS match_type, 
    CAST(r.processed_status AS VARCHAR(100))    AS processed_status, 
    CAST(r.processed_date AS DATETIME2(6))      AS processed_date, 
    
    CAST(r.permit_flag AS BIT)                  AS permit_flag, 
    CAST(r.permit_type AS VARCHAR(100))         AS permit_type, 
    CAST(r.blackout_flag AS BIT)                AS blackout_flag, 
    CAST(r.permit_accuracy AS VARCHAR(100))     AS permit_type_accuracy, 
    CAST(r.permit_plate AS VARCHAR(100))        AS permit_type_plate, 
    
    CAST(r.match_method AS VARCHAR(100))        AS match_method, 
    CAST(r.anpr_confidence_tier AS VARCHAR(20)) AS anpr_confidence_tier, 
    CAST(r.fuzzy_ready_flag AS VARCHAR(10))     AS fuzzy_ready_flag, 
    
    CAST(r.exempt_flag AS BIT)                  AS exempt_flag, 
    CAST(r.exemption_category AS VARCHAR(100))  AS exemption_category, 
    
    CAST(r.ai_corrected_flag AS BIT)            AS ai_corrected_flag, 
    CAST(r.anpr_single_flag AS BIT)             AS anpr_single_flag, 
    CAST(r.fuzzy_match_applied_flag AS BIT)     AS fuzzy_match_applied_flag, 
    CAST(NULL AS BIT)                           AS polus_single_flag, 
    
    CAST(r.anpr_plate_raw AS VARCHAR(100))      AS anpr_plate, 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20))                   AS polus_plate, 
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                  AS atlas_plate, 
    CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))                  AS atlas_processed_date,
    
    'Legacy'                                    AS source_system,

    -- ====================================================
    -- MULTIPLE VIOLATOR FLAG / STATUS & KEY
    -- ====================================================
    CAST(CASE WHEN vc.violation_count >= 4 THEN 'MV' ELSE 'SV' END AS VARCHAR(10)) AS violator_type,

    CONVERT(
        VARCHAR(32),
        HASHBYTES(
            'MD5',
            CONCAT(
                CASE WHEN vc.violation_count >= 4 THEN 'MV' ELSE 'SV' END,
                '|',
                UPPER(TRIM(r.match_type))
            )
        ),
        2
    ) AS violation_type_key,

    -- ====================================================
    -- EXISTING LEGACY-SPECIFIC COLUMNS
    -- ====================================================
    r.capture_date,
    r.date_inserted,
    r.record_type,
    r.step,
    r.time_updated,
    r.permit_id_present_flag,
    r.permit_raw,
    r.permit_accuracy,
    r.permit_plate,
    r.anpr_plate_raw,
    r.source_year

FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN violator_counts vc
    ON UPPER(TRIM(r.anpr_plate_raw)) = vc.registration_cleaned
WHERE r.rn = 1

model.ccp.core_stream_pair_legacy.name: core_stream_pair_legacy
model.ccp.core_stream_pair_legacy.raw_code:
-- Core stream pair entity (Built from NewLogic checked_plates, enriched with
-- approved_plates -> stage2_plates/stage3_plates, all year-sharded 2018-2025).
-- Grain = 1 per paired visit (26.3M for 2023 per context.md §7.6/§7.7).
-- Per context.md §6.2 core__stream_pair.
--
-- [ ... existing documentation retained ... ]

{{ config(
    alias = 'core_stream_pair_legacy',
    tags = ['core', 'stream']
) }}

WITH

-- ========================================================================
-- 1. VIOLATOR FREQUENCY AGGREGATION
-- ========================================================================
-- Groups the violators table by Registration to determine if a vehicle 
-- is a 'Multiple' (>= 4 violations) or 'Single' offender.
violator_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        UPPER(TRIM(registration)) AS registration_cleaned,
        COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(pcn))) AS violation_count
    FROM {{ ref('violators') }}
    WHERE registration IS NOT NULL 
      AND registration <> ''
      AND pcn IS NOT NULL
      AND pcn <> ''
    GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(registration))
),

-- ========================================================================
-- 2. YEAR-SHARDED STREAM PAIR PROCESSING
-- ========================================================================
{% set years = var('newlogic_years') %}
{% for y in years %}
year_{{ y }} AS (
    SELECT
        cp.id                                                  AS pair_id,
        cp.plate_images_id_1                                   AS stream1_id,
        cp.plate_images_id_2                                   AS stream2_id,
        {{ pcn_key('cp.site') }}                               AS site_id,
        cp.datetime_1                                          AS entry_at,
        cp.datetime_2                                          AS exit_at,
        DATEDIFF(minute, cp.datetime_1, cp.datetime_2)         AS duration_of_stay_mins,
        cp.plate_1,
        cp.plate_2,
        
        CAST(CASE WHEN cp.plate_1 = cp.plate_2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS plate_match_flag,
        
        cp.final_approval                                      AS inhouse_review_outcome,
        cp.fuzzy_ready                                         AS fuzzy_ready_flag,
        cp.time_updated,
        
        -- clean_pair_flag: reproduces the client's stored-procedure predicate
        CAST(
            CASE 
                WHEN cp.final_approval IS NULL
                 AND cp.fuzzy_ready   = 'Y'
                 AND cp.reserved_by   = 0
                 AND cp.acceptance_1  = 'AUTOBATCH'
                 AND cp.acceptance_2  = 'AUTOBATCH'
                THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END AS BIT
        ) AS clean_pair_flag,
        
        cp.violation_type                                      AS match_type,
        ap.violation_type                                      AS approved_violation_type,
        ap.status                                              AS approved_status,
        s2.status                                              AS inhouse_review_status,
        s2.time_created                                        AS review_date,
        
        CAST(CASE WHEN s2.status = 'stage3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS promoted_to_stage3_flag,
        CAST(CASE WHEN s2.permit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS permit_flag_review_stage,
        
        s2.permit_accuracy,
        s2.permit_plate                                        AS permit_matched_plate,
        CAST(CASE WHEN s2.permit_accuracy < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS fuzzy_permit_flag,
        
        {% if y >= 2022 %}s2.logic_type{% else %}CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)){% endif %} AS match_method,
        
        s3.status                                              AS pre_dvla_rule_check_status,
        s3.time_created                                        AS pre_dvla_rule_check_date,
        {{ y }}                                                AS source_year

    FROM {{ ref('checked_plates_' ~ y) }} cp
    
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('approved_plates_' ~ y) }} ap
        ON ap.checked_plates_id = cp.id
        
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            approved_plates_id, status, permit_id, permit_accuracy, permit_plate, time_created{% if y >= 2022 %}, logic_type{% endif %},
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY approved_plates_id ORDER BY time_created DESC) AS rn
        FROM {{ ref('stage2_plates_' ~ y) }}
    ) s2 ON s2.approved_plates_id = ap.id AND s2.rn = 1
    
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            approved_plates_id, status, time_created,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY approved_plates_id ORDER BY time_created DESC) AS rn
        FROM {{ ref('stage3_plates_' ~ y) }}
    ) s3 ON s3.approved_plates_id = ap.id AND s3.rn = 1
){% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}
{% endfor %}

, combined_years AS (
    {% for y in years %}
    SELECT * FROM year_{{ y }}
    {% if not loop.last %}UNION ALL{% endif %}
    {% endfor %}
),

-- ========================================================================
-- 3. DEDUPLICATION
-- ========================================================================
deduped_pairs AS (
    SELECT TOP 1 WITH TIES *
    FROM combined_years
    ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY pair_id
        ORDER BY 
            time_updated DESC,
            review_date DESC
    )
)

-- ========================================================================
-- 4. FINAL INTEGRATION
-- ========================================================================
SELECT 
    dp.*,
    
    -- Multiple Violator categorization (Threshold: >= 4)
    CAST(
        CASE 
            WHEN vc.violation_count >= 4 THEN 'MV' 
            ELSE 'SV'
        END AS VARCHAR(10)
    ) AS violator_type,

    -- Violation Type Key (MD5 hash of violator_type | match_type)
    CONVERT(
        VARCHAR(32),
        HASHBYTES(
            'MD5',
            CONCAT(
                CASE WHEN vc.violation_count >= 4 THEN 'MV' ELSE 'SV' END,
                '|',
                UPPER(TRIM(dp.match_type))
            )
        ),
        2
    ) AS violation_type_key

FROM deduped_pairs dp
LEFT JOIN violator_counts vc
    ON UPPER(TRIM(dp.plate_1)) = vc.registration_cleaned

model.ccp.core_tracing_legacy.name: core_tracing_legacy
model.ccp.core_tracing_legacy.raw_code:
-- Core tracing entity (Built from Traffic Guard goneaways, enriched with
-- keeperliability + addresschanges). Grain = 1 per tracing attempt
-- (goneaways.id anchor). Per context.md §6.3 core__tracing.
--
-- Naming: TrafficGuard/NewLogic (legacy-system) core entity -- see the naming
-- note in core_claim_legacy.sql.
--
-- goneaways -> keeperliability is modelled as an ORDERED PROGRESSION
-- (tracing_status), per context.md's explicit instruction, so §11 #4
-- ("is 'reached keeper-liability stage' enough, or should these be two
-- distinct values?") is a labelling change here, not a re-model. Only 18.8%
-- of goneaways progress to keeperliability -- existence only, no outcome
-- detail on that table itself.
--
-- addresschanges is keyed by violatorid (int FK to violators.ID, 100% match
-- per context.md §4.1), NOT pcn text -- resolved via violators below.
--
-- Per context.md §9 rule 1, every pcn-shaped join key is TRIM/UPPER-normalised.

{{ config(
    alias = 'core_tracing_legacy',
    tags = ['core', 'tracing']
) }}

WITH

base AS (
    SELECT
        id                      AS tracing_id,
        {{ pcn_key('pcn') }}    AS pcn_id,
        date_added              AS tracing_sent_date
    FROM {{ ref('gone_aways') }}
    WHERE pcn IS NOT NULL
      AND pcn <> ''
),

keeper_liability_flag AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT {{ pcn_key('pcn') }} AS pcn_id
    FROM {{ ref('keeper_liability') }}
    WHERE pcn IS NOT NULL AND pcn <> ''
),

violator_lookup AS (
    SELECT
        id                          AS violator_id,
        {{ pcn_key('full_pcn') }}   AS pcn_id
    FROM {{ ref('violators') }}
),

address_changes_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        vl.pcn_id,
        ac.address_1,
        ac.address_2,
        ac.address_3,
        ac.postcode,
        ac.date_changed,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY vl.pcn_id
            ORDER BY ac.date_changed DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('address_changes') }} ac
    JOIN violator_lookup vl ON vl.violator_id = ac.violator_id
),

address_changes_latest AS (
    SELECT pcn_id, address_1, address_2, address_3, postcode, date_changed
    FROM address_changes_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT
    b.tracing_id,
    b.pcn_id,
    b.tracing_sent_date,
    CASE WHEN kl.pcn_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'KEEPER_LIABILITY' ELSE 'GONEAWAY' END AS tracing_status,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', ac.address_1, ac.address_2, ac.address_3, ac.postcode)     AS tracing_outcome,
    ac.date_changed                                                            AS tracing_outcome_date

FROM base b
LEFT JOIN keeper_liability_flag kl  ON kl.pcn_id = b.pcn_id
LEFT JOIN address_changes_latest ac ON ac.pcn_id = b.pcn_id

model.ccp.core_vehicle_legacy.name: core_vehicle_legacy
model.ccp.core_vehicle_legacy.raw_code:
-- Core vehicle entity (Built from Traffic Guard violators + dvla +
-- anprceomonitor_carweb). Grain = 1 per registration. Per the dbt build
-- guide for the 10 TrafficGuard/NewLogic dimension tables (2026-08-28).
--
-- Naming: TrafficGuard/NewLogic (legacy-system) core entity -- see the
-- naming note in core_claim_legacy.sql.
--
-- Registration universe is the union of violators.registration and
-- dvla.reg -- either source can carry a plate the other lacks. Attribute
-- preference is dvla over violators -- violators.make/model/color are
-- 95.1% null (context.md), dvla is the fuller source.
--
-- Tie-break on multiple rows per registration: violators has no confirmed
-- "date added" column to order by, so `id DESC` is used instead (a clean
-- int surrogate, same tie-break pattern already used elsewhere in this
-- estate for tables without a reliable date column -- see
-- core_claim_legacy.sql's judgement_notice_ranked/court_hearing_ranked).
--
-- fuel_type and vehicle_category have no source anywhere in TrafficGuard --
-- typed NULL, not guessed.

{{ config(
    alias = 'core_vehicle_legacy',
    tags = ['core', 'vehicle']
) }}

WITH

registrations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT {{ pcn_key('registration') }} AS vehicle_registration
    FROM {{ ref('violators') }}
    WHERE registration IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(registration) <> ''

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT {{ pcn_key('reg') }} AS vehicle_registration
    FROM {{ ref('dvla') }}
    WHERE reg IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(reg) <> ''
),

-- a registration can carry multiple dvla enquiry rows (re-checks,
-- reissues) -- take the latest so this stays one row per plate
dvla_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        {{ pcn_key('reg') }}    AS vehicle_registration,
        make, model, colour,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY {{ pcn_key('reg') }}
            ORDER BY date_received DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('dvla') }}
    WHERE reg IS NOT NULL
),

dvla_latest AS (
    SELECT vehicle_registration, make, model, colour
    FROM dvla_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),

-- fallback only -- never overrides a dvla-side value
violator_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        {{ pcn_key('registration') }}    AS vehicle_registration,
        make, model, color,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY {{ pcn_key('registration') }}
            ORDER BY id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('violators') }}
    WHERE registration IS NOT NULL
),

violator_latest AS (
    SELECT vehicle_registration, make, model, color
    FROM violator_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),

-- year_of_manufacture candidate -- 8.0% match, expect mostly NULL, not a defect
carweb_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        {{ pcn_key('plate') }}    AS vehicle_registration,
        date_first_registered,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY {{ pcn_key('plate') }}
            ORDER BY carweb_request_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('anprceomonitor_carweb') }}
    WHERE plate IS NOT NULL
),

carweb_latest AS (
    SELECT vehicle_registration, date_first_registered
    FROM carweb_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT
    r.vehicle_registration                          AS vehicle_id,
    r.vehicle_registration                          AS vehicle_registration,
    COALESCE(d.make, v.make)                        AS vehicle_make,
    COALESCE(d.model, v.model)                      AS vehicle_model,
    COALESCE(d.colour, v.color)                     AS vehicle_colour,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20))                       AS fuel_type,            -- no source
    YEAR(cw.date_first_registered)                  AS year_of_manufacture,  -- 8.0% match
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(30))                       AS vehicle_category      -- no source

FROM registrations r
LEFT JOIN dvla_latest d     ON d.vehicle_registration = r.vehicle_registration
LEFT JOIN violator_latest v ON v.vehicle_registration = r.vehicle_registration
LEFT JOIN carweb_latest cw  ON cw.vehicle_registration = r.vehicle_registration

model.ccp.core_violation_type_legacy.name: core_violation_type_legacy
model.ccp.core_violation_type_legacy.raw_code:
-- Core violation-type entity (Built from NewLogic checked_plates, all 8
-- year-shards 2018-2025). Grain = 1 per distinct (violation_type,
-- fuzzy_ready) pair. Per the dbt build guide for the TrafficGuard/NewLogic
-- dimension tables, second pass (2026-08-31).
--
-- Naming: TrafficGuard/NewLogic (legacy-system) core entity -- see the naming
-- note in core_claim_legacy.sql.
--
-- CANDIDATE ONLY -- the weakest build in this pass. checked_plates
-- .violation_type/.fuzzy_ready are real, schema-confirmed columns (already
-- used for match_type/anpr_confidence_flag in core_stream_pair_legacy), but
-- their actual distinct-value cardinality across ~53M rows spanning 8
-- year-shards has never been profiled -- this dimension could turn out to
-- need 5 rows or 500.
--
-- match_type has no source on checked_plates -- the closest "how was this
-- matched" signal lives on stage2_plates.logic_type, a different table at a
-- different (pair) grain, already surfaced as match_method on
-- core_stream_pair_legacy. Not duplicated here as it doesn't share this
-- table's grain.
--
-- fuzzy_flag: 'Y'/'1' guessed as the true-ish values for a CHAR(1)-style
-- flag, unconfirmed against the source's actual distinct values.

{{ config(
    alias = 'core_violation_type_legacy',
    tags = ['core', 'violation_type']
) }}

WITH

{% set years = var('newlogic_years') %}
{% for y in years %}
year_{{ y }} AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT violation_type, fuzzy_ready
    FROM {{ ref('checked_plates_' ~ y) }}
    WHERE violation_type IS NOT NULL OR fuzzy_ready IS NOT NULL
){% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
,

unioned AS (
{% for y in years %}
    SELECT * FROM year_{{ y }}
    {% if not loop.last %}UNION{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    CONCAT(COALESCE(violation_type, 'UNKNOWN'), '|', COALESCE(fuzzy_ready, 'UNKNOWN')) AS violation_type_key,
    violation_type                                     AS violator_type,
    violation_type                                      AS type_label,       -- no separate label field found -- reusing the same value
    CASE WHEN fuzzy_ready IN ('Y', '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fuzzy_flag,      -- derived, unconfirmed true-value guess
    CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)                                AS sort_order        -- no source
FROM unioned
