        TRIM(UPPER(inc.ccp_ticketno))                                       AS pcn_key,
        inc.ccp_claimno                                                     AS claim_id,
        s.site_number                                                       AS site_id,
        LOWER(CAST(inc.ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36)))                            AS site_guid,
        inc.ccp_currentticketprice                                          AS total_amount,
        inc.ccp_ticketsentdate                                              AS pcn_issue_date

    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }} inc
    LEFT JOIN site_lookup s
        ON LOWER(CAST(inc.ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36))) = s.ccp_siteid
    WHERE
        -- BUG FOUND LIVE 2026-09-18: this was 'b7743f49-01ac-ef11-b8e8-00224800eacc',
        -- the Legal Claims casetype (see core_claims.sql's "Filter Legal Claims"
        -- comment) instead of the Ticket/PCN casetype every other model in the
        -- codebase uses for this exact purpose (int_ticket.sql, core_pv.sql,
        -- core_pcn_lifecycle.sql, int_pcn_event_scd_legacy.sql). That wrong GUID
        -- shrank this CTE from ~1.49M real PCN tickets down to 83,785 claim-type
        -- incidents, so almost every payment's LEFT JOIN to `incident` (and,
        -- through it, to `claim_issue`) failed to match -- confirmed live: 0 of
        -- 821,990 core_payment rows had a non-null claim_issue_date, silently
        -- collapsing every Live payment into 'pre_court' and gutting Post Court's
        -- Total Amount Collected.
        LOWER(CAST(inc.ccp_casetype AS VARCHAR(36))) = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'

    UNION ALL

    -- DATA QUALITY 2026-09-22: 8 payments have ccp_ticket pointing to an
    -- Appeal-casetype incident (60fc97f4-9763-ee11-8df0-0022481ab7e6) rather
    -- than a Ticket/PCN incident. The primary branch above never matches them,
    -- leaving pcn_issue_date NULL. Fix: join the appeal incident's ccp_ticketno
    -- back to the deduped ticket incident to recover ccp_ticketsentdate.
    -- Confirmed recoverable for all 8 via diagnostic query (Q3 above, result
    -- shows recoverable_issue_date populated for every appeal-linked row).
    SELECT
        appeal.incidentid,
        ticket.ccp_ticketno                                             AS pcn_id,
        TRIM(UPPER(ticket.ccp_ticketno))                                AS pcn_key,
        appeal.ccp_claimno                                              AS claim_id,
        s.site_number                                                   AS site_id,
        LOWER(CAST(appeal.ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36)))                     AS site_guid,
        appeal.ccp_currentticketprice                                   AS total_amount,
        ticket.ccp_ticketsentdate                                       AS pcn_issue_date

    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }} appeal
    JOIN {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }} ticket
        ON  TRIM(UPPER(CAST(ticket.ccp_ticketno AS VARCHAR(50))))
          = TRIM(UPPER(CAST(appeal.ccp_ticketno AS VARCHAR(50))))
        AND LOWER(CAST(ticket.ccp_casetype AS VARCHAR(36)))
          = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
    LEFT JOIN site_lookup s
        ON LOWER(CAST(appeal.ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36))) = s.ccp_siteid
    WHERE LOWER(CAST(appeal.ccp_casetype AS VARCHAR(36)))
        = '60fc97f4-9763-ee11-8df0-0022481ab7e6'

),

claim_issue AS (

    SELECT
        pcn_id                                                          AS pcn_key,
        claim_issue_date

    FROM {{ ref('int_claim_issue_date_zeus') }}

)

SELECT

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 1. REPORTING LAYER COLUMNS (fact_payment ER DIAGRAM ALIGNED - 11 COLUMNS)
    -- =========================================================================
    p.payment_id,
    
    -- PCN & Claim link
    i.pcn_id,
    i.claim_id,
    CAST(i.site_id AS VARCHAR(50))                                      AS site_id,
    CAST(i.site_guid AS VARCHAR(36))                                    AS site_guid,

    -- Transaction Execution Date
    CAST(p.payment_date AS DATE)                                       AS payment_date,

    -- [NEW] Payment Issue / Entry Date (from payment transaction record)
    CAST(i.pcn_issue_date AS DATE)                AS pcn_issue_date,
    CAST(COALESCE(p.created_on, p.payment_date) AS DATE)                AS transaction_date,

    -- [NEW] Claim Issue Date (from int_claim_issue_date_zeus)
    CAST(c.claim_issue_date AS DATE)                                    AS claim_issue_date,

    -- [NEW] Payment Issuance Financial Year Cohort (FY24, FY25, FY26, FY27)
    CASE
        WHEN MONTH(i.pcn_issue_date) >= 4
            THEN CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(i.pcn_issue_date) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
        ELSE CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(i.pcn_issue_date) AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
    END AS pcn_issue_fy,

    -- Refunds/chargebacks are netted into post_court/pre_court by payment_date,
    -- not carved into a separate 'refund' stage -- confirmed against the
    -- client's own Per CCP July-2026 Post/Pre Court figures: their
    -- Post Court + Pre Court sums to their Total (720,562 + 2,020,437 =
    -- 2,740,999 vs Total 2,740,998, a GBP1 rounding gap), which only holds if
    -- refunds are netted into the two buckets rather than excluded from both.
    -- Excluding refunds (the old logic) left Post Court + Pre Court GBP6,435
    -- higher than Total for that same month.
    CASE
        WHEN c.claim_issue_date IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(p.payment_date AS DATE) >= CAST(c.claim_issue_date AS DATE)
            THEN 'post_court'
        ELSE 'pre_court'
    END AS claim_payment_stage,

    -- [NEW] Days Elapsed (payment date vs issue date)
    DATEDIFF(
        day, 
        CAST(i.pcn_issue_date AS DATE), 
        CAST(p.payment_date AS DATE)
    )                                                                   AS days_since_issue,

    -- Financial Measures (DECIMAL 18,2 to prevent overflow Error 8115)
    CAST(p.amount_paid AS DECIMAL(18,2))               AS amount_paid,
    -- (CAST(i.total_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2)) -  CAST(p.amount_paid AS DECIMAL(18,2)) )            AS amount_due,
    CAST(i.total_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))
-
SUM(CAST(p.amount_paid AS DECIMAL(18,2))) OVER (
    PARTITION BY i.pcn_id
    ORDER BY p.payment_date, p.payment_id
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
) AS amount_due,


    -- =========================================================================
    -- 2. EXTENDED CORE ATTRIBUTES (PRESERVED)
    -- =========================================================================
    p.incident_id,
    p.payment_method,
    p.payment_method_id,
    p.failed_transaction_flag,
    p.refund_flag,
    i.total_amount

FROM payment p

LEFT JOIN incident i
    ON LOWER(CAST(p.incident_id AS VARCHAR(36)))
     = LOWER(CAST(i.incidentid AS VARCHAR(36)))

LEFT JOIN claim_issue c
    ON c.pcn_key = i.pcn_key;

model.ccp.core_pcn.name: core_pcn
model.ccp.core_pcn.raw_code:
-- Core PCN entity
-- Grain = 1 per ticket

{{ config(
    alias = 'core_pcn',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn']
) }}

-- Latest tracing outcome per PCN from ccp_recordtracingoutcomes
-- Ordered by ccp_recordtracedon DESC so the most recent trace result
-- surfaces as the current/final tracing state on the PCN.
WITH pcn AS (
    SELECT
        i.pcn_id,
        i.incident_id,
        i.pv_id,
        i.ccp_sitenumber  AS site_id,
        LOWER(CAST(i.ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36))) AS site_guid,
        i.violation_date AS pv_date,
        lba.ccp_lbalettersid AS lba_id,
        i.claim_number AS claim_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS fine_id,
        i.issue_date,
        i.ticket_price AS charge,
        i.ticket_price AS total_payment_amount,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS current_status,
        i.statecode AS current_status_code,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS payment_status,
        i.statuscode AS payment_status_code,
        i.match_type,
        i.fuzzy_flag,

        CAST(
            CASE WHEN i.statecode = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            AS BIT
        ) AS cancelled_flag,

        i.cancellation_reason AS cancelled_reason,
        i.cancelled_date,

        CAST(
            CASE WHEN i.paused_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            AS BIT
        ) AS paused_flag,

        i.paused_date,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS paused_reason,

        CASE 
            WHEN i.statuscodename = 'Fully Paid' OR i.statuscode = 860620002 
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS fully_paid_flag,



        CASE
            WHEN i.outstanding_balance = 0 THEN pay.last_accepted_payment_date
        END AS fully_paid_date,

        -- Was i.total_amount_paid (ccp_totalamountpaid, a raw Zeus rollup
        -- field with no independent verification) -- now sourced from
        -- int_payment.total_paid_ledger, the actual signed transaction sum,
        -- same fix already applied to claims' cash_collected (see
        -- core_claims.sql) and to core_pcn_legacy.sql's total_paid.
        CAST(COALESCE(pay.total_paid_ledger, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS total_paid,
        pay.total_paid_ledger,
        pay.refund_count,

        -- Gross "ever paid" flag, matching the client's TicketWasPaid
        -- semantics (see int_payment.sql's header) -- confirmed live
        -- 2026-09-09 against the client's Accrued Income Report: their
        -- PCNs Paid count matches DISTINCTCOUNT(TicketWasPaid=1) almost
        -- exactly (23,917 vs report's 23,903 for April 2023), while a
        -- net-positive-balance definition (total_paid > 0) undercounts by
        -- ~900 -- refunded/reversed tickets still count as "Paid" on their
        -- side. Do not derive this from total_paid > 0.
        CAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(pay.n_nonzero_transactions, 0) > 0
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS ever_paid_flag,
        -- collection_cycle_stage: maps ccp_substage onto the same canonical
        -- ladder vocabulary as Legacy's pcnstatus_stage_map seed (ISSUED,
        -- REMINDER_1/2/3, LBA, DEBT_RECOVERY(_RETURNED), CLAIM_ISSUED,
        -- POST_CCJ(_RECOVERY[_RETURNED]), TRACING, NTK, POPLA, PAID,
        -- CANCELLED) so fact_pcn has one consistent field across both source
        -- systems. The ccp_substage -> stage_key mapping itself is copied
        -- from core_pcn_lifecycle.sql (verified live against 1.46M records);
        -- PAID/CANCELLED override the substage here since those are terminal
        -- states that can outlive whatever substage the ticket was last left
        -- at, same precedence Legacy's map gives Paid/Cancelled. A few DNI/
        -- "Do Not Issue" substages have no exact Legacy analog and are
        -- best-guess mapped (NTK for review/hold states) -- same caveat the
        -- Legacy seed documents for its own unmapped statuses.
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN i.statuscodename = 'Fully Paid' OR i.statuscode = 860620002 THEN 'PAID'
                WHEN i.statecode = 2                                            THEN 'CANCELLED'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800001     THEN 'ISSUED'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800002     THEN 'REMINDER_1'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800003     THEN 'REMINDER_2'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800004     THEN 'REMINDER_3'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800005     THEN 'POPLA'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800006     THEN 'DEBT_RECOVERY'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800007     THEN 'DEBT_RECOVERY_RETURNED'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800008     THEN 'LBA'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800009     THEN 'LBA'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800011     THEN 'CLAIM_ISSUED'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800012     THEN 'POST_CCJ'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800013     THEN 'POST_CCJ'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800014     THEN 'POST_CCJ'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800015     THEN 'POST_CCJ_RECOVERY'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800016     THEN 'POST_CCJ_RECOVERY_RETURNED'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800017     THEN 'POST_CCJ'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800018     THEN 'POST_CCJ_RECOVERY'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 800019     THEN 'POPLA'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 860620000  THEN 'POPLA'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 860620001  THEN 'NTK'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 860620002  THEN 'CLAIM_ISSUED'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 860620005  THEN 'POST_CCJ'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 860620007  THEN 'CLAIM_ISSUED'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 860620008  THEN 'DEBT_RECOVERY'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 860620009  THEN 'DEBT_RECOVERY_RETURNED'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 860620010  THEN 'TRACING'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 100000001  THEN 'NTK'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 100000003  THEN 'ISSUED'
                WHEN i.ccp_substage = 100000004  THEN 'CLAIM_ISSUED'
                ELSE NULL
            END
        AS VARCHAR(50)) AS collection_cycle_stage,
        i.ccp_substage AS collection_cycle_stage_code,

        CAST(
            CASE WHEN d.incident_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            AS BIT
        ) AS discount_flag,

        d.discount_type,
        d.discount_amount,
        d.surcharge_amount,
        ap.statuscode AS appeal_statuscode,
        tr.ccp_tracingoutcomename AS tracing_outcome,

        -- Latest tracing outcome detail columns (from ccp_recordtracingoutcomes)
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tr.ccp_tracingoutcomename)) LIKE '%no ccj%'
            THEN 'No'
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tr.ccp_tracingoutcomename)) LIKE '%ccj%'
            THEN 'Yes'
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                                 AS tracing_outcome_ccj,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tr.ccp_tracingoutcomename)) LIKE 'same address%'
            THEN 'Same address'
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tr.ccp_tracingoutcomename)) LIKE 'new address%'
            THEN 'New address'
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                                 AS tracing_outcome_address_match,

        CASE
            WHEN tr.ccp_score IS NULL OR tr.ccp_score = 0
            THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(tr.ccp_score AS VARCHAR(50))
        END                                                                 AS tracing_outcome_tracing_score,

        cl.claim_statuscode,
        lba.ccp_lbatypename AS lba_type,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS lba_status,
        lba.statecode AS lba_status_code,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS payment_plan_type,
        pp.ccp_paymentplantype AS payment_plan_type_code,
        pp.ccp_dateoffirstpayment AS payment_plan_start_date,
        mv.ccp_lbageneratedstatus AS multiviolator_type,

        /*
            DNI STATUS
            1 = Do Not Issue
            0 = Not Do Not Issue
            Codes:
            860620001 = Legal 1 - Do not Issue - Under review
            860620008 = DNI - DR Sent
            100000001 = Do Not Issue - No Further Action
            860620009 = DNI - DR Returned
        */
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN i.ccp_substage IN (860620001, 860620008, 100000001, 860620009) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
            AS BIT
        ) AS dni_status,

        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS dni_reason,

        -- Inheriting dynamically calculated violator type from int_ticket
        i.violator_type,

        /*
            FINAL TYPE LABEL
            Fuzzy + SV       = Fuzzy SV
            Fuzzy + MV       = Fuzzy MV
            Non-Fuzzy + SV   = Non-fuzzy SV
            Non-Fuzzy + MV   = Non-fuzzy MV
        */
        CASE
            WHEN i.fuzzy_flag = 'FUZZY' AND i.violator_type = 'SV' THEN 'Fuzzy SV'
            WHEN i.fuzzy_flag = 'FUZZY' AND i.violator_type = 'MV' THEN 'Fuzzy MV'
            WHEN i.fuzzy_flag = 'Non-FUZZY' AND i.violator_type = 'SV' THEN 'Non-fuzzy SV'
            WHEN i.fuzzy_flag = 'Non-FUZZY' AND i.violator_type = 'MV' THEN 'Non-fuzzy MV'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS type_label,

        CASE
        WHEN MONTH(i.issue_date) >= 4
                THEN CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(i.issue_date) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
            ELSE CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(i.issue_date) AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
        END AS issue_fy,

        CASE
            WHEN MONTH(i.violation_date) >= 4
                THEN CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(i.violation_date) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
            ELSE CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(i.violation_date) AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
        END AS pv_fy,

        d.discount_type_count,
        d.excluded_amount_to_value_rows                 AS discount_excluded_rows,
        d.excluded_untyped_rows                         AS discount_excluded_untyped_rows,
        pay.unmapped_type_rows                          AS payment_unmapped_type_rows,
        CASE
            WHEN i.ccp_golivedate IS NULL OR i.issue_date IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(i.issue_date AS DATE) < CAST(i.ccp_golivedate AS DATE) THEN 0
            ELSE DATEDIFF(MONTH, CAST(i.ccp_golivedate AS DATE), CAST(i.issue_date AS DATE))
        END                                             AS months_since_golive,
        CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(i.statuscodename) NOT IN ('cancelled','fully paid','resolved','appeal accepted') THEN 1
            ELSE 0 
        END                                             AS is_live

    FROM {{ ref('int_ticket') }} i

    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_latest_lba') }} lba ON lba.incident_id = i.incident_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_latest_tracing') }} tr ON tr.incident_id = i.incident_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_latest_appeal') }} ap ON ap.parent_case_id = i.incident_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_claim') }} cl ON cl.claim_incident_id = i.claim_incident_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_discount') }} d ON d.incident_id = i.incident_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_payment') }} pay ON pay.incident_id = i.incident_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_latest_payment_plan') }} pp ON pp.claim_incident_id = i.claim_incident_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('ccp_mvlba') }} mv ON LOWER(mv.ccp_mvlbaid) = i.mvlba_ref
)

SELECT 
    pcn_id,
    incident_id,
    pv_id,
    site_id,
    site_guid,
    lba_id,
    claim_id,
    fine_id,
    issue_date,
    pv_date,
    charge,
    total_payment_amount,
    current_status,
    current_status_code,
    payment_status,
    payment_status_code,
    match_type,
    fuzzy_flag,
    cancelled_flag,
    cancelled_reason,
    cancelled_date,
    paused_flag,
    paused_date,
    paused_reason,
    fully_paid_flag,
    fully_paid_date,
    total_paid,
    total_paid_ledger,
    refund_count,
    ever_paid_flag,
    collection_cycle_stage,
    collection_cycle_stage_code,
    discount_flag,
    discount_type,
    discount_amount,
    surcharge_amount,
    appeal_statuscode,
    tracing_outcome,
    tracing_outcome_ccj,
    tracing_outcome_address_match,
    tracing_outcome_tracing_score,
    claim_statuscode,
    lba_type,
    lba_status,
    lba_status_code,
    payment_plan_type,
    payment_plan_type_code,
    payment_plan_start_date,
    multiviolator_type,
    dni_status,
    dni_reason,
    violator_type,
    type_label,
    issue_fy,
    pv_fy,
    discount_type_count,
    discount_excluded_rows,
    discount_excluded_untyped_rows,
    payment_unmapped_type_rows,
    CONVERT(
        VARCHAR(32),
        HASHBYTES(
            'MD5',
            CONCAT(
                UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(violator_type))),
                '|',
                UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(match_type)))
            )
        ),
        2
    ) AS violation_type_key,
    months_since_golive,
    is_live

FROM pcn

model.ccp.int_claim.name: int_claim
model.ccp.int_claim.raw_code:
-- Intermediate (live/pcn): int_claim -- the claim, reached by self-join on
-- ticket.ccp_claimid. The claim is itself another incident row (75,915 of
-- 1,438,768 tickets carry one, confirmed live). Unscoped -- any incident row
-- (ticket, appeal, or claim) can in principle be pointed to by a ticket's
-- ccp_claimid.

{{ config(
    alias = 'int_claim',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn']
) }}

WITH ranked_claims AS (

    SELECT
        LOWER(incidentid) AS claim_incident_id,
        statuscode AS claim_statuscode,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LOWER(incidentid)
            ORDER BY modifiedon DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM {{ ref('incident') }}
)

SELECT
    claim_incident_id,
    claim_statuscode
FROM ranked_claims
WHERE rn = 1

model.ccp.int_discount.name: int_discount
model.ccp.int_discount.raw_code:
{{ config(
    alias = 'int_discount',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn','int_discount']
) }}

-- Intermediate (live/pcn): int_discount -- split discount from surcharge.
-- ccp_ticketdiscountsurcharge mixes multiple types in one table (~3.3M rows
-- against 1,438,768 tickets) -- summed whole it nets or doubles the figure.
--
-- Confirmed live 2026-08-21 (figures drift slightly from the original spec
-- draft -- ongoing live ingestion, not a discrepancy worth chasing):
--   Amount By Value    1,848,533 rows  -24,904,301.91   the discount
--   Surcharge          1,344,778 rows  +91,373,647.11   not a discount
--   Amount To Value        78,774 rows +186,693,348,690.81  EXCLUDED -- not an amount
--   NULL type              70,361 rows  -2,817,493.00   EXCLUDED -- type unknown, not in the original spec
--   Amount By Percentage        3 rows          -72.50   negligible, folded into the two main buckets by omission
--
-- Amount To Value averages ~2.4m per row against a maximum ticket price of
-- 100.00 -- not money in the same unit as the rest of the column.
--
-- CORRECTION: the original spec claimed Amount To Value "by discount type
-- ... all sits under Manual". Measured live, it does not -- within those
-- 78,774 excluded rows, ccp_discounttypename splits Appeal 53,317 (67.7%),
-- Manual 19,761 (25.1%), Lifecycle 5,502 (7.0%), NULL 194. Recorded here so
-- nobody re-derives the wrong assumption from the exclusion.
--
-- discount_type/discount_type_count are NOT filtered to the discount rows
-- only (matches the original spec's own aggregation) -- they span every
-- discountsurchargetype bucket for the ticket, since ccp_discounttypename is
-- a separate field populated across all of them, not just the true discount
-- rows. discount_type_count exposes when MAX silently drops a second value.
--
-- 'Lifecycle' dominates the resulting discount_type on ~97% of discounted
-- tickets -- checked live whether that was an artifact of the unfiltered
-- aggregation (Surcharge rows leaking in) before trusting it, and it is not:
-- even filtered to JUST the real 'Amount By Value' discount rows, the split
-- is Lifecycle 1,754,933, Appeal 87,782, Manual 716 -- Lifecycle genuinely is
-- the overwhelming majority discount type in this data, not a filtering bug.

WITH enriched_discount AS (

    SELECT
        ccp_incidentid,
        ccp_amount,
        
        -- Resolve Discount/Surcharge Type
        CASE ccp_discountsurchargetype
            WHEN 860620000 THEN 'Amount By Percentage'
            WHEN 860620001 THEN 'Amount By Value'
            WHEN 860620002 THEN 'Amount To Value'
            WHEN 860620003 THEN 'Surcharge'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ccp_discountsurchargetypename,
        
        -- Resolve Discount Category Name
        CASE ccp_discounttype
            WHEN 860620000 THEN 'Manual'
            WHEN 860620001 THEN 'Appeal'
            WHEN 860620003 THEN 'Lifecycle'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ccp_discounttypename

    FROM {{ ref('ccp_ticketdiscountsurcharge') }}
    WHERE ccp_incidentid IS NOT NULL

)

SELECT
    LOWER(ccp_incidentid) AS incident_id,
    
    SUM(CASE WHEN ccp_discountsurchargetypename = 'Amount By Value'
             THEN CAST(ccp_amount AS DECIMAL(19,4)) END)              AS discount_amount,
             
    SUM(CASE WHEN ccp_discountsurchargetypename = 'Surcharge'
             THEN CAST(ccp_amount AS DECIMAL(19,4)) END)              AS surcharge_amount,
             
    MAX(ccp_discounttypename)                                         AS discount_type,
    
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccp_discounttypename)                              AS discount_type_count,
    
    SUM(CASE WHEN ccp_discountsurchargetypename = 'Amount To Value'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                       AS excluded_amount_to_value_rows,
             
    SUM(CASE WHEN ccp_discountsurchargetypename IS NULL
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                       AS excluded_untyped_rows

FROM enriched_discount
GROUP BY LOWER(ccp_incidentid)

model.ccp.int_incident_deduped.name: int_incident_deduped
model.ccp.int_incident_deduped.raw_code:
-- Intermediate (live/shared): int_incident_deduped
-- Grain = 1 per incidentid, latest snapshot.
--
-- zeus.incident carries multiple snapshot rows per incidentid rather than
-- latest-state-only (same issue found and fixed for appeals in
-- core_appeals_lifecycle.sql and for tickets in int_ticket.sql -- see those
-- files' headers). Any model that joins on incidentid, or runs a
-- PARTITION BY incidentid window function, must read incident through here
-- instead of `{{ ref('incident') }}` directly -- otherwise a duplicated
-- incidentid silently fans out a join, or (worse) two snapshots showing
-- genuinely different field values (not just a different modifiedon) get
-- both counted as if they were separate real rows.
--
-- Confirmed live 2026-09-07: 67,418 of 2,097,973 incidentids are duplicated
-- overall; scoped to the PCN casetype alone, 55,765 incidentids have >1
-- snapshot row and 17,949 of those disagree on ccp_substage across their
-- snapshots (not just modifiedon) -- a real, growing correctness risk, not
-- a theoretical one. This model is the single shared fix; int_ticket.sql
-- and core_appeals_lifecycle.sql keep their own inline versions of the same
-- logic (predates this shared model, still correct, not worth the
-- rebuild-order churn of switching them over).

{{ config(
    alias = 'int_incident_deduped',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'shared']
) }}

SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
        i.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY incidentid
            ORDER BY modifiedon DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('incident') }} AS i
) deduped
WHERE rn = 1

model.ccp.int_latest_appeal.name: int_latest_appeal
model.ccp.int_latest_appeal.raw_code:
-- Intermediate (live/pcn): int_latest_appeal -- the appeal child case,
-- reached by parentcaseid = the ticket's incidentid. Latest child case per
-- ticket, by createdon.
--
-- CORRECTION against the original spec draft, confirmed live 2026-08-21:
-- the spec's own filter (`LOWER(COALESCE(case_type_name,'')) LIKE '%appeal%'`)
-- is currently BROKEN -- ccp_casetypename is 100% NULL for every child-case
-- row (472,146 of 472,146), for BOTH appeal case-type GUIDs. The label
-- simply hasn't survived for these two optionset values, even though it
-- does survive for the main 'Ticket' scope filter on the same column.
--
-- Filtered on the two case-type GUIDs directly instead -- confirmed stable
-- and far more reliable than a label that resolves to NULL:
--   60fc97f4-9763-ee11-8df0-0022481ab7e6  Appeal        450,288 rows
--   26e162df-3e24-f011-8c4e-0022481a77e4  Legal Appeal   21,854 rows
-- (4 child rows have neither GUID and are excluded either way.) Close to
-- the spec's cited 450,910/21,943 -- the drift is ongoing live ingestion
-- since the spec was written, not a mismatch worth chasing.
--
-- ONLY the Appeal GUID is scoped in below, per Connor's finding on the
-- team call: despite the name, "Legal Appeal" is not an appeal at all --
-- it's the defence-and-counterclaim case in court, a defence against a
-- damages claim, unrelated to a violator's appeal. This model previously
-- picked whichever of the two child cases was most recent by createdon,
-- meaning a ticket whose latest child case was a Legal Appeal was silently
-- reporting counterclaim status/dates as its "appeal" -- confirmed a real,
-- live-affecting conflation, not a naming quibble.
--
-- ccp_violatorsappeal is NOT the source -- it's the portal submission
-- record, not the case, and its ccp_pcn is free text, not a GUID.
--
-- Reads int_incident_deduped, not incident, as of 2026-09-07 -- this
-- model's own ROW_NUMBER partitions by parentcaseid/createdon to pick the
-- latest DISTINCT appeal case per ticket, which only works correctly once
-- each appeal incidentid itself appears exactly once. Reading raw incident
-- meant a single appeal's own snapshot duplicates (same incidentid,
-- differing modifiedon, identical createdon) could tie on this model's own
-- ORDER BY and get arbitrarily split across ranks -- int_incident_deduped
-- collapses that first.

{{ config(
    alias = 'int_latest_appeal',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn']
) }}

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(parentcaseid) AS parent_case_id,
        statuscode,
        statecode,
        createdon,
        incidentid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LOWER(parentcaseid)
            ORDER BY createdon DESC, incidentid DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE parentcaseid IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(ccp_casetype) = '60fc97f4-9763-ee11-8df0-0022481ab7e6'  -- Appeal only -- see header
)

SELECT parent_case_id, statuscode, statecode, createdon
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

model.ccp.int_latest_lba.name: int_latest_lba
model.ccp.int_latest_lba.raw_code:
-- Intermediate (live/pcn): int_latest_lba -- latest LBA letter per ticket.
-- All 379,996 ccp_lbaletters rows match on ccp_pcn = incident.incidentid
-- (confirmed live 2026-08-21, exact figure). Uses ccp_lbatypename, the
-- surviving lookup label, not ccp_lbatype (the raw code).
--
-- lba_status is NOT resolved here (see core_pcn.sql) -- ccp_lbaletters
-- itself carries statecodename fine as a column, but this needs its actual
-- value-set measured before it's trusted as a status; raw statecode is
-- passed through as a bonus column for that future work.

{{ config(
    alias = 'int_latest_lba',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn','int_latest_lba']
) }}

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(ccp_pcn) AS incident_id,
        ccp_lbalettersid,
        statecode,
        CASE ccp_lbatype
            WHEN 860620000 THEN 'Fast-tracked'
            WHEN 860620001 THEN 'Regular'
            WHEN 860620002 THEN 'New Address'
            WHEN 860620003 THEN 'New Address - Fast-tracked'
            ELSE NULL
        END  AS ccp_lbatypename,
        ccp_lbasenton,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LOWER(ccp_pcn)
            ORDER BY ccp_lbasenton DESC, ccp_lbalettersid DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_lbaletters') }}
    WHERE ccp_pcn IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT incident_id, ccp_lbalettersid, statecode, ccp_lbatypename, ccp_lbasenton
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

model.ccp.int_latest_payment_plan.name: int_latest_payment_plan
model.ccp.int_latest_payment_plan.raw_code:
-- Intermediate (live/pcn): int_latest_payment_plan -- joined on the
-- ticket's CLAIM, not the ticket itself. Both keys land (confirmed live:
-- 1,487 via incident.incidentid, 1,500 via incident.ccp_claimid) -- the
-- claim-id route is used since it reaches more rows and matches what the
-- source column is named after.
--
-- ccp_paymentplantype is carried as a RAW CODE only -- ccp_instalmentconfig
-- has no *name label columns at all (confirmed: no ccp_paymentplantypename,
-- no statecodename/statuscodename either), unlike every other zeus table
-- touched by this fact. Per the business's instruction (2026-08-21), the
-- decoded payment_plan_type goes out as typed NULL at the fact layer until
-- a label mapping is ingested.

{{ config(
    alias = 'int_latest_payment_plan',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn']
) }}

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(ccp_claimid) AS claim_incident_id,
        ccp_paymentplantype,
        ccp_dateoffirstpayment,
        ccp_instalmentconfigid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LOWER(ccp_claimid)
            ORDER BY ccp_dateoffirstpayment DESC, ccp_instalmentconfigid DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_instalmentconfig') }}
    WHERE ccp_claimid IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT claim_incident_id, ccp_paymentplantype, ccp_dateoffirstpayment
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

model.ccp.int_latest_tracing.name: int_latest_tracing
model.ccp.int_latest_tracing.raw_code:
-- Intermediate (live/pcn): int_latest_tracing -- latest tracing outcome per
-- ticket. 690,803 ccp_recordtracingoutcomes rows match on
-- ccp_ticketno = incident.incidentid (confirmed live, exact figure).
--
-- Do NOT map tracing_status to statecodename on this table -- it is
-- 'Active' on every single row (0% information; "populated but constant" is
-- not a source). ccp_tracingoutcomename is the real result, 9 values.

{{ config(
    alias = 'int_latest_tracing',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn','int_latest_tracing']
) }}

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(ccp_ticketno) AS incident_id,
        CASE ccp_tracingoutcome
            WHEN 860620000 THEN 'Deceased / Insolvent'
            WHEN 860620001 THEN 'New address provided'
            WHEN 860620002 THEN 'Due Claim'
            WHEN 860620003 THEN 'Same Address - satisfied CCJ'
            WHEN 860620004 THEN 'Same Address - live CCJ'
            WHEN 860620005 THEN 'Not matched / Invalid'
            WHEN 860620006 THEN 'Same address - No CCJ'
            WHEN 860620007 THEN 'New Address - No CCJ'
            WHEN 860620008 THEN 'New Address - Live CCJ'
            WHEN 860620009 THEN 'Deceased'
            WHEN 860620010 THEN 'Insolvent'
            ELSE NULL
        END                                              AS ccp_tracingoutcomename,
        ccp_score,
        ccp_recordtracedon,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LOWER(ccp_ticketno)
            ORDER BY ccp_recordtracedon DESC, ccp_recordtracingoutcomesid DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_recordtracingoutcomes') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT incident_id, ccp_score, ccp_tracingoutcomename, ccp_recordtracedon
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

model.ccp.int_payment.name: int_payment
model.ccp.int_payment.raw_code:
-- Intermediate (live/pcn): int_payment -- the signed transaction ledger.
--
-- CORRECTION against the original spec draft: it hard-coded four
-- transaction-type codes (860620000-3) as "NOT YET VERIFIED". Confirmed
-- live 2026-08-21 against ccp_transactiontypename (the label):
--   860620000  Accepted       747,424 rows   45,122,129.85   the payment
--   860620001  Refund          40,190 rows    1,256,524.36   negative
--   860620002  Charged Back         1 row           100.00   negative
--   860620003  Failed           4,764 rows    3,272,914.43   zero-impact
-- Matches the spec's guessed sign logic exactly. REVERTED to the raw codes
-- 2026-09-09: ccp_transactiontypename no longer exists on the staged table
-- (schema drift on the raw source, same class of issue as ccp_mvlba's
-- ccp_lbageneratedstatusname) -- only ccp_transactiontype (the raw code)
-- survives now.

{{ config(
    alias = 'int_payment',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn']
) }}

WITH
-- BUG FOUND LIVE 2026-09-18: ccp_tickettransaction is configured as an
-- incremental MERGE keyed on ccp_tickettransactionid, but the physical
-- staging table carries 485 exact duplicate rows (same
-- ccp_tickettransactionid, same amount/date -- confirmed live, e.g.
-- transaction e518186e-74ab-f111-aad6-00155d018004 appears twice for ticket
-- 194324300911, doubling its total_paid from £170 to £340) -- the merge
-- has not enforced its own unique key. Deduping defensively here rather
-- than relying on the staging model's merge to self-heal. Confirmed
-- financial impact: £41,512.72 excess across the 485 duplicated IDs.
deduped_txn AS (
    SELECT
        ccp_ticket,
        ccp_transactiondate,
        ccp_transactiontype,
        ccp_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ccp_tickettransactionid
            ORDER BY ccp_tickettransactionid
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_tickettransaction') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticket IS NOT NULL
),

txn AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(ccp_ticket) AS incident_id,
        CAST(ccp_transactiondate AS DATE) AS payment_date,
        ccp_transactiontype,
        CASE
            WHEN ccp_transactiontype = 860620000 THEN  CAST(ccp_amount AS DECIMAL(19,4))  -- Accepted
            WHEN ccp_transactiontype = 860620001 THEN -CAST(ccp_amount AS DECIMAL(19,4))  -- Refund
            WHEN ccp_transactiontype = 860620002 THEN -CAST(ccp_amount AS DECIMAL(19,4))  -- Charged Back
            WHEN ccp_transactiontype = 860620003 THEN  CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(19,4))           -- Failed
        END AS amount_delta
    FROM deduped_txn
    WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT
    incident_id,
    SUM(amount_delta)  AS total_paid_ledger,
    MIN(payment_date)  AS first_payment_date,
    MAX(payment_date)  AS last_payment_date,
    -- Gross "was this ticket ever paid" signal, confirmed live 2026-09-09
    -- against the client's own Accrued Income Report: their TicketWasPaid
    -- flag is set on ANY transaction event row (Accepted, Refund or Charged
    -- Back alike -- their own SCD2 view only filters `Amount <> 0`, with no
    -- sign/type restriction), and stays true even if a later refund nets
    -- the ticket's total back to zero/negative -- it does NOT require a
    -- currently-positive net balance the way total_paid_ledger > 0 does,
    -- and is NOT limited to Accepted-only rows either (tested and ruled
    -- out: Accepted-only undercounts the report by a similar margin to
    -- total_paid_ledger > 0). 'Failed' rows are excluded since their
    -- amount_delta is always 0, matching Amount <> 0 on their side.
    -- Also requires a real payment_date -- confirmed live 2026-09-09: 446
    -- rows across the whole table have a nonzero transaction type but a
    -- NULL ccp_transactiondate (a data-quality edge case the client's own
    -- SCD2 view also carries -- their April 2023 cohort had 11 such
    -- tickets). Counting these without a date check inflated
    -- ever_paid_flag by that same small margin.
    COUNT(CASE WHEN amount_delta <> 0 AND payment_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS n_nonzero_transactions,
    -- fully_paid_date source, per Connor's finding (team call, 2026-08-2x):
    -- "date of the last Accepted transaction where remaining balance = 0" --
    -- last_payment_date above is wrong for this purpose on its own since it
    -- takes MAX() across ALL transaction types, so a later refund/failed row
    -- can push the date past the ticket's actual last real payment. This is
    -- gated on outstanding_balance = 0 at the core_pcn.sql layer (that's
    -- where "remaining balance = 0" lives -- int_ticket.outstanding_balance).
    MAX(CASE WHEN ccp_transactiontype = 860620000 THEN payment_date END) AS last_accepted_payment_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ccp_transactiontype IN (860620001, 860620002) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count,
    -- a genuinely new/unmapped transaction type would fall to NULL in amount_delta
    -- and vanish silently from the SUM -- this catches that.
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount_delta IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmapped_type_rows
FROM txn
GROUP BY incident_id

model.ccp.int_ticket.name: int_ticket
model.ccp.int_ticket.raw_code:
-- Intermediate (live/pcn): int_ticket
-- Grain = 1 per ticket.
--
-- Enriched with:
--   1. Potential violation match_type from POLUS in-house records
--   2. Fuzzy / Non-Fuzzy classification
--   3. Violator type calculated dynamically from incident counts (SV/MV)
--   4. DNI status from ccp_substage

{{ config(
    alias = 'int_ticket',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn','int_ticket']
) }}

WITH incident_deduped AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT
            incident_dedup.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY incidentid
                ORDER BY modifiedon DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM {{ ref('incident') }} AS incident_dedup
    ) deduped
    WHERE rn = 1
),

inhouse_records AS (
    SELECT
        stage2_plates_id,
        violation_type
    FROM {{ ref('records_presented_to_in_house') }}
),

ranked_inhouse AS (
    SELECT
        stage2_plates_id,
        violation_type,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY stage2_plates_id
            ORDER BY stage2_plates_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM inhouse_records
),

-- ccp_potentialviolation carries genuine duplicate rows for the same
-- real-world entity differing only by GUID case (confirmed live 2026-09-09,
-- e.g. both 'ef09a19f-...' and 'EF09A19F-...' for the same
-- ccp_potentialviolationid) -- the same class of issue int_incident_deduped
-- exists to solve for `incident`, but this table has no equivalent
-- protection. Deduping by LOWER(...) here so the LOWER(...)=LOWER(...) join
-- below doesn't match both case variants and silently fan out every ticket
-- row 2x.
potential_violation_deduped AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT
            pv.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY LOWER(CAST(pv.ccp_potentialviolationid AS VARCHAR(100)))
                ORDER BY pv.ccp_potentialviolationid
            ) AS rn
        FROM {{ ref('ccp_potentialviolation') }} AS pv
    ) x WHERE rn = 1
),

potential_violation AS (
    SELECT
        pv.ccp_potentialviolationid AS pv_id,
        r.violation_type AS match_type
    FROM potential_violation_deduped AS pv
    LEFT JOIN ranked_inhouse AS r
        ON CAST(pv.ccp_polusreference AS VARCHAR(100)) = CAST(r.stage2_plates_id AS VARCHAR(100))
        AND r.rn = 1
),

pv_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        pv.pv_id,
        pv.match_type,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(pv.match_type))) IN ('FUZZY', 'FUZZYNOPARK') THEN 'FUZZY'
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(pv.match_type))) IN ('OVERNIGHT', 'OVERSTAY', 'NOPARK') THEN 'Non-FUZZY'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fuzzy_flag
    FROM potential_violation AS pv
),

site_audit_new AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(CAST(s.ccp_siteid AS VARCHAR(36)))                        AS ccp_site,
        MIN(s.ccp_statuschangeon)                                       AS min_statuschangeon
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }} s
    INNER JOIN {{ ref('ccp_siteaudit') }} sa
        ON LOWER(CAST(s.ccp_siteid AS VARCHAR(36))) = LOWER(CAST(sa.ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36)))
    WHERE sa.ccp_newvalue IN (
              'New',
              'In Analysis',
              'Awaiting survey',
              'Booked for Install',
              'Installed',
              'Live - Operational'
          )
      AND s.ccp_siteid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY LOWER(CAST(s.ccp_siteid AS VARCHAR(36)))
),

-- Same case-duplication issue as ccp_potentialviolation above -- confirmed
-- live 2026-09-09 (e.g. both '1BF80591-...' and '1bf80591-...' for the same
-- ccp_siteid). SELECT DISTINCT alone doesn't dedupe these since the two
-- rows aren't byte-identical strings.
site AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT
            s.ccp_siteid,
            -- FIX: ccp_golivedate fallback comes from joining ccp_site & ccp_siteaudit
            -- where ccp_newvalue IN ('New', 'In Analysis', 'Awaiting survey', 'Booked for Install', 'Installed', 'Live - Operational').
            -- Grouped/deduped to 1 row per site to avoid exploding core_pcn & fact_pcn.
            COALESCE(s.ccp_golivedate, san.min_statuschangeon) AS ccp_golivedate,
            s.ccp_sitenumber,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY LOWER(CAST(s.ccp_siteid AS VARCHAR(100)))
                ORDER BY s.ccp_siteid
            ) AS rn
        FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }} s
        LEFT JOIN site_audit_new san
            ON LOWER(CAST(s.ccp_siteid AS VARCHAR(36))) = san.ccp_site
    ) x WHERE rn = 1
),

-- Dynamic SV/MV Calculation
sv_mv_calc AS (
    SELECT
        ccp_vehicleregistration,
        ccp_driverid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT incidentid) AS NoOfTickets
    FROM {{ ref('incident') }}
    WHERE ccp_casetype = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND statecode = 0
      AND statuscode NOT IN (860620002, 860620003, 6)
    GROUP BY
        ccp_vehicleregistration,
        ccp_driverid
),

ranked_incidents AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LOWER(incidentid)
            ORDER BY modifiedon DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('incident') }}
)

SELECT
    LOWER(i.incidentid) AS incident_id,
    i.ccp_ticketno AS pcn_id,
    LOWER(i.parentcaseid) AS parent_case_id,
    LOWER(i.ccp_casetype) AS case_type_id,
    i.ccp_casetypename AS case_type_name,
    i.ccp_dateofviolation AS violation_date,
    LOWER(i.ccp_potentialviolation) AS pv_id,
    LOWER(i.ccp_claimid) AS claim_incident_id,
    i.ccp_claimno AS claim_number,
    LOWER(i.ccp_mvlbaref) AS mvlba_ref,
    CAST(i.ccp_ticketsentdate AS DATETIME2(6)) AS issue_date,
    CAST(i.ccp_ticketprice AS DECIMAL(19,4)) AS ticket_price,
    CAST(i.ccp_totalamountpaid AS DECIMAL(19,4)) AS total_amount_paid,
    CAST(i.ccp_outstandingbalance AS DECIMAL(19,4)) AS outstanding_balance,
    i.statecode,
    i.statuscode,
    i.ccp_substage,
    i.ccp_cancellationreason AS cancellation_reason,
    CAST(i.ccp_cancelledon AS DATETIME2(6)) AS cancelled_date,
    CAST(i.ccp_pausedon AS DATETIME2(6)) AS paused_date,
    i.ccp_pausedby,
    
    CASE i.statuscode
        WHEN 860620017 THEN 'Acknowledgement Sent'
        WHEN 860620002 THEN 'Fully Paid'
        WHEN 860620011 THEN 'Appeal Accepted'
        WHEN 860620004 THEN 'Waiting for External response'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Cancelled'
        WHEN 860620023 THEN 'Live - Appeal Discount'
        WHEN 860620009 THEN 'Live'
        WHEN 860620018 THEN 'Live - Manual Discount'
        WHEN 860620020 THEN 'Live - Appeals'
        WHEN 860620008 THEN 'Internal Response Received'
        WHEN 765440000 THEN 'New'
        WHEN 860620006 THEN 'No Response - Action required'
        WHEN 860620010 THEN 'Outstanding'
        WHEN 860620025 THEN 'Live - Gone Away'
        WHEN 860620007 THEN 'External Response Received'
        WHEN 860620026 THEN 'Live - Breathing Space'
        WHEN 860620000 THEN 'Resolved'
        WHEN 860620003 THEN 'Live/Partially Paid'
        WHEN 860620031 THEN 'Live-Legal Appeal'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS statuscodename,

    i.ccp_dayssincepaused,
    i.ccp_ismultipleviolator,
    i.ccp_site,
    s.ccp_sitenumber,
    i.createdon,

    CASE
        WHEN sm.NoOfTickets <= 4 THEN 'SV'
        WHEN sm.NoOfTickets > 4 THEN 'MV'
        ELSE 'SV'
    END AS violator_type,

    pv.match_type,
    pv.fuzzy_flag,
    s.ccp_golivedate

FROM ranked_incidents AS i

LEFT JOIN pv_enriched AS pv
    ON LOWER(CAST(i.ccp_potentialviolation AS VARCHAR(100))) = LOWER(CAST(pv.pv_id AS VARCHAR(100)))

LEFT JOIN site AS s  
    ON LOWER(i.ccp_site) = LOWER(s.ccp_siteid)

LEFT JOIN sv_mv_calc AS sm
    ON i.ccp_vehicleregistration = sm.ccp_vehicleregistration
    AND i.ccp_driverid = sm.ccp_driverid

WHERE LOWER(i.ccp_casetype) = LOWER('52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c')
  AND i.parentcaseid IS NULL
  AND i.rn = 1

model.ccp.int_ticket_cancellation_zeus.name: int_ticket_cancellation_zeus
model.ccp.int_ticket_cancellation_zeus.raw_code:
-- Intermediate (live/pcn): int_ticket_cancellation_zeus -- the Dynamics/Zeus
-- side of a "Ticket Cancellation" event, per the client's
-- Staging.viewFactTicketsSCD2 trace (ZEUSEvents, Ticket Cancellation branch):
--   FROM Staging.Incident i WHERE i.StateCode = 2 AND i.ccp_cancelledon IS NOT NULL
--   AND i.ParentCaseId IS NULL
-- Grain = 1 per cancelled Zeus/migrated ticket.
--
-- This exists because of the view's SourceOrder rule (UnionSelected, Stage 7 in
-- the trace): for any ticket with a Dynamics presence at all, Dynamics wins
-- for EVERY event type, not just Claim Issued -- 'Dynamics' < 'Traffica'
-- alphabetically, and RANK() is computed per TicketNumber, not per event
-- type. A TG-sourced cancellation on a migrated ticket is therefore not a
-- legitimate second signal to keep alongside this one -- see how this is
-- consumed in int_pcn_event_scd_legacy.sql's Ticket Cancellation branch.

{{ config(
    alias = 'int_ticket_cancellation_zeus',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn']
) }}

SELECT
    TRIM(UPPER(ccp_ticketno))            AS pcn_ticket_no,
    MIN(CAST(ccp_cancelledon AS DATETIME2(6))) AS cancelled_date

FROM {{ ref('incident') }}
WHERE statecode = 2
  AND ccp_cancelledon IS NOT NULL
  AND parentcaseid IS NULL
  AND ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY TRIM(UPPER(ccp_ticketno))

model.ccp.int_ticket_payment_zeus.name: int_ticket_payment_zeus
model.ccp.int_ticket_payment_zeus.raw_code:
-- Intermediate (live/pcn): int_ticket_payment_zeus -- the Dynamics/Zeus side
-- of a "Ticket Payment" event, per the client's Staging.viewFactTicketsSCD2
-- trace (ZEUSEvents, Ticket Payment branch): ccp_tickettransaction joined to
-- incident on ccp_Ticket = IncidentId, sign-adjusted by transaction type
-- (860620000 payment +, 860620001 refund -, 860620002 chargeback -,
-- 860620003 failed = 0). Grain = 1 per Zeus/migrated-ticket transaction.
--
-- Same SourceOrder reasoning as int_ticket_cancellation_zeus.sql -- a
-- migrated ticket's payments are tracked in Zeus once it has any Dynamics
-- presence at all, so TG's own payment record for that ticket is not a
-- legitimate second signal to keep -- see how this is consumed in
-- int_pcn_event_scd_legacy.sql's Ticket Payment branch.

{{ config(
    alias = 'int_ticket_payment_zeus',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'core_pcn']
) }}

SELECT
    TRIM(UPPER(i.ccp_ticketno))                    AS pcn_ticket_no,
    CAST(t.ccp_transactiondate AS DATE)            AS payment_date,
    CASE t.ccp_transactiontype
        WHEN 860620000 THEN CAST(t.ccp_amount AS DECIMAL(19,4))
        WHEN 860620001 THEN -1 * CAST(t.ccp_amount AS DECIMAL(19,4))
        WHEN 860620002 THEN -1 * CAST(t.ccp_amount AS DECIMAL(19,4))
        WHEN 860620003 THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(19,4))
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,4))
    END                                             AS amount_delta

FROM {{ ref('ccp_tickettransaction') }} t
JOIN {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }} i
    ON LOWER(t.ccp_ticket) = LOWER(i.incidentid)
WHERE i.parentcaseid IS NULL
  AND i.ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
  AND t.ccp_transactiondate IS NOT NULL

model.ccp.core_pcn_lifecycle.name: core_pcn_lifecycle
model.ccp.core_pcn_lifecycle.raw_code:
{{ config(
    alias        = 'core_pcn_lifecycle',
    tags         = ['core', 'live', 'pcn', 'pcn_lifecycle'],
    materialized = 'table'
) }}

-- =========================================================================
-- Entity : core_pcn_lifecycle / fact_pcn_lifecycle
-- Grain  : 1 row per PCN lifecycle stage event reached
-- =========================================================================
-- ARCHITECTURE CHANGE (data-profiling driven, 2026-09-22):
-- Old design: 1 row per PCN sourced from ccp_substage on incident only.
--   → incident is overwritten on each stage change; no history survives.
--   → all lifecycle history was lost; only current stage was captured.
-- New design: UNION ALL of one block per stage, each using the best
--   persistent date source for that stage (date col, child table, or
--   substage fallback where no date col exists).
--   → one row per stage event per PCN; full lifecycle history preserved.
--
-- SOURCE DECISIONS (confirmed by data profiling 2026-09-22):
--
--  PCN_ISSUANCE        incident.createdon
--  FIRST/2ND/3RD REM   incident.ccp_first/second/thirdremindersenton
--  LBA                 incident.ccp_lbasentdate (client-canonical source,
--                       back to 2018; ccp_lbaletters starts Jun 2025 only)
--  LBA_REMINDER        ccp_lbaletters WHERE lbatype IN (860620002,860620003)
--                       (New Address variants; only source; Jun 2025+)
--  AT_POPLA            incident.ccp_atpopladatetime / ccp_poplasubmitteddate
--  AFTER_POPLA         incident.ccp_popladecisiondate
--  POPLA_WITHDRAWN     incident.ccp_poplawithdrawaldate
--  DUE_TRACING         ccp_recordtracingoutcomes MIN(ccp_recordtracedon)
--                       per PCN (719,787 rows vs 7,505 from tracingexportedon)
--  BREATHING_SPACE     statuscode = 860620026, modifiedon as proxy (2 rows)
--  DNI_DR_SENT         incident.ccp_dcblegalsenton
--  DNI_DR_RETURNED     incident.ccp_dcblegalreturnedon
--  DR_1ST_SENT         incident.ccp_debtrecover1stplacementon
--  DR_1ST_RETURNED     incident.ccp_dr1stplacementreturnedon (23,403 rows;
--                       senior noted substage 800007 = 16,621 current-only;
--                       date col wins coverage; 6,647 agree = not fabricated)
--  CCJ_OBTAINED        ccp_judgmentupdates WHERE ccp_type='Accepted'
--                       MIN(ccp_judgmentdate) per PCN (49,022 rows, 2019+;
--                       substage 800012 had only 63 current-only rows)
--  EXTERNAL_CLAIM      ccp_claimupdates WHERE ccp_type='Claim N1CPC issued'
--  INTERNAL_CLAIM      incident.ccp_claimissuedate, NOT EXISTS claimupdates
--
--  SUBSTAGE FALLBACKS (no persistent date col; current-stage PCNs only):
--    DO_NOT_ISSUE_NFA         sub=100000001   9,377 rows
--    CLAIM_ISSUANCE           sub=860620007  76,041 rows
--    CLAIM_ISSUED_NFA         sub=860620002   2,768 rows
--    LEGAL_1_DNI_UNDER_REVIEW sub=860620001       1 row
--    POST_CCJ                 sub=800013         61 rows
--    POST_CCJ_REMINDER        sub=800014      1,467 rows
--    POST_CCJ_WP_OFFER        sub=800017     23,784 rows
--    POST_CCJ_DR              sub=800018     64,410 rows
--    POST_CCJ_DR_SENT         sub=800015     16,024 rows
--    POST_CCJ_DR_RETURNED     sub=800016      3,865 rows
--
--  ccp_incidentdetail REMOVED: ccp_postccjdrsenton 75.85% null,
--    ccp_postccjdrreturnedon 100% null → substage fallback used instead.
--  DUE_CCJ sub=860620005: 0 records in incident AND ccp_caseaudit → excluded.
-- =========================================================================

WITH site_lookup AS (

    SELECT
        LOWER(CAST(ccp_siteid AS VARCHAR(36))) AS ccp_siteid,
        CAST(ccp_sitenumber AS VARCHAR(50))     AS site_number
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }}
    WHERE ccp_siteid IS NOT NULL

),

pcn AS (

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- One row per PCN -- identifiers, financials, PCN-level flags.
-- Joined onto every stage-event row in the final SELECT.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        LOWER(CAST(i.incidentid          AS VARCHAR(36)))               AS incidentid,
        i.ccp_ticketno                                                  AS pcn_id,
        s.site_number                                                   AS site_id,
        LOWER(CAST(i.ccp_site            AS VARCHAR(36)))               AS site_guid,
        CAST(i.ccp_siteticketpriceid     AS VARCHAR(36))                AS fine_id,
        CAST(ccp_dateofviolation AS DATE)                               AS issue_date,
        CAST(ccp_currentticketprice    AS DECIMAL(18, 2))               AS total_payment_amount,
        CAST(COALESCE(ccp_totalamountpaid, 0.00) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))    AS cash_at_stage,
        CAST(ccp_totalamountpaid       AS DECIMAL(18, 2))               AS amount_paid,

        -- Current PCN status (same value on every event row for this PCN)
        CAST(
            CASE statuscode
                WHEN 6          THEN 'Cancelled'
                WHEN 765440000  THEN 'New'
                WHEN 860620000  THEN 'Resolved'
                WHEN 860620002  THEN 'Fully Paid'
                WHEN 860620003  THEN 'Live/Partially Paid'
                WHEN 860620004  THEN 'Waiting for External response'
                WHEN 860620006  THEN 'No Response - Action required'
                WHEN 860620007  THEN 'External Response Received'
                WHEN 860620008  THEN 'Internal Response Received'
                WHEN 860620009  THEN 'Live'
                WHEN 860620010  THEN 'Outstanding'
                WHEN 860620011  THEN 'Appeal Accepted'
                WHEN 860620017  THEN 'Acknowledgement Sent'
                WHEN 860620018  THEN 'Live - Manual Discount'
                WHEN 860620020  THEN 'Live - Appeals'
                WHEN 860620023  THEN 'Live - Appeal Discount'
                WHEN 860620025  THEN 'Live - Gone Away'
                WHEN 860620026  THEN 'Live - Breathing Space'
                WHEN 860620031  THEN 'Live-Legal Appeal'
                ELSE NULL
            END
        AS VARCHAR(100))                                                AS statuscodename,

        -- is_live: 1 = PCN still active (not in a terminal status)
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN statuscode IN (6, 860620000, 860620002, 860620011)
                THEN 0 ELSE 1
            END
        AS BIT)                                                         AS is_live,

        -- PCN-level "ever sent" flags (BUG FIX 2026-09-17: old reached_flag
        -- returned NULL for tickets that had progressed past the reminder
        -- stage, undercounting 1st-reminder sends by >50% for Oct 2024 cohort.
        -- These flags read directly from confirmation fields regardless of
        -- current stage.)
        CAST(CASE WHEN ccp_firstremindersent  = 1
                    OR ccp_firstremindersenton  IS NOT NULL
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)                            AS ever_sent_first_reminder_flag,
        CAST(CASE WHEN ccp_secondremindersent = 1
                    OR ccp_secondremindersenton IS NOT NULL
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)                            AS ever_sent_second_reminder_flag,
        CAST(CASE WHEN ccp_thirdremindersent  = 1
                    OR ccp_thirdremindersenton  IS NOT NULL
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)                            AS ever_sent_third_reminder_flag,

        -- Confirmed 2026-09-17 against client's Staging.viewFactTicketsSCD2:
        -- ccp_debtrecover1stplacementon and ccp_lbasentdate are the canonical
        -- source fields for these two stages.
        CAST(CASE WHEN ccp_debtrecover1stplacementon IS NOT NULL
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)                            AS ever_sent_1st_placement_flag,
        CAST(CASE WHEN ccp_lbasentdate IS NOT NULL
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)                            AS ever_sent_lba_flag,

        CAST(
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(ccp_totalamountpaid, 0) > 0
                   OR statuscode = 860620002
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        AS BIT)                                                         AS paid_at_stage_flag

    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }} i
    LEFT JOIN site_lookup s
        ON LOWER(CAST(i.ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36))) = s.ccp_siteid
    WHERE i.ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND i.ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'

),

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DUE_TRACING: earliest trace outcome per PCN from ccp_recordtracingoutcomes.
-- Changed from ccp_tracingexportedon (7,505 rows, 2-week Jun 2026 window) →
-- 719,787 PCNs back to Jun 2025. One row per PCN (MIN = stage entry date).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
tracing_first AS (

    SELECT
        LOWER(CAST(rt.ccp_ticketno AS VARCHAR(36)))                     AS incidentid,
        CAST(MIN(rt.ccp_recordtracedon) AS DATE)                        AS stage_date
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_recordtracingoutcomes') }} rt
    INNER JOIN {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }} i
        ON LOWER(CAST(rt.ccp_ticketno AS VARCHAR(36)))
         = LOWER(CAST(i.incidentid    AS VARCHAR(36)))
    WHERE i.ccp_casetype        = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND rt.ccp_recordtracedon IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY LOWER(CAST(rt.ccp_ticketno AS VARCHAR(36)))

),

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CCJ_OBTAINED: earliest accepted judgment per PCN from ccp_judgmentupdates.
-- Changed from substage 800012 (63 current-only rows) →
-- ccp_judgmentupdates WHERE ccp_type='Accepted' (49,022 rows, 2019+).
-- All rows single source (860620000). MIN deduplicates NEW + UPDATED rows.
-- Join: ccp_pcn = incident.ccp_ticketno (text; 99.4% match confirmed).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ccj_first AS (

    SELECT
        LOWER(CAST(i.incidentid AS VARCHAR(36)))                        AS incidentid,
        CAST(MIN(ju.ccp_judgmentdate) AS DATE)                          AS stage_date
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_judgmentupdates') }} ju
    INNER JOIN {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }} i
        ON ju.ccp_pcn = i.ccp_ticketno
    WHERE i.ccp_casetype     = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ju.ccp_type        = 'Accepted'
      AND ju.ccp_judgmentdate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY LOWER(CAST(i.incidentid AS VARCHAR(36)))

),

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ALL STAGE EVENTS: one block per lifecycle stage.
-- Columns: incidentid, stage_key, stage_name, stage_date.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
all_stage_events AS (

    -- 1. PCN_ISSUANCE
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))) AS incidentid,
           'PCN_ISSUANCE'  AS stage_key,
           'PCN Issuance'  AS stage_name,
           CAST(createdon AS DATE) AS stage_date
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND createdon     IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 2. FIRST_REMINDER
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'FIRST_REMINDER', 'First Reminder',
           CAST(ccp_firstremindersenton AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_firstremindersenton IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 3. SECOND_REMINDER
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'SECOND_REMINDER', 'Second Reminder',
           CAST(ccp_secondremindersenton AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_secondremindersenton IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 4. THIRD_REMINDER
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'THIRD_REMINDER', 'Third Reminder',
           CAST(ccp_thirdremindersenton AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_thirdremindersenton IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 5. LBA
    -- Canonical source: incident.ccp_lbasentdate (client-confirmed, 2018+).
    -- ccp_lbaletters has 100% join rate but only starts Jun 2025.
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'LBA', 'LBA',
           CAST(ccp_lbasentdate AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_lbasentdate IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 6. LBA_REMINDER
    -- Source: ccp_lbaletters WHERE lbatype IN (860620002 New Address,
    -- 860620003 New Address Fast-tracked). Jun 2025+ only (no earlier source).
    -- One row per letter sent per PCN.
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(i.incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'LBA_REMINDER', 'LBA Reminder',
           CAST(l.ccp_lbasenton AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }} i
    INNER JOIN {{ ref('ccp_lbaletters') }} l
        ON LOWER(CAST(l.ccp_pcn AS VARCHAR(36)))
         = LOWER(CAST(i.incidentid AS VARCHAR(36)))
    WHERE i.ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND i.ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND l.ccp_lbatype   IN (860620002, 860620003)
      AND l.ccp_lbasenton IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 7. AT_POPLA
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'AT_POPLA', 'At POPLA',
           CAST(COALESCE(ccp_atpopladatetime, ccp_poplasubmitteddate) AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND (ccp_atpopladatetime IS NOT NULL OR ccp_poplasubmitteddate IS NOT NULL)

    UNION ALL

    -- 8. AFTER_POPLA
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'AFTER_POPLA', 'After POPLA',
           CAST(ccp_popladecisiondate AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_popladecisiondate IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 9. POPLA_WITHDRAWN
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'POPLA_WITHDRAWN', 'POPLA Withdrawn',
           CAST(ccp_poplawithdrawaldate AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_poplawithdrawaldate IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 10. DUE_TRACING (via tracing_first pre-agg CTE)
    SELECT t.incidentid, 'DUE_TRACING', 'Due Tracing', t.stage_date
    FROM tracing_first t

    UNION ALL

    -- 11. BREATHING_SPACE
    -- No dedicated date col. modifiedon used as proxy. 2 active records only.
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'BREATHING_SPACE', 'Breathing Space',
           CAST(modifiedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND statuscode    = 860620026

    UNION ALL

    -- 12. DO_NOT_ISSUE_NFA
    -- ccp_dniprocesseddate was 100% null. Substage fallback (9,377 rows).
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'DO_NOT_ISSUE_NFA', 'Do Not Issue - No Further Action',
           CAST(ccp_slasubstagechangedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_substage  = 100000001
      AND ccp_slasubstagechangedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 13. LEGAL_1_DNI_UNDER_REVIEW  (1 record; substage fallback)
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'LEGAL_1_DNI_UNDER_REVIEW', 'Legal 1 - Do Not Issue - Under Review',
           CAST(ccp_slasubstagechangedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_substage  = 860620001
      AND ccp_slasubstagechangedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 14. DNI_DR_SENT
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'DNI_DR_SENT', 'DNI - DR Sent',
           CAST(ccp_dcblegalsenton AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_dcblegalsenton IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 15. DNI_DR_RETURNED
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'DNI_DR_RETURNED', 'DNI - DR Returned',
           CAST(ccp_dcblegalreturnedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_dcblegalreturnedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 16. DR_1ST_PLACEMENT_SENT
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'DR_1ST_PLACEMENT_SENT', 'Debt Recovery 1st Placement Sent',
           CAST(ccp_debtrecover1stplacementon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_debtrecover1stplacementon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 17. DR_1ST_PLACEMENT_RETURNED
    -- Date col (23,403) beats substage 800007 (16,621 current-only).
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'DR_1ST_PLACEMENT_RETURNED', 'Debt Recovery 1st Placement Returned',
           CAST(ccp_dr1stplacementreturnedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_dr1stplacementreturnedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 18. CLAIM_ISSUANCE
    -- ccp_claimrequesteddate was 100% null. Substage fallback (76,041 rows).
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'CLAIM_ISSUANCE', 'Claim Issuance',
           CAST(ccp_slasubstagechangedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_substage  = 860620007
      AND ccp_slasubstagechangedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 19. EXTERNAL_CLAIM_ISSUED
    -- ccp_claimupdates WHERE type='Claim N1CPC issued'. Text join on
    -- ccp_pcn = incident.ccp_ticketno (99.4% match confirmed).
    -- ccp_zeusclaimcreationdate is 50.15% null → only non-null rows land.
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(i.incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'EXTERNAL_CLAIM_ISSUED', 'External Claim Issued',
           CAST(cu.ccp_zeusclaimcreationdate AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }} i
    INNER JOIN {{ ref('ccp_claimupdates') }} cu
        ON cu.ccp_pcn = i.ccp_ticketno
    WHERE i.ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND i.ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND cu.ccp_type     = 'Claim N1CPC issued'
      AND cu.ccp_zeusclaimcreationdate IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 20. INTERNAL_CLAIM_ISSUED
    -- PCNs with ccp_claimissuedate but no matching N1CPC row (42 records).
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(i.incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'INTERNAL_CLAIM_ISSUED', 'Internal Claim Issued',
           CAST(i.ccp_claimissuedate AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }} i
    WHERE i.ccp_ticketno      IS NOT NULL
      AND i.ccp_casetype       = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND i.ccp_claimissuedate IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('ccp_claimupdates') }} cu
          WHERE cu.ccp_pcn  = i.ccp_ticketno
            AND cu.ccp_type = 'Claim N1CPC issued'
      )

    UNION ALL

    -- 21. CLAIM_ISSUED_NFA  (substage fallback; 2,768 rows)
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'CLAIM_ISSUED_NFA', 'CLAIM ISSUED - NFA',
           CAST(ccp_slasubstagechangedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_substage  = 860620002
      AND ccp_slasubstagechangedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 22. CCJ_OBTAINED (via ccj_first pre-agg CTE)
    -- Changed from substage 800012 (63 rows) → ccp_judgmentupdates (49,022 rows).
    SELECT c.incidentid, 'CCJ_OBTAINED', 'CCJ Obtained', c.stage_date
    FROM ccj_first c

    UNION ALL

    -- 23. POST_CCJ
    -- ccp_ccjlettersentdate was 100% null. Substage fallback (61 rows).
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'POST_CCJ', 'Post CCJ',
           CAST(ccp_slasubstagechangedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_substage  = 800013
      AND ccp_slasubstagechangedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 24. POST_CCJ_REMINDER
    -- ccp_ccjreminderlettersentdate was 100% null. Substage fallback (1,467 rows).
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'POST_CCJ_REMINDER', 'Post CCJ Reminder',
           CAST(ccp_slasubstagechangedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_substage  = 800014
      AND ccp_slasubstagechangedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 25. POST_CCJ_WP_OFFER  (substage fallback; 23,784 rows)
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'POST_CCJ_WP_OFFER', 'Post CCJ WP Offer',
           CAST(ccp_slasubstagechangedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_substage  = 800017
      AND ccp_slasubstagechangedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 26. POST_CCJ_DR  (substage fallback; 64,410 rows)
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'POST_CCJ_DR', 'Post CCJ Debt Recovery',
           CAST(ccp_slasubstagechangedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_substage  = 800018
      AND ccp_slasubstagechangedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 27. POST_CCJ_DR_SENT
    -- ccp_incidentdetail.ccp_postccjdrsenton was 75.85% null (8,869 usable).
    -- Substage fallback (16,024 rows).
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'POST_CCJ_DR_SENT', 'Post CCJ Debt Recovery Sent',
           CAST(ccp_slasubstagechangedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_substage  = 800015
      AND ccp_slasubstagechangedon IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 28. POST_CCJ_DR_RETURNED
    -- ccp_incidentdetail.ccp_postccjdrreturnedon was 100% null.
    -- Substage fallback (3,865 rows).
    SELECT LOWER(CAST(incidentid AS VARCHAR(36))),
           'POST_CCJ_DR_RETURNED', 'Post CCJ Debt Recovery Returned',
           CAST(ccp_slasubstagechangedon AS DATE)
    FROM {{ ref('int_incident_deduped') }}
    WHERE ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
      AND ccp_casetype  = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND ccp_substage  = 800016
      AND ccp_slasubstagechangedon IS NOT NULL

    -- DUE_CCJ (sub=860620005): 0 records in incident AND ccp_caseaudit. Excluded.

),

lifecycle AS (

    SELECT
        e.incidentid,
        e.stage_key,
        e.stage_name,
        e.stage_date,
        p.pcn_id,
        p.site_id,
        p.site_guid,
        p.fine_id,
        p.issue_date,
        p.total_payment_amount,
        p.cash_at_stage,
        p.amount_paid,
        p.statuscodename,
        p.is_live,
        p.paid_at_stage_flag,
        p.ever_sent_first_reminder_flag,
        p.ever_sent_second_reminder_flag,
        p.ever_sent_third_reminder_flag,
        p.ever_sent_1st_placement_flag,
        p.ever_sent_lba_flag,

        -- reached_flag: 1 for every row. Presence of a row means this stage
        -- was reached (each UNION ALL block filters on IS NOT NULL / join success).
        -- Retained for backward compatibility. Old design's bug (NULL for tickets
        -- that progressed past a reminder stage) is resolved by the new grain.
        CAST(1 AS BIT)                                                  AS reached_flag,

        LEAD(e.stage_key) OVER (
            PARTITION BY e.incidentid ORDER BY e.stage_date, e.stage_key
        )                                                               AS next_lifecycle_stage,

        LEAD(e.stage_date) OVER (
            PARTITION BY e.incidentid ORDER BY e.stage_date, e.stage_key
        )                                                               AS next_stage_start_date

    FROM all_stage_events e
    INNER JOIN pcn p ON e.incidentid = p.incidentid

),

discount AS (

    -- Stage-aware discount: keep one row per discount/surcharge transaction
    -- with its transaction date so it can be matched to the lifecycle stage
    -- whose date window contains it.
    --
    -- Date source: ccp_validfromdate is the canonical "when this discount was
    -- applied" date; COALESCE to createdon as fallback when NULL (consistent
    -- with core_claims.sql ordering logic).
    --
    -- =========================================================================
    -- CONFIRMED 2026-09-23 (diagnostic queries run against live source):
    --
    --  UNIT:  ccp_amount is in GBP (£), NOT pence. No /100 conversion needed.
    --         Amount By Value avg = -£12.87; Surcharge avg = +£67.17.
    --
    --  SEMANTICS (confirmed by: tds_current_price + ccp_amount = adjusted_price):
    --    ccp_currentticketprice   = original PCN price BEFORE the discount/surcharge
    --    ccp_amount               = GBP delta (negative = reduces price; positive = adds cost)
    --    ccp_adjustedticketprice  = price AFTER applying the discount/surcharge
    --
    --  TYPES:
    --    860620001  Amount By Value      → ccp_amount = direct £ discount value (negative)
    --                                     1,986,417 rows; avg -£12.87
    --    860620003  Surcharge            → ccp_amount = £ surcharge added (positive)
    --                                     1,400,910 rows; avg +£67.17
    --                                     Large values (e.g. £2,538) = court cost additions
    --    860620000  Amount By Percentage → ccp_amount = pre-calculated £ value of pct discount
    --                                     ccp_percentageplaceholder = the % rate (e.g. 50)
    --                                     formula: ccp_amount = -(current × pct/100)
    --                                     Only 3 rows in live data; included for completeness
    --    860620002  Amount To Value      → EXCLUDED: avg ~£2.4M/row — not money in same
    --                                     unit; confirmed these are not discounts
    --    NULL type                       → EXCLUDED: 75,862 rows, avg -£40.03 but no type
    --                                     code so cannot be classified as discount or
