    --                                     surcharge. NULL <> 860620002 evaluates to NULL
    --                                     (falsy) in T-SQL so the WHERE below excludes them.
    -- =========================================================================
    SELECT
        LOWER(CAST(ccp_incidentid AS VARCHAR(36)))                      AS incidentid,
        CAST(COALESCE(ccp_validfromdate, createdon) AS DATE)            AS discount_date,
        CAST(ccp_amount AS DECIMAL(18, 2))                              AS trx_amount,
        CAST(
            CASE ccp_discountsurchargetype
                WHEN 860620001 THEN 'Amount By Value'
                WHEN 860620003 THEN 'Surcharge'
                WHEN 860620000 THEN 'Amount By Percentage'
                ELSE NULL
            END
        AS VARCHAR(50))                                                 AS discount_surcharge_type
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_ticketdiscountsurcharge') }}
    WHERE ccp_incidentid IS NOT NULL
      -- Exclude Amount To Value (wrong unit) and NULL-type rows (unclassifiable)
      AND ccp_discountsurchargetype <> 860620002

)


SELECT
    -- =========================================================================
    -- 1. REPORTING LAYER COLUMNS
    -- =========================================================================
    l.pcn_id,
    l.site_id,
    l.site_guid,
    l.stage_key,
    l.stage_name,
    l.stage_date,
    l.issue_date,
    l.reached_flag,
    l.ever_sent_first_reminder_flag,
    l.ever_sent_second_reminder_flag,
    l.ever_sent_third_reminder_flag,
    l.ever_sent_1st_placement_flag,
    l.ever_sent_lba_flag,
    l.paid_at_stage_flag,
    l.cash_at_stage,

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 2. EXTENDED CORE ATTRIBUTES
    -- =========================================================================
    l.fine_id,
    l.total_payment_amount,
    l.amount_paid,
    l.statuscodename,
    l.is_live,

    l.stage_date                                                        AS stage_start_date,
    CASE
        WHEN l.next_lifecycle_stage IS NOT NULL
         AND l.next_lifecycle_stage <> l.stage_key
        THEN l.next_stage_start_date
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                                 AS stage_end_date,

    -- Stage-aware discount: only discounts whose transaction date falls within
    -- this stage's time window are counted here.
    --   Window = [stage_date, next_stage_start_date)  for non-terminal stages
    --            [stage_date, ∞)                      for the terminal stage
    --                                                 (next_stage_start_date IS NULL)
    -- This mirrors how int_payment.sql uses ccp_transactiondate to assign
    -- payments to the stage where cash actually moved.
    --
    -- BUG FIX 2026-09-23: discount_flag previously used COUNT(d.discount_date)
    -- which fired on ANY matched row — including Surcharge-only rows — causing
    -- discount_flag=1 while discount_amount=NULL (no Amount By Value rows in the
    -- window). Fixed: both discount_flag and discount_amount now use the same
    -- type filter. surcharge_flag added separately for Surcharge-type rows.
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN COUNT(
            CASE WHEN d.discount_surcharge_type IN ('Amount By Value', 'Amount By Percentage')
                 THEN 1 END
        ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    AS BIT)                                                             AS discount_flag,

    CAST(SUM(
        CASE WHEN d.discount_surcharge_type IN ('Amount By Value', 'Amount By Percentage')
             THEN d.trx_amount ELSE NULL END
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))                                                AS discount_amount,

    -- surcharge_flag: 1 if any Surcharge-type row fell within this stage window
    -- (court costs, penalty additions). Separate from discount_flag.
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN COUNT(
            CASE WHEN d.discount_surcharge_type = 'Surcharge' THEN 1 END
        ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    AS BIT)                                                             AS surcharge_flag,

    CAST(SUM(
        CASE WHEN d.discount_surcharge_type = 'Surcharge'
             THEN d.trx_amount ELSE NULL END
    ) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))                                                AS surcharge_amount

FROM lifecycle l
LEFT JOIN discount d
    ON  d.incidentid = l.incidentid
    AND d.discount_date >= l.stage_date
    AND (
        -- Non-terminal stage: discount date must be before the next stage starts
        l.next_stage_start_date IS NULL
        OR d.discount_date < l.next_stage_start_date
    )
GROUP BY
    l.incidentid,
    l.pcn_id,
    l.site_id,
    l.site_guid,
    l.stage_key,
    l.stage_name,
    l.stage_date,
    l.issue_date,
    l.reached_flag,
    l.ever_sent_first_reminder_flag,
    l.ever_sent_second_reminder_flag,
    l.ever_sent_third_reminder_flag,
    l.ever_sent_1st_placement_flag,
    l.ever_sent_lba_flag,
    l.paid_at_stage_flag,
    l.cash_at_stage,
    l.fine_id,
    l.total_payment_amount,
    l.amount_paid,
    l.statuscodename,
    l.is_live,
    l.next_lifecycle_stage,
    l.next_stage_start_date;

model.ccp.core_pv.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    alias='core_pv',
    tags=['core', 'live', 'core_pv']
) }}

WITH inhouse_records AS (
    SELECT
        stage2_plates_id,
        violation_type,
        entryPlateId,
        exitPlateId,
        source_screen
    FROM {{ ref('records_presented_to_in_house') }}
    
    UNION ALL 
    
    SELECT
        stage2_plates_id,
        violation_type,
        entryPlateId,
        exitPlateId,
        source_screen
    FROM {{ ref('records_presented_to_in_house_archive') }}

),

ranked_inhouse AS (
    SELECT
        stage2_plates_id,
        violation_type,
        entryPlateId,
        exitPlateId,
        source_screen,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY stage2_plates_id
            ORDER BY stage2_plates_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM inhouse_records
),

potential_violation AS (
    SELECT
        pv.ccp_potentialviolationid AS pv_id,
        pv.ccp_sitenumber AS site_id,
        r.stage2_plates_id AS inhouse_review_id,
        CAST(pv.ccp_dateofviolation AS DATE) AS pv_date,
        r.entryPlateId AS stream1_id,
        r.exitPlateId AS stream2_id,
        pv.ccp_polusreference as pair_id,
        CASE
            WHEN r.source_screen = 'Clean Pair' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS clean_pair_flag,
        r.violation_type AS match_type
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_potentialviolation') }} AS pv
    LEFT JOIN ranked_inhouse AS r
        -- Note: Changed NVARCHAR to VARCHAR here to prevent Fabric distribution errors
        ON CAST(pv.ccp_polusreference AS VARCHAR(100)) = CAST(r.stage2_plates_id AS VARCHAR(100))
        AND r.rn = 1
),

-- New CTE extracting the SV/MV logic based on incident/ticket counts per vehicle and driver
sv_mv_calc AS (
    SELECT
        ccp_vehicleregistration,
        ccp_driverid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT incidentid) AS NoOfTickets
    FROM {{ ref('incident') }}
    WHERE ccp_casetype = '52b0ef4d-2043-ee11-bdf3-0022481ab71c'
      AND statecode = 0
      AND statuscode NOT IN (860620002, 860620003, 6)
    GROUP BY
        ccp_vehicleregistration,
        ccp_driverid
),

incident_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ccp_potentialviolation,
        ccp_vehicleregistration,
        ccp_driverid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LOWER(CAST(ccp_potentialviolation AS VARCHAR(100)))
            ORDER BY createdon DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('incident') }}
    WHERE ccp_potentialviolation IS NOT NULL 
     
),

final_data AS (
    SELECT
        pv.pv_id,
        pv.site_id,
        pv.inhouse_review_id,
        pv.pv_date,
        pv.stream1_id,
        pv.stream2_id,
        pv.clean_pair_flag,
        pv.match_type,
        pv.pair_id,

        -- Applied the dynamic SV/MV threshold logic
        CASE
            WHEN sm.NoOfTickets <= 4 THEN 'SV'
            WHEN sm.NoOfTickets > 4 THEN 'MV'
            ELSE 'SV'
        END AS violator_type,

        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(pv.match_type))) IN ('FUZZY', 'FUZZYNOPARK') THEN 'FUZZY'
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(pv.match_type))) IN ('OVERNIGHT', 'OVERSTAY', 'NOPARK') THEN 'Non-FUZZY'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fuzzy_flag,

        CASE
            WHEN i.ccp_potentialviolation IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)
            ELSE CAST(0 AS BIT)
        END AS pcn_issued_flag

    FROM potential_violation AS pv
    LEFT JOIN incident_ranked AS i
        ON LOWER(CAST(pv.pv_id AS VARCHAR(100))) = LOWER(CAST(i.ccp_potentialviolation AS VARCHAR(100)))
        AND i.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN sv_mv_calc AS sm
        ON i.ccp_vehicleregistration = sm.ccp_vehicleregistration
        AND i.ccp_driverid = sm.ccp_driverid
),

-- Wrap the type_label creation in a CTE so it can be referenced downstream
labeled_data AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN fuzzy_flag = 'Non-FUZZY' AND violator_type = 'SV' THEN 'Non-fuzzy SV'
            WHEN fuzzy_flag = 'FUZZY' AND violator_type = 'SV' THEN 'Fuzzy SV'
            WHEN fuzzy_flag = 'Non-FUZZY' AND violator_type = 'MV' THEN 'Non-fuzzy MV'
            WHEN fuzzy_flag = 'FUZZY' AND violator_type = 'MV' THEN 'Fuzzy MV'
            ELSE NULL
        END as type_label
    FROM final_data
)

SELECT
    *,
    CONVERT(
        VARCHAR(32),
        HASHBYTES(
            'MD5',
            CONCAT(
                UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(violator_type))),
                '|',
                UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(match_type)))
            )
        ),
        2
    ) AS violation_type_key
FROM labeled_data
