model.ccp.core_site_lifecycle.raw_code:
{{ config(
    alias = 'core_site_lifecycle',
    tags  = ['core', 'live', 'core_site_lifecycle']
) }}

-- =========================================================================
-- Entity: core_site_lifecycle / fact_site_event
-- Grain : 1 row per site lifecycle milestone / status transition / blackout event
-- Sources: ccp_siteaudit (milestones) UNION ALL ccp_blackout (suspensions)
-- =========================================================================

WITH site AS (

    SELECT
        LOWER(CAST(ccp_siteid AS VARCHAR(36)))                          AS ccp_siteid,
        ccp_sitenumber,
        ccp_accountid,
        ccp_totalnumberofspaces,
        CASE ccp_sitetier
            WHEN 860620000 THEN 'Platinum'
            WHEN 860620001 THEN 'Gold'
            WHEN 860620002 THEN 'Silver'
            WHEN 860620003 THEN 'Bronze'
            WHEN 860620004 THEN 'Low Performer'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ccp_sitetiername,
        CASE ccp_typeofpcnshare
            WHEN 860620000 THEN 'Gross Profit Share'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ccp_typeofpcnsharename,
        ccp_valueofpcnshare,
        ccp_sitepcncancellationallowance,
        CASE statuscode
            WHEN 1 THEN 'New'
            WHEN 765440001 THEN 'Awaiting survey'
            WHEN 765440002 THEN 'Booked for Install'
            WHEN 765440004 THEN 'Installed'
            WHEN 765440005 THEN 'Live - Operational'
            WHEN 765440007 THEN 'Surveyed -Not booked for install'
            WHEN 765440008 THEN 'On Hold'
            WHEN 765440010 THEN 'Not Approved Commercially'
            WHEN 765440011 THEN 'Cancelled at Survey'
            WHEN 765440012 THEN 'Customer change of mind'
            WHEN 765440013 THEN 'Cancelled at Install'
            WHEN 765440016 THEN 'Lost - Site Sold/ Change of Ownership'
            WHEN 765440017 THEN 'Lost - Client claiming reputational damage'
            WHEN 765440018 THEN 'Lost - Client in Liquidation/ administration'
            WHEN 765440019 THEN 'Lost - Client lease ended'
            WHEN 765440020 THEN 'Lost - Commercial buy out of agreement by client'
            WHEN 765440021 THEN 'Lost - Devt site/site closed/site sold'
            WHEN 765440022 THEN 'Lost - Early termination agreed'
            WHEN 765440023 THEN 'Lost - End of agreement – notice served'
            WHEN 765440024 THEN 'Lost - Internal Commercial decision to exit'
            WHEN 765440025 THEN 'Lost - Lease surrendered to landlord'
            WHEN 765440026 THEN 'Lost - Legal Dispute with client/ landowner'
            WHEN 765440028 THEN 'Lost - due to proposition shortfall'
            WHEN 765440029 THEN 'Lost - due to service levels'
            WHEN 765440030 THEN 'Lost - to competitor'
            WHEN 765440031 THEN 'Lost - Persistent abuse/ vandalism'
            WHEN 765440032 THEN 'Lost - Site Redevelopment'
            WHEN 860620001 THEN 'Uninstalled'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS statuscodename,
        ccp_ownernewname,
        ccp_sitetariff,
        ccp_sitesettlementamount,
        ccp_businesscategorylookupname,
        
        -- Safe String Casting to prevent "Yes" conversion to INT errors
        CASE CAST(ccp_touchscreenskiosk AS VARCHAR(50))
            WHEN '765440000' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN '765440001' THEN 'No'
            WHEN '1' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN '0' THEN 'No'
            WHEN 'Yes' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN 'No' THEN 'No'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ccp_touchscreenskioskname,
        
        CASE CAST(ccp_paymentmachine AS VARCHAR(50))
            WHEN '765440000' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN '765440001' THEN 'No'
            WHEN '1' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN '0' THEN 'No'
            WHEN 'Yes' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN 'No' THEN 'No'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ccp_paymentmachinename,
        
        CASE CAST(ccp_ringgo AS VARCHAR(50))
            WHEN '765440000' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN '765440001' THEN 'No'
            WHEN '1' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN '0' THEN 'No'
            WHEN 'Yes' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN 'No' THEN 'No'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ccp_ringgoname,
        
        CASE CAST(ccp_justpark AS VARCHAR(50))
            WHEN '765440000' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN '765440001' THEN 'No'
            WHEN '1' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN '0' THEN 'No'
            WHEN 'Yes' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN 'No' THEN 'No'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ccp_justparkname,
        
        CASE CAST(ccp_tablets AS VARCHAR(50))
            WHEN '765440000' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN '765440001' THEN 'No'
            WHEN '1' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN '0' THEN 'No'
            WHEN 'Yes' THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN 'No' THEN 'No'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ccp_tabletsname
        
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }}
    WHERE ccp_siteid IS NOT NULL

),

-- Latest active contract per site
entitlement_ranked AS (

    SELECT
        entitlementid,
        LOWER(CAST(ccp_siteid AS VARCHAR(36)))                          AS ccp_siteid,
        CASE ccp_contracttype
            WHEN 765440000 THEN 'Auto-renewal'
            WHEN 765440001 THEN 'Continued until notice served'
            WHEN 765440002 THEN 'Fixed Term'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ccp_contracttypename,
        startdate,
        enddate,
        ccp_contractterms,
        ccp_contracttermsperiod,
        ccp_finalnoticedeadline,
        statecode,
        modifiedon,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LOWER(CAST(ccp_siteid AS VARCHAR(36)))
            ORDER BY statecode ASC, modifiedon DESC, startdate DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('entitlement') }}
    WHERE ccp_siteid IS NOT NULL

),

entitlement AS (

    SELECT
        entitlementid,
        ccp_siteid,
        ccp_contracttypename,
        startdate,
        enddate,
        ccp_contractterms,
        ccp_contracttermsperiod,
        ccp_finalnoticedeadline
    FROM entitlement_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),

-- Latest enforcement rule per site
site_rule_ranked AS (

    SELECT
        ccp_siteruleid,
        LOWER(CAST(ccp_site_siterule AS VARCHAR(36)))                   AS ccp_site_siterule,
        ccp_site_siterulename,
        ccp_enforcementmodelname,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LOWER(CAST(ccp_site_siterule AS VARCHAR(36))) 
            ORDER BY modifiedon DESC, createdon DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_siterule') }}
    WHERE ccp_site_siterule IS NOT NULL

),

site_rule AS (

    SELECT
        ccp_site_siterule,
        ccp_enforcementmodelname,
        ccp_site_siterulename
    FROM site_rule_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1

),

-- Latest camera asset per site
site_camera_ranked AS (

    SELECT
        LOWER(CAST(ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36)))                            AS ccp_site,
        ccp_typeofcameraname,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LOWER(CAST(ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36))) 
            ORDER BY modifiedon DESC, createdon DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_sitecamera') }}
    WHERE ccp_site IS NOT NULL

),

site_camera AS (

    SELECT
        ccp_site,
        ccp_typeofcameraname
    FROM site_camera_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1

),

-- Combined Event Stream: Site Status Audits + Blackout Suspensions
all_events AS (

    -- 1. Site Status Transitions / Milestone Audits
    SELECT
        CAST(sa.ccp_siteauditid AS VARCHAR(36))                         AS site_lifecycle_id,
        LOWER(CAST(sa.ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36)))                         AS site_id,
        CAST(sa.ccp_changedon AS DATE)                                      AS event_date,
        CAST(sa.ccp_changedon AS DATETIME2(6))                              AS event_timestamp,
        
        -- Event Milestone Type
        CASE 
            WHEN CHARINDEX('-', sa.ccp_newvalue) > 0 
            THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sa.ccp_newvalue, 1, CHARINDEX('-', sa.ccp_newvalue) - 1)))
            ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(sa.ccp_newvalue))
        END                                                             AS event_type,

        0                                                               AS is_blackout_flag,
        0                                                               AS blackout_days_count,
        CAST(NULL AS DATE)                                              AS blackout_end_date,

        -- Churn Classification
        CASE 
            WHEN sa.ccp_newvalue LIKE 'Lost%' THEN
                CASE 
                    WHEN sa.ccp_newvalue LIKE '%Internal Commercial decision%' 
                    THEN 'Non Regrettable Loss'
                    ELSE 'Regrettable Loss'
                END
            ELSE 'NOT LOST'
        END                                                             AS churn_type,

        CASE 
            WHEN sa.ccp_newvalue LIKE 'Lost%' AND CHARINDEX('-', sa.ccp_newvalue) > 0
            THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(sa.ccp_newvalue, CHARINDEX('-', sa.ccp_newvalue) + 1, LEN(sa.ccp_newvalue))))
            ELSE NULL
        END                                                             AS churn_reason,

        CASE 
            WHEN sa.ccp_newvalue LIKE 'Lost%' THEN
                CASE 
                    WHEN sa.ccp_newvalue LIKE '%Internal Commercial decision%' THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END
            ELSE 0
        END                                                             AS is_regrettable

    FROM {{ ref('ccp_siteaudit') }} AS sa
    WHERE sa.ccp_siteauditid IS NOT NULL 
      AND sa.ccp_site IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 2. Blackout Suspension Events
    SELECT
        CAST(b.ccp_blackoutid AS VARCHAR(36))                           AS site_lifecycle_id,
        LOWER(CAST(b.ccp_site AS VARCHAR(36)))                          AS site_id,
        CAST(b.ccp_fromdate AS DATE)                                    AS event_date,
        CAST(b.ccp_fromdate AS DATETIME2(6))                            AS event_timestamp,
        
        -- Event Type for Blackout
        CASE ccp_reason
            WHEN 765440000 THEN 'Tablet App fault'
            WHEN 765440001 THEN 'Payment machine fault'
            WHEN 765440002 THEN 'ANPR Camera fault'
            WHEN 765440003 THEN 'Partner Tech fault (YPS, JP, Startraq, etc)'
            WHEN 765440004 THEN 'Phone and Pay fault'
            WHEN 765440005 THEN 'QR code fault'
            WHEN 765440006 THEN 'CCTV / EV fault'
            WHEN 765440007 THEN 'Exemption Camera Fault'
            WHEN 765440008 THEN 'Kiosk Fault'
            WHEN 765440009 THEN 'Register reg web'
            WHEN 765440010 THEN 'Client event'
            WHEN 765440011 THEN 'Refurb'
            WHEN 765440012 THEN 'Client Complaint'
            WHEN 765440013 THEN 'Power issue'
            WHEN 765440014 THEN 'Assisting client'
            WHEN 765440015 THEN 'Bank Holiday'
            WHEN 765440016 THEN 'Change of terms'
            WHEN 765440017 THEN 'New install'
            WHEN 765440018 THEN 'Uninstall'
            WHEN 765440019 THEN 'Legal issue'
            WHEN 765440020 THEN 'Other'
            ELSE NULL
        END  AS event_type,

        1                                                               AS is_blackout_flag,
        
        -- Total duration of this blackout event
        DATEDIFF(
            day, 
            CAST(b.ccp_fromdate AS DATE), 
            CAST(COALESCE(b.ccp_todate, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) AS DATE)
        ) + 1                                                           AS blackout_days_count,

        CAST(COALESCE(b.ccp_todate, '2099-12-31') AS DATE)             AS blackout_end_date,

        'NOT LOST'                                                      AS churn_type,
        NULL                                                            AS churn_reason,
        0                                                               AS is_regrettable

    FROM {{ ref('ccp_blackout') }} AS b
    WHERE b.ccp_blackoutid IS NOT NULL 
      AND b.ccp_site IS NOT NULL

)

SELECT

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 1. REPORTING LAYER EVENT COLUMNS
    -- =========================================================================
    CAST(e_all.site_lifecycle_id AS VARCHAR(100))                       AS site_lifecycle_id,
    CAST(s.ccp_sitenumber AS VARCHAR(100))                              AS site_id,
    CAST(e_all.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                 AS site_guid,
    CAST(s.ccp_accountid AS VARCHAR(100))                               AS customer_id,
    CAST(e.entitlementid AS VARCHAR(100))                               AS contract_id,
    CAST(e.ccp_contracttypename AS VARCHAR(100))                         AS contract_type,

    -- Event & Milestone Attributes
    CAST(e_all.event_date AS DATE)                                      AS event_date,
    CAST(e_all.event_timestamp AS DATETIME2(6))                         AS event_timestamp,
    CAST(e_all.event_type AS VARCHAR(150))                              AS event_type,
    CAST(e_all.is_blackout_flag AS INT)                                 AS is_blackout_flag,
    CAST(e_all.blackout_days_count AS INT)                              AS blackout_days_count,
    CAST(e_all.blackout_end_date AS DATE)                               AS blackout_end_date,

    -- Active Contract Length in Years at time of event
    CASE 
        WHEN e.startdate IS NOT NULL AND e.enddate IS NOT NULL AND e.enddate > e.startdate AND YEAR(e.enddate) < 9000 
        THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(day, e.startdate, e.enddate) / 365.25 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
        WHEN e.ccp_contractterms IS NOT NULL AND e.ccp_contracttermsperiod = 765440001
        THEN CAST(e.ccp_contractterms AS DECIMAL(10,2))
        WHEN e.ccp_contractterms IS NOT NULL AND e.ccp_contracttermsperiod = 765440000
        THEN CAST(e.ccp_contractterms / 12.0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
        WHEN e.ccp_contractterms IS NOT NULL
        THEN CAST(e.ccp_contractterms / 12.0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))  -- fallback: assume months
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                                 AS contract_length_years,

    CAST(s.ccp_sitetiername AS VARCHAR(50))                             AS quality_tier_at_event,
    CAST(e_all.churn_type AS VARCHAR(100))                              AS churn_type,
    CAST(e_all.churn_reason AS VARCHAR(255))                            AS churn_reason,
    CAST(e_all.is_regrettable AS INT)                                   AS is_regrettable,

    -- =========================================================================
    -- 2. EXTENDED CORE SITE ATTRIBUTES
    -- =========================================================================
    CAST(s.ccp_totalnumberofspaces AS INT)                              AS spaces,
    CAST(e.startdate AS DATE)                                           AS contract_start_date,
    CAST(e.enddate AS DATE)                                             AS contract_end_date,
    CAST(e.ccp_finalnoticedeadline AS DATE)                             AS renewal_date,
    CAST(s.ccp_typeofpcnsharename AS VARCHAR(100))                       AS revenue_share_model,
    CAST(s.ccp_valueofpcnshare AS DECIMAL(5,2))                         AS revenue_share_pct,
    CAST(s.ccp_sitepcncancellationallowance AS INT)                     AS free_cancellation_limit,
    CAST(sr.ccp_enforcementmodelname AS VARCHAR(100))                    AS site_nature,
    CAST(sr.ccp_site_siterulename AS VARCHAR(100))                       AS site_rule_type,
    CAST(s.ccp_businesscategorylookupname AS VARCHAR(100))               AS business_category,
    CAST(s.statuscodename AS VARCHAR(100))                              AS processed_status,
    CAST(s.ccp_ownernewname AS VARCHAR(100))                            AS responsible_team,
    CAST(sc.ccp_typeofcameraname AS VARCHAR(100))                        AS site_technology,
    CAST(s.ccp_sitetariff AS VARCHAR(100))                               AS tariff_technology,
    CAST(s.ccp_sitesettlementamount AS DECIMAL(18,2))                   AS monthly_free_cancel_budget,

    -- Tablet / Payment Kiosk Type
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN s.ccp_touchscreenskioskname = 'Yes' THEN 'Touchscreen Kiosk'
            WHEN s.ccp_paymentmachinename    = 'Yes' THEN 'Payment Machine'
            WHEN s.ccp_ringgoname            = 'Yes' THEN 'RingGo'
            WHEN s.ccp_justparkname          = 'Yes' THEN 'JustPark'
            ELSE NULL
        END
    AS VARCHAR(100))                                                    AS tablet_type,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN s.ccp_touchscreenskioskname = 'Yes' THEN s.ccp_touchscreenskioskname
            WHEN s.ccp_tabletsname           = 'Yes' THEN s.ccp_tabletsname
            WHEN s.ccp_paymentmachinename    = 'Yes' THEN s.ccp_paymentmachinename
            WHEN s.ccp_ringgoname            = 'Yes' THEN s.ccp_ringgoname
            WHEN s.ccp_justparkname          = 'Yes' THEN s.ccp_justparkname
            ELSE NULL
        END
    AS VARCHAR(100))                                                    AS tablet_status

FROM all_events AS e_all

LEFT JOIN site AS s
    ON e_all.site_id = s.ccp_siteid

LEFT JOIN entitlement AS e
    ON e_all.site_id = e.ccp_siteid

LEFT JOIN site_rule AS sr
    ON e_all.site_id = sr.ccp_site_siterule

LEFT JOIN site_camera AS sc
    ON e_all.site_id = sc.ccp_site;

model.ccp.core_stream.name: core_stream
model.ccp.core_stream.raw_code:
-- Core Stream entity (LIVE system -- Polus ANPR pipeline).
-- Grain = 1 per raw ANPR capture (plateimagessource row, 166,910,330 total).
--
-- Source tables and join chain:
--   plateimagessource          -- anchor; every raw camera capture (166,910,330 rows)
--       -> plate_images        via plateimagessource.id = plate_images.pi_id
--                              Enriched stream records (95.69% match | 159,718,583 rows).
--                              4.31% of captures are raw un-enriched frames; those rows
--                              still land in this model with pi.* columns as NULL.
--       -> plate_images_fuzzies via plateimagessource.id = plate_images_fuzzies.pi_id
--                              Fuzzy OCR matched records (3.56% | 5,947,942 rows).
--                              NOTE: plate_images_fuzzies has no live Polus staging
--                              model yet -- sourced direct from lh_raw.polus until
--                              a staging model is added to staging/live/polus/.
--       -> records_presented_to_in_house via plateimagessource.id = rph.entryPlateId
--                              Filtered to LOWER(sourcscreen) = 'clean pair' only.
--                              0.45% match overall (757,124 / 166,910,330).
--       -> atlas_plate_images_backup via plateimagessource.id = atlas_plate_images_backup.pi_id
--                              51.78% match (86,429,124 / 166,910,330). Unsynced
--                              captures leave atlas_plate_id / atlas_processed_date NULL.
--
-- permit_flag / permit_type: derived from plate_images.permit_id + permit column.
--   permit_id IS NOT NULL AND permit IN ('permit','permitc') -> 5.61% of enriched streams.
-- exempt_flag / exemption_type: same logic but permit IN ('exemption','exemptiond').
--   Exemptions are rare; 100% NULL in spot-checks.
-- duplicate_flag: plate_images.record_type = 'duplicate' (1.91% of enriched streams).
-- numeric_flag: plate_images.record_type = 'numeric' (0.26% of enriched streams).
-- anpr_single_flag: plate_images.record_type = 'single' (6.15% of enriched streams).
-- match_type: 'Fuzzy Match' when a fuzzy record exists for this capture; otherwise NULL.
-- ai_corrected_flag: 95.65% NULL -- only plates with ambiguous characters are corrected.
-- process_name: 0.00% NULL on enriched records (159,718,583 populated).
-- atlas_plate_id: 48.22% NULL -- captures not yet mirrored to Atlas cloud backup.

{{ config(
    alias = 'core_stream',
    tags  = ['core', 'live', 'core_stream']
) }}

-- ============================================================
-- UNIONED SOURCES
-- Combining live and archive tables explicitly
-- ============================================================

WITH source_plateimagessource AS (
    SELECT id, site, cameraname, plate, date, accuracy 
    FROM {{ ref('plateimagessource') }}
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, site, cameraname, plate, date, accuracy 
    FROM {{ ref('plateimagessource_archive') }}
),

source_plate_images AS (
    SELECT pi_id, pi_date, pi_site, ai_corrected, permit_id, permit, record_type, process_name, time_updated
    FROM {{ ref('plate_images') }}
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pi_id, pi_date, pi_site, ai_corrected, permit_id, permit, record_type, process_name, time_updated
    FROM {{ ref('plate_images_archive') }}
),

source_records_presented AS (
    SELECT entryPlateId, exitPlateId, time_updated, source_screen
    FROM {{ ref('records_presented_to_in_house') }}
    UNION ALL
    SELECT entryPlateId, exitPlateId, time_updated, source_screen
    FROM {{ ref('records_presented_to_in_house_archive') }}
),

-- ============================================================
-- RAW STREAM
-- ============================================================

stream AS
(
    SELECT
        src.id            AS stream_id,
        src.site          AS site_id,
        s.ccp_siteid      AS site_guid,
        src.cameraname    AS camera_id,
        src.plate         AS anpr_plate,
        src.date          AS stream_datetime,
        src.accuracy      AS anpr_confidence_tier,
 
        CASE
            WHEN s.ccp_sitenumber IS NOT NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_live_site
 
    FROM source_plateimagessource AS src
 
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('ccp_site') }} AS s
        ON s.ccp_sitenumber = src.site
       AND s.statuscode = '765440005'
),
 
-- ============================================================
-- ENRICHED
-- Keep latest plate_images record for each pi_id
-- ============================================================
 
enriched AS
(
    SELECT
        pi_id,
        pi_date,
        pi_site AS site_id,
        ai_corrected AS ai_corrected_flag,
        permit_id,
        permit,
        record_type,
        process_name
 
    FROM
       
    (
        SELECT
            pi_id,
            pi_date,
            pi_site,
            ai_corrected,
            permit_id,
            permit,
            record_type,
            process_name,
            time_updated,
 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY pi_id, record_type
                ORDER BY time_updated DESC
            ) AS rn
 
        FROM source_plate_images
    ) pi
 
    WHERE rn = 1
),
 
-- ============================================================
-- CLEAN PAIRS
-- Keep latest record for each entryPlateId + exitPlateId
-- ============================================================
 
clean_pairs AS
(
    SELECT
        entryPlateId,
        exitPlateId AS pair_id
 
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            entryPlateId,
            exitPlateId,
            time_updated,
 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY entryPlateId
                ORDER BY time_updated DESC
            ) AS rn
 
        FROM source_records_presented
 
        WHERE LOWER(source_screen) = 'clean pair'
    ) cp
 
    WHERE rn = 1
),
 
-- ============================================================
-- ATLAS BACKUP
-- Keep latest Atlas record for each pi_id
-- ============================================================
 
atlas_backup AS
(
    SELECT
        pi_id,
        atlas_plate_id,
        atlas_processed_date
 
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            pi_id,
            id AS atlas_plate_id,
            pi_date AS atlas_processed_date,
 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY pi_id
                ORDER BY pi_date DESC
            ) AS rn
 
        FROM {{ ref('atlas_plate_images_backup') }}
    ) ab
 
    WHERE rn = 1
),
 
-- ============================================================
-- FINAL STREAM LEVEL DATA
-- ============================================================
 
final AS
(
    SELECT
 
        -- ====================================================
        -- FACT CONFORMED COLUMNS & CASTS
        -- ====================================================
        CAST(s.stream_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                           AS stream_id,
        CAST(s.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                             AS site_id,
        CAST(s.site_guid AS VARCHAR(100))                                           AS site_guid,
        CAST(s.camera_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                           AS camera_id,
        CAST(cp.pair_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                            AS pair_id,
        
        CAST(s.stream_datetime AS DATETIME2(6))                                     AS stream_datetime,
        CAST(s.stream_datetime AS DATE)                                             AS stream_date,

        CAST(CASE WHEN LOWER(e.record_type) = 'duplicate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS duplicate_flag,
        CAST(CASE WHEN LOWER(e.record_type) = 'numeric' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)   AS numeric_flag,
        CAST(e.record_type AS VARCHAR(100))                                         AS match_type,
        CAST(e.process_name AS VARCHAR(100))                                        AS processed_status,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))                                                  AS processed_date,

        CAST(CASE WHEN e.permit_id IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(e.permit) IN ('permit', 'permitc') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS permit_flag,
        CAST(CASE WHEN e.permit_id IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(e.permit) IN ('permit', 'permitc') THEN e.permit ELSE NULL END AS VARCHAR(100)) AS permit_type,
        CAST(NULL AS BIT)                                                           AS blackout_flag,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                                  AS permit_type_accuracy,
        CAST(CASE WHEN e.permit_id IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(e.permit) IN ('permit', 'permitc') THEN e.permit ELSE NULL END AS VARCHAR(100)) AS permit_type_plate,

        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                                  AS match_method,
        CAST(s.anpr_confidence_tier AS VARCHAR(20))                                 AS anpr_confidence_tier,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(10))                                                   AS fuzzy_ready_flag,

        CAST(CASE WHEN e.permit_id IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(e.permit) IN ('exemption', 'exemptiond') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS exempt_flag,
        CAST(CASE WHEN e.permit_id IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(e.permit) IN ('exemption', 'exemptiond') THEN e.permit ELSE NULL END AS VARCHAR(100)) AS exemption_category,

        CAST(e.ai_corrected_flag AS BIT)                                            AS ai_corrected_flag,
        CAST(CASE WHEN LOWER(e.record_type) = 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)    AS anpr_single_flag,
        CAST(NULL AS BIT)                                                           AS fuzzy_match_applied_flag,
        CAST(NULL AS BIT)                                                           AS polus_single_flag,

        CAST(s.anpr_plate AS VARCHAR(100))                                          AS anpr_plate,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20))                                                   AS polus_plate,
        CAST(ab.atlas_plate_id AS VARCHAR(100))                                     AS atlas_plate,
        CAST(ab.atlas_processed_date AS DATETIME2(6))                               AS atlas_processed_date,
        'Live'                                                                      AS source_system,

        -- ====================================================
        -- EXISTING LIVE-SPECIFIC COLUMNS
        -- ====================================================
        e.pi_date,
        e.site_id                                                                   AS pi_site_id,
        e.permit                                                                    AS permit,
        s.is_live_site

    FROM stream s
    LEFT JOIN enriched e ON s.stream_id = e.pi_id  
    LEFT JOIN clean_pairs cp ON s.stream_id = cp.entryPlateId
    LEFT JOIN atlas_backup ab ON s.stream_id = ab.pi_id
)
 
SELECT * FROM final

model.ccp.core_tracing.name: core_tracing
model.ccp.core_tracing.raw_code:
{{ config(
    alias = 'core_tracing',
    tags = ['core', 'live', 'tracing', 'core_tracing']
) }}

WITH raw_outcomes AS (

    SELECT
        ccp_recordtracingoutcomesid                      AS tracing_id,
        ccp_ticketno                                     AS pcn_id,
        CASE statuscode
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Active'
            ELSE NULL
        END                                              AS tracing_status,
        
        -- Resolve the outcome string first so downstream logic can reference it
        CASE ccp_tracingoutcome
            WHEN 860620000 THEN 'Deceased / Insolvent'
            WHEN 860620001 THEN 'New address provided'
            WHEN 860620002 THEN 'Due Claim'
            WHEN 860620003 THEN 'Same Address - satisfied CCJ'
            WHEN 860620004 THEN 'Same Address - live CCJ'
            WHEN 860620005 THEN 'Not matched / Invalid'
            WHEN 860620006 THEN 'Same address - No CCJ'
            WHEN 860620007 THEN 'New Address - No CCJ'
            WHEN 860620008 THEN 'New Address - Live CCJ'
            WHEN 860620009 THEN 'Deceased'
            WHEN 860620010 THEN 'Insolvent'
            ELSE NULL
        END                                              AS tracing_outcome,
        
        createdon,
        ccp_recordtracedon,
        ccp_score
        
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_recordtracingoutcomes') }}

),

base AS (

    SELECT
        tracing_id,
        pcn_id,
        tracing_status,
        tracing_outcome,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tracing_outcome)) LIKE '%ccj%'
            THEN 1
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tracing_outcome)) LIKE '%no ccj%'
            THEN 0
            ELSE NULL
        END AS tracing_outcome_ccj,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tracing_outcome)) LIKE 'same address%'
            THEN 'Same address'
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tracing_outcome)) LIKE 'new address%'
            THEN 'New address'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS tracing_outcome_address_match,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tracing_outcome)) = 'deceased'
            THEN 1
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tracing_outcome)) = 'deceased / insolvent'
            THEN NULL
            ELSE 0
        END AS tracing_outcome_deceased,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tracing_outcome)) LIKE '%insolvent%'
            THEN 1
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(tracing_outcome)) = 'deceased / insolvent'
            THEN NULL
            ELSE 0
        END AS tracing_outcome_insolvent,

        MIN(createdon) OVER (
            PARTITION BY tracing_id
        ) AS tracing_sent_date,

        MAX(ccp_recordtracedon) OVER (
            PARTITION BY tracing_id
        ) AS tracing_outcome_date,

        CASE
            WHEN ccp_score IS NULL OR ccp_score = 0
            THEN 'No score'
            ELSE CAST(ccp_score AS VARCHAR(50))
        END AS tracing_outcome_tracing_score

    FROM raw_outcomes

)

SELECT
    tracing_id,
    pcn_id,
    tracing_status,
    tracing_outcome,
    tracing_outcome_ccj,
    tracing_outcome_address_match,
    tracing_outcome_deceased,
    tracing_outcome_insolvent,
    tracing_sent_date,
    tracing_outcome_date,
    tracing_outcome_tracing_score
FROM base

model.ccp.core_vehicle.name: core_vehicle
model.ccp.core_vehicle.raw_code:
-- Core Vehicle entity
-- Grain = 1 per unique vehicle registration.
--
-- Built from the ZEUS ccp_vehicle entity and enriched with
-- POLUS carinfo and DVLA KadoeVQ7Response information.
--
-- The vehicle mapping across systems is established through:
-- ccp_vehicle.ccp_registrationnumber
--     <-> carinfo.plate (FULL OUTER JOIN)
--     <-> KadoeVQ7Response.v_q3__v_r_m (LEFT JOIN)
--
-- Specific logic:
-- - Multiple records per registration in Polus and DVLA are deduplicated
--   to keep the most recent entry.
-- - vehicle_id prioritizes the Zeus ccp_vehicleid. If unavailable, a
--   deterministic MD5 hash is generated from the vehicle registration.
-- - Vehicle attributes (make, model, colour) are resolved via COALESCE, 
--   prioritizing Zeus > Polus > DVLA.

{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    alias='core_vehicle',
    tags=['core', 'live', 'core_vehicle']
) }}

WITH 

-- ========================================================================
-- 1. IMPORT CTEs
-- ========================================================================

src_zeus_vehicles AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('ccp_vehicle') }}
),

src_polus_carinfo AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('carinfo') }}
),

src_dvla_responses AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('kadoevq7response_vq7response') }}
),

-- ========================================================================
-- 2. CLEANSING & STANDARDIZATION CTEs
-- ========================================================================

zeus_cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(ccp_vehicleid AS VARCHAR(100))                                         AS vehicle_id,
        UPPER(TRIM(CAST(ccp_registrationnumber AS VARCHAR(50))))                    AS vehicle_registration,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(ccp_make AS VARCHAR(100)))), '')                     AS vehicle_make,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(ccp_model AS VARCHAR(100)))), '')                    AS vehicle_model,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(ccp_colour AS VARCHAR(50)))), '')                    AS vehicle_colour
    FROM src_zeus_vehicles
    WHERE ccp_registrationnumber IS NOT NULL
),

polus_cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(TRIM(CAST(plate AS VARCHAR(50))))                                     AS vehicle_registration,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(make AS VARCHAR(100)))), '')                         AS make,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(color AS VARCHAR(50)))), '')                         AS color,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(fuel_type AS VARCHAR(50)))), '')                     AS fuel_type,
        
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(CAST(plate AS VARCHAR(50))))
            ORDER BY id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM src_polus_carinfo
    WHERE plate IS NOT NULL
),

dvla_cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(TRIM(CAST(v_q3__v_r_m AS VARCHAR(50))))                               AS vehicle_registration,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(v_q7__vehicle_details__make AS VARCHAR(100)))), '')  AS dvla_make,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(v_q7__vehicle_details__model AS VARCHAR(100)))), '') AS dvla_model,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(v_q7__vehicle_details__colour AS VARCHAR(50)))), '') AS dvla_colour,
        TRY_CAST(LEFT(v_q7__vehicle_details__date_of_first_registration, 4) AS INT) AS dvla_year,
        
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(CAST(v_q3__v_r_m AS VARCHAR(50))))
            ORDER BY kadoe_vq7response_vq7response_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM src_dvla_responses
    WHERE v_q3__v_r_m IS NOT NULL
),

-- ========================================================================
-- 3. DEDUPLICATION CTEs
-- ========================================================================

polus_deduped AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM polus_cleaned 
    WHERE rn = 1
),

dvla_deduped AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM dvla_cleaned 
    WHERE rn = 1
),

-- ========================================================================
-- 4. FINAL INTEGRATION
-- ========================================================================

final AS (
    SELECT
        -- Generate a deterministic ID if zeus vehicle_id is missing
        COALESCE(
            z.vehicle_id,
            CONVERT(
                VARCHAR(32),
                HASHBYTES('MD5', COALESCE(p.vehicle_registration, dvla.vehicle_registration)),
                2
            )
        ) AS vehicle_id,

        COALESCE(
            z.vehicle_registration, 
            p.vehicle_registration, 
            dvla.vehicle_registration
        ) AS vehicle_registration,

        COALESCE(
            z.vehicle_make, 
            p.make, 
            dvla.dvla_make
        ) AS vehicle_make,

        COALESCE(
            z.vehicle_model, 
            dvla.dvla_model
        ) AS vehicle_model,

        COALESCE(
            z.vehicle_colour, 
            p.color, 
            dvla.dvla_colour
        ) AS vehicle_colour,

        p.fuel_type      AS fuel_type,
        dvla.dvla_year   AS year_of_manufacture

    FROM zeus_cleaned AS z

    FULL OUTER JOIN polus_deduped AS p
        ON z.vehicle_registration = p.vehicle_registration

    LEFT JOIN dvla_deduped AS dvla
        ON COALESCE(z.vehicle_registration, p.vehicle_registration) = dvla.vehicle_registration
)

SELECT * FROM final

model.ccp.dim_collection_stage.name: dim_collection_stage
model.ccp.dim_collection_stage.raw_code:
-- Mart: dim_collection_stage. Generated from the seeds/event_stage_ladder.csv
-- Updated to map all 29 Zeus ccp_substage stage names (sourced from core_pcn_lifecycle
-- stage_key distinct values) to UPPER_SNAKE_CASE stage_key codes.
-- stage_group splits: Pre-Legal (1-8), Legal (9-21), Post-CCJ (22-29).
-- sort_order comes directly from event_stage_ladder.event_type_order.

{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias = 'dim_collection_stage',
    tags = ['mart', 'dimension']
) }}

SELECT
    CASE event_type
        WHEN 'PCN Issuance'                         THEN 'PCN_ISSUANCE'
        WHEN 'First Reminder'                        THEN 'FIRST_REMINDER'
        WHEN 'Second Reminder'                       THEN 'SECOND_REMINDER'
        WHEN 'Third Reminder'                        THEN 'THIRD_REMINDER'
        WHEN 'At POPLA'                              THEN 'AT_POPLA'
        WHEN 'POPLA Withdrawn'                       THEN 'POPLA_WITHDRAWN'
        WHEN 'After POPLA'                           THEN 'AFTER_POPLA'
        WHEN 'Breathing Space'                       THEN 'BREATHING_SPACE'
        WHEN 'LBA'                                   THEN 'LBA'
        WHEN 'LBA Reminder'                          THEN 'LBA_REMINDER'
        WHEN 'Debt Recovery 1st Placement Sent'      THEN 'DR_1ST_PLACEMENT_SENT'
        WHEN 'Debt Recovery 1st Placement Returned'  THEN 'DR_1ST_PLACEMENT_RETURNED'
        WHEN 'DNI - DR Sent'                         THEN 'DNI_DR_SENT'
        WHEN 'DNI - DR Returned'                     THEN 'DNI_DR_RETURNED'
        WHEN 'Do Not Issue - No Further Action'      THEN 'DO_NOT_ISSUE_NFA'
        WHEN 'Legal 1 - Do not Issue - Under review' THEN 'LEGAL_1_DNI_UNDER_REVIEW'
        WHEN 'Internal Claim Issued'                 THEN 'INTERNAL_CLAIM_ISSUED'
        WHEN 'Claim Issuance'                        THEN 'CLAIM_ISSUANCE'
        WHEN 'CLAIM ISSUED - NFA'                    THEN 'CLAIM_ISSUED_NFA'
        WHEN 'Due CCJ'                               THEN 'DUE_CCJ'
        WHEN 'CCJ Obtained'                          THEN 'CCJ_OBTAINED'
        WHEN 'Post CCJ'                              THEN 'POST_CCJ'
        WHEN 'Post CCJ Reminder'                     THEN 'POST_CCJ_REMINDER'
        WHEN 'Post CCJ WP Offer'                     THEN 'POST_CCJ_WP_OFFER'
        WHEN 'Post CCJ Debt Recovery Sent'           THEN 'POST_CCJ_DR_SENT'
        WHEN 'Post CCJ Debt Recovery Returned'       THEN 'POST_CCJ_DR_RETURNED'
        WHEN 'Post CCJ Debt Recovery'                THEN 'POST_CCJ_DR'
        WHEN 'Due Tracing'                           THEN 'DUE_TRACING'
        WHEN 'External Claim Issued'                 THEN 'EXTERNAL_CLAIM_ISSUED'
        ELSE NULL
    END                                             AS stage_key,
    event_type                                      AS stage_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN event_type_order <= 8  THEN 'Pre-Legal'
        WHEN event_type_order <= 21 THEN 'Legal'
        ELSE 'Post-CCJ'
    END                                             AS stage_group,
    event_type_order                                AS sort_order
FROM {{ ref('event_stage_ladder') }}
WHERE is_stage = 1

model.ccp.dim_customer.name: dim_customer
model.ccp.dim_customer.raw_code:
-- Mart: dim_client. CONFORMED across both source systems, replacing both
-- dim_client_legacy.sql (TrafficGuard) and dim_customer.sql (Zeus/Dataverse)
-- per the reporting layer's table inventory (dbt build guide for the
-- TrafficGuard/NewLogic dimension tables, third pass -- naming resolved,
-- 2026-08-31): "dim_client already existed as dim_customer" -- both names
-- converge here. source_system discriminates the two ('TrafficGuard' vs
-- 'Zeus'), same pattern as dim_site.sql.
--
-- client_id/client_name are core_client_legacy's TrafficGuard clientid/
-- clientname on one side, core_customer's Dataverse accountid/name on the
-- other -- an int-like small key vs a GUID string, so collision is not a
-- practical concern, but source_system is still carried explicitly rather
-- than relying on key-format alone.
--
-- status/post_code/state/country are typed NULL on the TrafficGuard side
-- (clients has only client_id/client_name, see core_client_legacy.sql) and
-- real on the Zeus side (Dataverse account, with a ccp_site postcode/city
-- fallback -- see core_customer.sql).
--
-- site_count (a TrafficGuard-only bonus column on core_client_legacy) is
-- deliberately NOT included -- Zeus has no equivalent here, and this mart's
-- job is the common conformed shape.

{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias = 'dim_customer',
    tags = ['mart', 'dimension']
) }}

WITH

legacy_client AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(client_id AS VARCHAR(100)) AS client_id,  -- explicit cast: legacy client_id is INT, live client_id is a VARCHAR(100) GUID -- an untyped UNION lets SQL Server's type precedence coerce the GUID side to INT and fail
        client_name,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS status,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS post_code,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS state,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS country,
        'Legacy'              AS source_system
    FROM {{ ref('core_client_legacy') }}
),

live_client AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id                AS client_id,
        customer_name               AS client_name,
        status,
        post_code,
        state,
        country,
        'Live'                      AS source_system
    FROM {{ ref('core_customer') }}
)

SELECT * FROM legacy_client
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM live_client

model.ccp.dim_date.name: dim_date
model.ccp.dim_date.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    alias='dim_date',
    tags=['mart','dimension','dim_date']
) }}

SELECT
    date_key,
    YEAR(date_key) AS calendar_year,
    MONTH(date_key) AS month_number,
    CAST(DATENAME(MONTH, date_key) AS VARCHAR(20)) AS calendar_month_name,
    CONCAT(CAST(DATENAME(MONTH, date_key) AS VARCHAR(20)), ' ', YEAR(date_key)) AS month_label,
    DATEPART(QUARTER, DATEADD(MONTH, -3, date_key)) AS quarter_number,
    CONCAT('Q', DATEPART(QUARTER, DATEADD(MONTH, -3, date_key))) AS quarter_name,
    EOMONTH(date_key) AS month_end_date,
    DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(date_key), MONTH(date_key), 1) AS month_start_date,
    
CASE WHEN MONTH(date_key) >= 4
         THEN CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(date_key) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
         ELSE CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(date_key) AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
    END AS financial_year,                                            -- assumes 1 April FY start, see header
    
    CASE WHEN MONTH(date_key) >= 4
         THEN MONTH(date_key) - 3
         ELSE MONTH(date_key) + 9
    END AS fy_month_no,                                                -- same assumption
    
    CONCAT(
        CASE WHEN MONTH(date_key) >= 4 
            THEN CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(date_key) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
            ELSE CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(date_key) AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
        END,
        ' Q', 
        DATEPART(QUARTER, DATEADD(MONTH, -3, date_key))
    ) AS quarter_label,  -- FY-aligned quarter, same assumption
    
    CASE WHEN EOMONTH(date_key) < CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_data_received  -- PLACEHOLDER PROXY ONLY, see header

FROM {{ ref('core_date') }}

model.ccp.dim_months_since_go_live.name: dim_months_since_go_live
model.ccp.dim_months_since_go_live.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    alias='dim_months_since_go_live',
    tags=['mart', 'dimension']
) }}

SELECT
    month_index,
    month_label,
    halo_phase,

model.ccp.dim_site.name: dim_site
model.ccp.dim_site.raw_code:
-- Mart: dim_site. CONFORMED across both source systems, per the reporting
-- layer's table inventory (dbt build guide for the TrafficGuard/NewLogic
-- dimension tables, third pass -- naming resolved, 2026-08-31): the
-- previous `_legacy` suffix is dropped, and TrafficGuard/core_site_legacy is
-- UNIONed with the pre-existing live/core_site.sql (Zeus/Dataverse) rather
-- than living as a second table. `source_system` is the discriminator column
-- the naming note asked for -- 'TrafficGuard' vs 'Zeus'. This UNION happens
-- here (mart layer), not in core, per this project's own dbt_project.yml
-- philosophy: core stays split by source system (different joins/dedup
-- logic per system), marts are the converged published layer -- same
-- pattern already used by fact_pcn.sql for legacy+live PCNs.
--
-- Both sides already independently converged on nearly the same column
-- shape (confirmed by reading core_site.sql, the live core entity, before
-- writing this) -- this UNION mostly just aligns naming (customer_id ->
-- client_id on the legacy side; core_site_legacy itself keeps customer_id
-- internally, see that model's header) rather than inventing new logic.
--
-- size_band_sort has no source on EITHER side (core_site.sql's own version
-- is commented out) -- typed NULL on both.
--
-- current_status is NOT reconciled to one vocabulary here: TrafficGuard
-- emits 'Live - operational'/'Disabled'/NULL (see core_site_legacy.sql
-- header), Zeus emits whatever raw statuscodename the CRM carries (e.g.
-- 'Lost - Churned') -- these are DIFFERENT strings that happen to share one
-- value in common. Not remapped to a single enum here since Zeus's full
-- vocabulary was never profiled -- filter/group by source_system + raw
-- current_status until that's done, not by current_status alone.
--
-- is_live_operational_flag (added 2026-09-17) is the one exception: both
-- sides' "live and operational" value is case-insensitively the same
-- concept ('Live - operational' vs 'Live - Operational'), so this single
-- flag is safe to filter/count on directly across both systems without
-- the source_system + raw-string caveat above -- use it instead of
-- comparing current_status to either literal casing.
--
-- latest_contract_length_years (a TrafficGuard-only bonus column, see
-- core_site_legacy.sql) is deliberately NOT included -- Zeus has no
-- equivalent, and this mart's job is the common conformed shape.

{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias = 'dim_site',
    tags = ['mart', 'dimension']
) }}

WITH

-- Zeus's ccp_legacysitenumber carries the pre-migration TrafficGuard site
-- code for any site that existed in Legacy before moving to Zeus (confirmed
-- 2026-09-11: all 3,436 core_site rows have this populated, and 3,229 of
-- core_site_legacy's 3,911 site_ids match one -- i.e. 82% of "TrafficGuard"
-- sites are really the same physical site already counted under Zeus).
-- Excluding those from legacy_site here mirrors fact_pcn.sql's own
-- Legacy-excluded-when-also-in-Live pattern, Zeus treated as the latest/
-- authoritative copy.
live_site_legacy_numbers AS (
    -- Query ccp_site (raw staging) directly rather than core_site.
    -- core_site filters out Zeus sites where ccp_businesscategorylookup IS NULL,
    -- so those sites' ccp_legacysitenumber would be missing and their TG
    -- counterparts would slip through the NOT EXISTS as if they were TG-only.
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TRIM(UPPER(CAST(ccp_legacysitenumber AS VARCHAR(50)))) AS legacy_site_number
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }}
    WHERE ccp_legacysitenumber IS NOT NULL
),

legacy_site AS (
    SELECT
        site_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(36)) AS site_guid,
        site_name,
        CAST(customer_id AS VARCHAR(36)) AS client_id,  -- explicit cast: legacy customer_id is INT, live client_id is a VARCHAR(36) GUID -- an untyped UNION lets SQL Server's type precedence coerce the GUID side to INT and fail
        region,
        postcode,
        site_nature,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))       AS type_of_car_park,
        business_category,
        spaces,
        size_band,
        size_band_sort,
        quality_tier,
        quality_tier_rank,
        revenue_share_model,
        revenue_share_pct,
        pcn_rev_share_band,
        -- Date safety-net: core_site_legacy already resolves these via COALESCE(raw, pcn);
        -- applied again here to make dim_site self-documenting and resilient to upstream changes.
        COALESCE(l.golive_date,        l.first_pcn_sent_date)        AS golive_date,
        COALESCE(l.acquisition_date,   l.first_pcn_sent_date)        AS acquisition_date,
        acquisition_fy,
        COALESCE(l.contract_start_date, l.first_pcn_sent_date)       AS contract_start_date,
        contract_end_date,
        contract_length_years,
        renewal_date,
        COALESCE(l.lost_date, CAST(l.last_pcn_issue_date AS DATE))   AS lost_date,
        current_status,
        is_live_operational_flag,
        site_sales_channel,
        -- Client-reported (2026-09-21) "484 non-existent" / "98 lost prior
        -- to Dec-19" TrafficGuard sites -- see core_site_legacy.sql for the
        -- derivation. Flag rather than remove: keeps the site record intact
        -- for historical PCNs while letting a dashboard filter these out of
        -- an "active sites" view.
        never_operational_flag,
        last_pcn_issue_date,
        dormant_pre_dec19_flag,
        NULL                         AS camera_type,
        'Legacy'               AS source_system
    FROM {{ ref('core_site_legacy') }} l
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM live_site_legacy_numbers ln
        WHERE ln.legacy_site_number = TRIM(UPPER(CAST(l.site_id AS VARCHAR(50))))
    )
),


live_site AS (
    SELECT
        -- BUG FOUND LIVE 2026-09-21: this was the raw ccp_siteid GUID,
        -- while legacy_site's site_id (above) is TrafficGuard's decimal
        -- site number -- one published column silently mixing two key
        -- formats, discriminated only by source_system. A consumer
        -- expecting a consistent decimal site number sees every Zeus row
        -- as "erroneous data" (client-reported: 925 such site_ids, e.g.
        -- deeadbe0-06e0-ef11-8eea-6045bd0cd960, which resolves to site
        -- number 2153). Swapped to core_site.sql's site_number (Zeus's own
        -- decimal site number, ccp_sitenumber -- 100% populated, always
        -- numeric) so both source systems publish the same key format here.
        site_number AS site_id,
        site_guid,
        site_name,
        client_id,
        region,
        postcode,
        site_nature,
        type_of_car_park,
        business_category,
        spaces,
        size_band,
        CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)        AS size_band_sort,   -- no source on the live side either, see header
        quality_tier,
        quality_tier_rank,
        revenue_share_model,
        revenue_share_pct,
        pcn_rev_share_band,
        golive_date,
        acquisition_date,
        acquisition_fy,
        contract_start_date,
        contract_end_date,
        contract_length_years,
        renewal_date,
        lost_date,
        current_status,
        is_live_operational_flag,
        site_sales_channel,
        -- No equivalent concept derived for Zeus yet -- the client's report
        -- was specifically about TrafficGuard sites. Typed false/NULL here
        -- to keep the UNION ALL aligned, not a claim that no Zeus site is
        -- ever non-operational or dormant.
        CAST(0 AS BIT)               AS never_operational_flag,
        CAST(NULL AS DATE)           AS last_pcn_issue_date,
        CAST(0 AS BIT)               AS dormant_pre_dec19_flag,
        camera_type,
        'Live'                       AS source_system
    FROM {{ ref('core_site') }}
)

SELECT * FROM legacy_site
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM live_site

model.ccp.fact_claims.description: Unified Legacy and Live claim records.
model.ccp.fact_claims.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias = 'fact_claims',
    tags = ['mart', 'fact', 'fact_claims']
) }}

WITH legacy_claims AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(claim_id AS VARCHAR(100)) AS claim_id,
        claim_pcn AS pcn_id,
        claim_issue_date,
        claim_status,
        claim_type,
        claim_amount,
        claim_stage_supplementary AS claim_stage,
        claim_stage_start_date,
        defended_status,
        court_flag,
        court_type,
        ccj_date,
        ccj_status,
        payment_status,
        fully_paid_flag,
        post_ccj_recovery_status,
        post_ccj_recovery_type,
        instalment_status,
        site_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(36)) AS site_guid,
        pcn_issue_date,

        post_court_cash_collected AS cash_collected,

        CAST(
            COALESCE(post_court_cash_collected_flag, 0)
            AS BIT
        ) AS post_court_cash_collected_flag,

        'Legacy' AS source_system

    FROM {{ ref('core_claim_legacy') }} l

    -- Migrated-ticket precedence: exclude any claim_pcn that also resolves to
    -- a claim in int_claim_issue_date_zeus (the client's view always prefers
    -- the Dynamics/Zeus side for "Claim Issued" when both exist). Was checking
    -- against core_claims (scoped to ccp_casetype = claim only), which misses
    -- migrated tickets whose only Zeus claim evidence is via the
    -- courtissued-linked / PreClaimSubStages-filtered logic in
    -- int_claim_issue_date_zeus.sql -- confirmed live 2026-09-08 (41 of 180
    -- Jan-2023 Legacy claims also existed in that broader Zeus set).
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM {{ ref('int_claim_issue_date_zeus') }} z
        WHERE z.pcn_id = CAST(l.claim_pcn AS VARCHAR(50))
    )
),

live_claims AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(claim_id AS VARCHAR(100)) AS claim_id,
        pcn_id,
        claim_issue_date,
        claim_status,
        claim_type,
        claim_amount,
        claim_stage,
        claim_stage_start_date,
        defended_status,
        court_flag,
        court_type,
        ccj_date,
        ccj_status,
        payment_status,
        fully_paid_flag,
        post_ccj_recovery_status,
        post_ccj_recovery_type,
        instalment_status,
        site_id,
        site_guid,
        pcn_issue_date,

        cash_collected,

        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(cash_collected, 0) > 0 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
            AS BIT
        ) AS post_court_cash_collected_flag,

        'Live' AS source_system

    FROM {{ ref('core_claims') }}
),

combined_claims AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM legacy_claims

    UNION ALL

    SELECT *
    FROM live_claims
)

SELECT *
FROM combined_claims
WHERE fully_paid_flag IS NOT NULL

        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                 AS dvla_engine_outcome,

        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                 AS dvla_api_status,
        CAST(dvla_api_sent_date AS DATETIME2(6))   AS dvla_api_date,
        CAST(dvla_submission_batch_id AS VARCHAR(100))
                                                    AS dvla_submission_batch_id,
CAST(dvla_api_check_outcome AS VARCHAR(50)) AS dvla_api_check_outcome,

        zeus_approval_outcome_reason,
