model.ccp.fact_payment.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias = 'fact_payment',
    tags = ['mart','fact', 'fact_payment']
) }}

WITH legacy_claim_latest AS (

    -- BUG FOUND LIVE 2026-09-16: legacy_payment below hardcoded claim_id to
    -- NULL for every Legacy row ("Explicitly typed NULLs to match
    -- core_payment's new schema"), which silently broke any Pre-Court/
    -- Post-Court split downstream (fact_payment.claim_id joined against
    -- fact_claims.claim_id always failed to match, so every Legacy payment
    -- fell through to "Pre Court" regardless of when it actually happened
    -- relative to the claim). core_claim_legacy.claim_id is the same key
    -- fact_claims.sql's own legacy_claims CTE uses, joined the same way
    -- (via claim_pcn). A PCN can have more than one court claim over time,
    -- so ranked to the latest by claim_issue_date to avoid fanning out
    -- payment rows on the join.
    SELECT
        claim_pcn AS pcn_id,
        claim_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY claim_pcn
            ORDER BY claim_issue_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('core_claim_legacy') }}
    WHERE claim_pcn IS NOT NULL

),

legacy_payment AS (

    -- BUG FOUND LIVE 2026-09-17: unlike int_pcn_event_scd_legacy.sql's own
    -- Ticket Payment branch (which suppresses a TG-native payment whenever
    -- the ticket has ANY Zeus/Dynamics presence -- the same SourceOrder
    -- precedence rule the client's view applies to every event type), this
    -- CTE had no such suppression. A TG-originated ticket that migrated to
    -- Zeus and had its payment re-recorded there gets counted TWICE --
    -- once here (from the original TG payment tables) and once more via
    -- live_payment (from the migrated ticket's own core_payment/Zeus
    -- record). Confirmed live: ~£2.78M of double-counted payments across
    -- 2018-2025 issue cohorts, discovered while reconciling Pre/Post-Court
    -- Total Amount Collected against the client's own Synapse query
    -- (Fabric was running 5-14% high on combined Pre+Post cash for
    -- otherwise-settled old cohorts).
    SELECT
        CAST(cp.payment_id AS VARCHAR(100))     AS payment_id,
        CAST(cp.pcn_id AS VARCHAR(100))         AS pcn_id,
        p.charge                                AS total_fine_amount,
        cp.payment_date,
        cp.amount                               AS amount_paid,
        'Legacy'                                AS source_system,

        CAST(cl.claim_id AS VARCHAR(100))       AS claim_id,
        p.site_id                               AS site_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(36))               AS site_guid,

        -- BUG FOUND LIVE 2026-09-22: 871 legacy payments reference a PCN that
        -- is not in core_pcn_legacy (orphan payments -- PCN deleted / voided
        -- in TrafficGuard after the payment was recorded). The LEFT JOIN to
        -- core_pcn_legacy returns NULL for p.issue_date on these rows, making
        -- pcn_issue_date, pcn_issue_fy and days_since_issue all NULL.
        --
        -- Fix: add a secondary fallback LEFT JOIN to violators (the raw source
        -- for core_pcn_legacy) keyed on the same TRIM/UPPER pcn_id format.
        -- The COALESCE below prefers core_pcn_legacy (authoritative, deduped)
        -- and falls back to violators.orig_pcn_sent_date only when the primary
        -- join misses. Confirmed: p.pcn_id IS NULL is the exact miss condition.
        -- COALESCE chain: 1) authoritative core_pcn_legacy issue_date
        --                2) raw violators.orig_pcn_sent_date (PCN filtered from core)
        --                3) cancelled.cancelled date (PCN deleted from violators;
        --                   cancellation date is the best available proxy for issue
        --                   date -- confirmed 871 orphan payments via diagnostic
        --                   query 2026-09-22; cancelled table uses pcn not full_pcn)
        CAST(COALESCE(
            p.issue_date,
            CAST(v.orig_pcn_sent_date AS DATE),
            CAST(c_pcn.cancelled_date AS DATE)
        ) AS DATE)                              AS pcn_issue_date,

        cp.payment_date                         AS transaction_date,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.issue_date, p.reissue_date,
                          CAST(v.orig_pcn_sent_date AS DATE),
                          CAST(c_pcn.cancelled_date AS DATE)) IS NULL
                THEN NULL
            WHEN MONTH(COALESCE(p.issue_date, p.reissue_date,
                          CAST(v.orig_pcn_sent_date AS DATE),
                          CAST(c_pcn.cancelled_date AS DATE))) >= 4
                THEN CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(p.issue_date, p.reissue_date,
                          CAST(v.orig_pcn_sent_date AS DATE),
                          CAST(c_pcn.cancelled_date AS DATE))) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
            ELSE CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(COALESCE(p.issue_date, p.reissue_date,
                          CAST(v.orig_pcn_sent_date AS DATE),
                          CAST(c_pcn.cancelled_date AS DATE))) AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
        END                                     AS pcn_issue_fy,
        claim_payment_stage,
        DATEDIFF(
            day,
            CAST(COALESCE(
                p.issue_date,
                CAST(v.orig_pcn_sent_date AS DATE),
                CAST(c_pcn.cancelled_date AS DATE)
            ) AS DATE),
            CAST(cp.payment_date AS DATE)
        )                                       AS days_since_issue,
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2))             AS amount_due

    FROM {{ ref('core_payment_legacy') }} cp

    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('core_pcn_legacy') }} p
        ON p.pcn_id = cp.pcn_id

    -- Fallback 2: recover orig_pcn_sent_date for orphan payments (PCN exists in
    -- raw violators but was excluded from core_pcn_legacy's dedup/filter chain)
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('violators') }} v
        ON p.pcn_id IS NULL
        AND TRIM(UPPER(CAST(v.full_pcn AS VARCHAR(50)))) = cp.pcn_id

    -- Fallback 3: for the 871 orphan payments whose PCNs are in cancelled but
    -- not in violators at all (PCN deleted from TG after payment was recorded).
    -- Uses MIN(cancelled) per PCN to prevent row fan-out. cancelled.pcn column
    -- confirmed (not full_pcn) via diagnostic query 2026-09-22.
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            TRIM(UPPER(CAST(pcn AS VARCHAR(50)))) AS pcn_id,
            MIN(cancelled)                         AS cancelled_date
        FROM {{ ref('cancelled') }}
        WHERE pcn IS NOT NULL AND pcn <> ''
        GROUP BY TRIM(UPPER(CAST(pcn AS VARCHAR(50))))
    ) c_pcn
        ON  p.pcn_id IS NULL
        AND v.full_pcn IS NULL
        AND c_pcn.pcn_id = cp.pcn_id

    LEFT JOIN legacy_claim_latest cl
        ON cl.pcn_id = cp.pcn_id
        AND cl.rn = 1
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('incident') }} i
        WHERE i.parentcaseid IS NULL AND i.ccp_ticketno IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(UPPER(i.ccp_ticketno)) = cp.pcn_id
    )

),


live_payment AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(payment_id AS VARCHAR(100))        AS payment_id,
        CAST(pcn_id AS VARCHAR(100))       AS pcn_id,
        total_amount                            AS total_fine_amount,
        payment_date,
        amount_paid,
        'Live'                                  AS source_system,
        claim_id,
        site_id,
        site_guid,
        pcn_issue_date,
        transaction_date,
        pcn_issue_fy,
        claim_payment_stage,
        days_since_issue,
        amount_due

    FROM {{ ref('core_payment') }}

),

unioned_payments AS (

    SELECT
        payment_id,
        pcn_id,
        total_fine_amount,
        payment_date,
        amount_paid,
        claim_id,
        site_id,
        site_guid,
        pcn_issue_date,
        transaction_date,
        pcn_issue_fy,
        claim_payment_stage,
        days_since_issue,
        amount_due,
        source_system
    FROM legacy_payment

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        payment_id,
        pcn_id,
        total_fine_amount,
        payment_date,
        amount_paid,
        claim_id,
        site_id,
        site_guid,
        pcn_issue_date,
        transaction_date,
        pcn_issue_fy,
        claim_payment_stage,
        days_since_issue,
        amount_due,
        source_system
    FROM live_payment

),

payment_with_lifecycle AS (

    SELECT 
        p.*,
        l.stage_key AS stage_at_payment_key,
        -- Fail-safe: Prevents row fan-out if a payment happens on the exact day a stage ends/starts
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.payment_id 
            ORDER BY l.stage_start_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM unioned_payments p
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('fact_pcn_lifecycle') }} l
        ON p.pcn_id = l.pcn_id
        AND CAST(p.payment_date AS DATE) >= l.stage_start_date
        AND (CAST(p.payment_date AS DATE) < l.stage_end_date OR l.stage_end_date IS NULL)
)

SELECT
    payment_id,
    pcn_id,
    total_fine_amount,
    payment_date,
    amount_paid,
    claim_id,
    site_id,
    site_guid,
    pcn_issue_date,
    transaction_date,
    pcn_issue_fy,
    claim_payment_stage,
    days_since_issue,
    amount_due,
    stage_at_payment_key,
    source_system
FROM payment_with_lifecycle
WHERE rn = 1

model.ccp.fact_pcn.name: fact_pcn
model.ccp.fact_pcn.description: Unified Legacy and Live PCN records.
model.ccp.fact_pcn.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias = 'fact_pcn',
    tags = ['mart', 'pcn','fact_pcn']
) }}

WITH

-- 1. Isolate the latest stage_key per PCN from the lifecycle model
latest_lifecycle_stage AS (
    SELECT
        pcn_id,
        stage_key AS latest_stage_key,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pcn_id
            ORDER BY stage_start_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('fact_pcn_lifecycle') }}
),

latest_stage_filtered AS (
    SELECT pcn_id, latest_stage_key
    FROM latest_lifecycle_stage
    WHERE rn = 1
),

appeal_outcome_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ao.pcn_id,
        ao.appeal_final_outcome,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ao.pcn_id
            ORDER BY ca.submitted_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('int_appeal_outcome_legacy') }} ao
    JOIN {{ ref('core_appeal_legacy') }} ca
        ON ca.appeal_id = ao.appeal_id
),

appeal_outcome_latest AS (
    SELECT pcn_id, appeal_final_outcome
    FROM appeal_outcome_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),

tracing_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        pcn_id,
        tracing_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pcn_id
            ORDER BY tracing_sent_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('core_tracing_legacy') }}
),

tracing_latest AS (
    SELECT pcn_id, tracing_status
    FROM tracing_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),

lba_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        pcn_linkage AS pcn_id,
        lba_type,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pcn_linkage
            ORDER BY lba_issue_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('core_lba_legacy') }}
    WHERE lba_source_table = 'debt_recovery_lba'
),

lba_latest AS (
    SELECT pcn_id, lba_type
    FROM lba_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),

new_lba_milestones AS (
    SELECT
        pcn_linkage AS pcn_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table IN ('debt_recovery', 'debt_recovery_2')
                 THEN lba_issue_date END)                    AS debt_recovery_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table IN ('dr_returned', 'dr_returned_2')
                 THEN lba_issue_date END)                    AS debt_recovery_returned_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table = 'drfi'
                 THEN lba_issue_date END)                    AS debt_recovery_failed_instalment_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table = 'dr_returned_post_ccj'
                 THEN lba_issue_date END)                    AS post_ccj_debt_recovery_returned_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table IN ('cpr_letters', 'cpr_letter_new')
                 THEN lba_issue_date END)                    AS cpr_letter_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table = 'no_send_court'
                 THEN lba_issue_date END)                    AS no_send_court_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table = 'no_send_court'
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                          AS no_send_court_flag,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table = 'pcn_no_further_action'
                 THEN lba_issue_date END)                    AS pcn_no_further_action_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table = 'pcn_application_set_aside'
                 THEN lba_issue_date END)                    AS pcn_application_set_aside_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table = 'scottish_pre_legal_wp'
                 THEN lba_issue_date END)                    AS scottish_pre_legal_wp_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lba_source_table = 'debt_recovery_scottish_lba'
                 THEN lba_issue_date END)                    AS debt_recovery_scottish_lba_date
    FROM {{ ref('core_lba_legacy') }}
    WHERE lba_source_table IN (
        'debt_recovery', 'debt_recovery_2', 'dr_returned', 'dr_returned_2',
        'drfi', 'dr_returned_post_ccj', 'cpr_letters', 'cpr_letter_new',
        'no_send_court', 'pcn_no_further_action', 'pcn_application_set_aside',
        'scottish_pre_legal_wp', 'debt_recovery_scottish_lba'
    )
    GROUP BY pcn_linkage
),

fully_paid_crossing AS (
    SELECT
        e.pcn_id,
        MIN(e.stage_start_date) AS fully_paid_date
    FROM {{ ref('int_pcn_event_scd_legacy') }} e
    JOIN {{ ref('core_pcn_legacy') }} pc
        ON pc.pcn_id = e.pcn_id
    WHERE e.running_total_paid >= pc.charge
    GROUP BY e.pcn_id
),

payment_plan_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        pcn_id,
        payment_plan_type,
        plan_start_date AS payment_plan_start_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pcn_id
            ORDER BY plan_start_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ ref('core_payment_plan_legacy') }}
),

payment_plan_latest AS (
    SELECT pcn_id, payment_plan_type, payment_plan_start_date
    FROM payment_plan_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),

live_pcn_keys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(UPPER(pcn_id)) AS pcn_id
    FROM {{ ref('core_pcn') }}
    WHERE pcn_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- BUG FOUND LIVE 2026-09-18: legacy_pcn below discards a TG-originated PCN's
-- entire row whenever a Zeus counterpart exists (WHERE lv.pcn_id IS NULL),
-- and live_pcn (below) took core_pcn's ever_paid_flag/cancelled_flag as-is.
-- But core_pcn/int_payment.sql compute those flags purely from Zeus-native
-- ccp_tickettransaction/incident.statecode -- they have no visibility into
-- PRE-migration TG payment/cancellation history. core_pcn_legacy.sql's own
-- ever_paid_flag, by contrast, already blends TG's native payments with any
-- post-migration Zeus payments (see its tg_payments/zeus_payments CTEs) --
-- but that more-complete flag was being thrown away with the rest of the
-- discarded legacy row. Net effect: a migrated ticket paid/cancelled only
-- while it was still a TG ticket (and never touched again in Zeus) came out
-- of fact_pcn as neither paid nor cancelled, silently inflating Unpaid.
-- Confirmed live: this tracks migration volume, not data recency -- a
-- persistent 0.5-2.3% Paid/Cancelled undercount (Unpaid overcount) across
-- 40+ otherwise-settled months in the PCN reconciliation, found while
-- reconciling against a fresh Power BI export. Surfacing the discarded
-- legacy row's flags here so live_pcn can OR them into the surviving row.
legacy_flags_for_migrated AS (
    SELECT
        TRIM(UPPER(p.pcn_id)) AS pcn_id,
        p.ever_paid_flag      AS legacy_ever_paid_flag,
        p.cancelled_flag      AS legacy_cancelled_flag,
        p.cancelled_date      AS legacy_cancelled_date,
        p.cancelled_reason    AS legacy_cancelled_reason,
        p.total_paid          AS legacy_total_paid
    FROM {{ ref('core_pcn_legacy') }} p
    INNER JOIN live_pcn_keys lv ON lv.pcn_id = TRIM(UPPER(p.pcn_id))
),

-- claim_issued_flag: "did this ticket ever have a claim issued against it",
-- regardless of which month/system the claim itself belongs to -- matches
-- the client's Accrued Income Report's "Claim Issued" column (cohort-based
-- on the ticket's own sent month, confirmed live 2026-09-10 within a few
-- tickets against the report). Checks BOTH claim sources since a ticket's
-- claim can resolve via either side (see int_claim_issue_date_zeus.sql /
-- core_claim_legacy.sql for the full derivation of each).
claim_ever_issued AS (

    SELECT pcn_id FROM {{ ref('int_claim_issue_date_zeus') }}
    WHERE claim_issue_date IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT TRIM(UPPER(CAST(claim_pcn AS VARCHAR(50)))) AS pcn_id
    FROM {{ ref('core_claim_legacy') }}
    WHERE claim_issue_date IS NOT NULL

),

legacy_pcn AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(p.pcn_id AS VARCHAR(100))          AS pcn_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))              AS incident_id,
        CAST(p.pv_id AS VARCHAR(100))           AS pv_id,
        CASE WHEN ll.pcn_id IS NOT NULL
             THEN CAST(p.pcn_id AS VARCHAR(100))
             ELSE NULL END                      AS lba_id,
        CAST(p.court_claim_number AS VARCHAR(100)) AS claim_id,
        CAST(p.pcn_id AS VARCHAR(100))          AS fine_id,

        p.issue_date,
        p.charge,
        p.total_payment_amount,

        CAST(p.current_status AS VARCHAR(100))  AS current_status,
        CAST(p.payment_status AS VARCHAR(100))  AS payment_status,

        p.cancelled_flag,
        CAST(p.cancelled_reason AS VARCHAR(255)) AS cancelled_reason,
        p.cancelled_date,

        CAST(p.violation_date AS DATE) AS pv_date,
         CASE
            WHEN MONTH(p.violation_date) >= 4
                THEN CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(p.violation_date) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
            ELSE CONCAT('FY', RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(p.violation_date) AS VARCHAR(4)), 2))
        END AS pv_fy,


        p.paused_flag,
        p.paused_date,
        CAST(p.paused_reason AS VARCHAR(255))   AS paused_reason,

        p.fully_paid_flag,
        fpc.fully_paid_date,
        p.total_paid,
        p.ever_paid_flag,

        CAST(cs.collection_cycle_stage AS VARCHAR(100)) AS collection_cycle_stage,

        df.discount_flag,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))               AS discount_type,
        df.discount_amount,

        CAST(ao.appeal_final_outcome AS VARCHAR(100)) AS appeal_status,
        CAST(tl.tracing_status AS VARCHAR(100))       AS tracing_outcome,
        CAST(cc.claim_status AS VARCHAR(100))         AS claim_status,

        CAST(ll.lba_type AS VARCHAR(100))       AS lba_type,
        CAST(cs.lba_status_current AS VARCHAR(100)) AS lba_status,

        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS tracing_outcome_ccj,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS tracing_outcome_address_match,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS tracing_outcome_tracing_score,

        CAST(pp.payment_plan_type AS VARCHAR(100)) AS payment_plan_type,
        pp.payment_plan_start_date,

        p.ticket_type,
        p.issue_fy,
        p.site_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(36))               AS site_guid,

        CAST(p.dni_status AS VARCHAR(50))       AS dni_status,
        CAST(p.dni_reason AS VARCHAR(250))      AS dni_reason,
        CAST(NULL AS BIT)                       AS fuzzy_permit_flag,

        CAST(ls.latest_stage_key AS VARCHAR(100)) AS latest_stage_key,
        
        'Legacy'                                AS source_system,

        CAST(nlm.debt_recovery_date                     AS DATETIME2(6)) AS debt_recovery_date,
        CAST(nlm.debt_recovery_returned_date            AS DATETIME2(6)) AS debt_recovery_returned_date,
        CAST(nlm.debt_recovery_failed_instalment_date   AS DATETIME2(6)) AS debt_recovery_failed_instalment_date,
        CAST(nlm.post_ccj_debt_recovery_returned_date   AS DATETIME2(6)) AS post_ccj_debt_recovery_returned_date,
        CAST(nlm.cpr_letter_date                        AS DATETIME2(6)) AS cpr_letter_date,
        CAST(nlm.no_send_court_date                     AS DATETIME2(6)) AS no_send_court_date,
        CAST(nlm.no_send_court_flag                     AS BIT)          AS no_send_court_flag,
        CAST(nlm.pcn_no_further_action_date             AS DATETIME2(6)) AS pcn_no_further_action_date,
        CAST(nlm.pcn_application_set_aside_date         AS DATETIME2(6)) AS pcn_application_set_aside_date,
        CAST(nlm.scottish_pre_legal_wp_date             AS DATETIME2(6)) AS scottish_pre_legal_wp_date,
        CAST(nlm.debt_recovery_scottish_lba_date        AS DATETIME2(6)) AS debt_recovery_scottish_lba_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN cancelled_flag = 0 AND p.fully_paid_flag = 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END                                      AS is_live,

        CASE
            WHEN sl.golive_date IS NULL OR p.issue_date IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(p.issue_date AS DATE) < CAST(sl.golive_date AS DATE) THEN 0
            ELSE DATEDIFF(MONTH, CAST(sl.golive_date AS DATE), CAST(p.issue_date AS DATE))
        END                                      AS months_since_golive

    FROM {{ ref('core_pcn_legacy') }} p
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('core_site_legacy') }} sl ON TRIM(UPPER(CAST(sl.site_id AS VARCHAR(50)))) = TRIM(UPPER(CAST(p.site_id AS VARCHAR(50))))
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_collection_stage_legacy') }} cs ON cs.pcn_id = p.pcn_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('int_discount_flag_legacy') }}    df ON df.pcn_id = p.pcn_id
    LEFT JOIN appeal_outcome_latest ao                    ON ao.pcn_id = p.pcn_id
    LEFT JOIN tracing_latest tl                           ON tl.pcn_id = p.pcn_id
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('core_claim_legacy') }} cc           ON cc.claim_pcn = p.pcn_id
    LEFT JOIN lba_latest ll                               ON ll.pcn_id = p.pcn_id
    LEFT JOIN payment_plan_latest pp                      ON pp.pcn_id = p.pcn_id
    LEFT JOIN fully_paid_crossing fpc                     ON fpc.pcn_id = p.pcn_id
    LEFT JOIN new_lba_milestones nlm                      ON nlm.pcn_id = p.pcn_id
    LEFT JOIN live_pcn_keys lv                            ON lv.pcn_id = TRIM(UPPER(p.pcn_id))
    LEFT JOIN latest_stage_filtered ls                    ON ls.pcn_id = p.pcn_id
    WHERE lv.pcn_id IS NULL
),

live_pcn AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(p.pcn_id AS VARCHAR(100))          AS pcn_id,
        CAST(incident_id AS VARCHAR(100))       AS incident_id,
        CAST(pv_id AS VARCHAR(100))             AS pv_id,
        CAST(lba_id AS VARCHAR(100))            AS lba_id,
        CAST(claim_id AS VARCHAR(100))          AS claim_id,
        CAST(fine_id AS VARCHAR(100))           AS fine_id,

        issue_date,
        charge,
        total_payment_amount,

        pv_date,
        pv_fy,

        CAST(current_status AS VARCHAR(100))    AS current_status,
        CAST(payment_status AS VARCHAR(100))    AS payment_status,

        CAST(CASE WHEN cancelled_flag = 1 OR lfm.legacy_cancelled_flag = 1
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)     AS cancelled_flag,
        CAST(COALESCE(cancelled_reason, lfm.legacy_cancelled_reason)
             AS VARCHAR(255))                  AS cancelled_reason,
        COALESCE(cancelled_date, lfm.legacy_cancelled_date) AS cancelled_date,

        paused_flag,
        paused_date,
        CAST(paused_reason AS VARCHAR(255))     AS paused_reason,

        fully_paid_flag,
        fully_paid_date,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(total_paid, 0) >= COALESCE(lfm.legacy_total_paid, 0)
             THEN total_paid ELSE lfm.legacy_total_paid END AS total_paid,
        CAST(CASE WHEN ever_paid_flag = 1 OR lfm.legacy_ever_paid_flag = 1
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)     AS ever_paid_flag,
        payment_status_code,

        CAST(collection_cycle_stage AS VARCHAR(100)) AS collection_cycle_stage,

        discount_flag,
        CAST(discount_type AS VARCHAR(50))      AS discount_type,
        discount_amount,

        CAST(appeal_statuscode AS VARCHAR(100))  AS appeal_status,
        CAST(tracing_outcome AS VARCHAR(100))    AS tracing_outcome,
        CAST(claim_statuscode AS VARCHAR(100))   AS claim_status,

        CAST(lba_type AS VARCHAR(100))          AS lba_type,
        CAST(lba_status AS VARCHAR(100))        AS lba_status,

        CAST(tracing_outcome_ccj           AS VARCHAR(50)) AS tracing_outcome_ccj,
        CAST(tracing_outcome_address_match AS VARCHAR(50)) AS tracing_outcome_address_match,
        CAST(tracing_outcome_tracing_score AS VARCHAR(50)) AS tracing_outcome_tracing_score,

        CAST(payment_plan_type AS VARCHAR(100)) AS payment_plan_type,
        payment_plan_start_date,

        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(10))               AS ticket_type,

        CAST(dni_status AS VARCHAR(50))         AS dni_status,
        CAST(dni_reason AS VARCHAR(250))        AS dni_reason,

        CAST(ls.latest_stage_key AS VARCHAR(100)) AS latest_stage_key,

        site_id,
        p.site_guid,
        issue_fy,
        violation_type_key,
        months_since_golive,
        'Live'                                  AS source_system,

        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))               AS debt_recovery_date,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))               AS debt_recovery_returned_date,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))               AS debt_recovery_failed_instalment_date,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))               AS post_ccj_debt_recovery_returned_date,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))               AS cpr_letter_date,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))               AS no_send_court_date,
        CAST(NULL AS BIT)                        AS no_send_court_flag,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))               AS pcn_no_further_action_date,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))               AS pcn_application_set_aside_date,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))               AS scottish_pre_legal_wp_date,
        CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(6))               AS debt_recovery_scottish_lba_date,
        p.is_live

    FROM {{ ref('core_pcn') }} p
    LEFT JOIN latest_stage_filtered ls ON ls.pcn_id = p.pcn_id
    LEFT JOIN legacy_flags_for_migrated lfm ON lfm.pcn_id = TRIM(UPPER(p.pcn_id))
),

-- 2. Wrap the UNION ALL in a single CTE
unioned_pcn AS (
    SELECT 
        pcn_id,
        incident_id,
        pv_id,
        lba_id,
        claim_id,
        fine_id,
        issue_date,
        charge,
        pv_date,
        pv_fy,
        total_payment_amount,
        current_status,
        payment_status,
        cancelled_flag,
        cancelled_reason,
        cancelled_date,
        paused_flag,
        paused_date,
        paused_reason,
        fully_paid_flag,
        fully_paid_date,
        total_paid,
        ever_paid_flag,
        collection_cycle_stage,
        discount_flag,
        discount_type,
        discount_amount,
        appeal_status,
        tracing_outcome,
        tracing_outcome_ccj,
        tracing_outcome_address_match,
        tracing_outcome_tracing_score,
        claim_status,
        lba_type,
        lba_status,
        payment_plan_type,
        payment_plan_start_date,
        ticket_type,
        dni_status,
        dni_reason,
        NULL AS partially_paid_flag,
        latest_stage_key,
        source_system,
        site_id,
        site_guid,
        issue_fy,
        NULL AS violation_type_key,
        months_since_golive,
        debt_recovery_date,
        debt_recovery_returned_date,
        debt_recovery_failed_instalment_date,
        post_ccj_debt_recovery_returned_date,
        cpr_letter_date,
        no_send_court_date,
        no_send_court_flag,
        pcn_no_further_action_date,
        pcn_application_set_aside_date,
        scottish_pre_legal_wp_date,
        debt_recovery_scottish_lba_date,
        is_live
    FROM legacy_pcn

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        pcn_id,
        incident_id,
        pv_id,
        lba_id,
        claim_id,
        fine_id,
        issue_date,
        charge,
        pv_date,
        pv_fy,
        total_payment_amount,
        current_status,
        payment_status,
        cancelled_flag,
        cancelled_reason,
        cancelled_date,
        paused_flag,
        paused_date,
        paused_reason,
        fully_paid_flag,
        fully_paid_date,
        total_paid,
        ever_paid_flag,
        collection_cycle_stage,
        discount_flag,
        discount_type,
        discount_amount,
        appeal_status,
        tracing_outcome,
        tracing_outcome_ccj,
        tracing_outcome_address_match,
        tracing_outcome_tracing_score,
        claim_status,
        lba_type,
        lba_status,
        payment_plan_type,
        payment_plan_start_date,
        ticket_type,
        dni_status,
        dni_reason,
        CASE  
            WHEN payment_status_code = 860620003  
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0  
        END AS partially_paid_flag,
        latest_stage_key,
        source_system,
        site_id,
        site_guid,
        issue_fy,
        violation_type_key,
        months_since_golive,
        debt_recovery_date,
        debt_recovery_returned_date,
        debt_recovery_failed_instalment_date,
        post_ccj_debt_recovery_returned_date,
        cpr_letter_date,
        no_send_court_date,
        no_send_court_flag,
        pcn_no_further_action_date,
        pcn_application_set_aside_date,
        scottish_pre_legal_wp_date,
        debt_recovery_scottish_lba_date,
        is_live
    FROM live_pcn
),

-- 3. Resolve the stage_at_cancelled_key using the dates
pcn_with_cancelled_stage AS (
    SELECT
        u.*,
        l.stage_key AS stage_at_cancelled_key,
        CAST(CASE WHEN cei.pcn_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS claim_issued_flag,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY u.pcn_id
            ORDER BY l.stage_start_date DESC
        ) AS rn_cancel
    FROM unioned_pcn u
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('fact_pcn_lifecycle') }} l
        ON u.pcn_id = l.pcn_id
        AND u.cancelled_date IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(u.cancelled_date AS DATE) >= l.stage_start_date
        AND (CAST(u.cancelled_date AS DATE) < l.stage_end_date OR l.stage_end_date IS NULL)
    LEFT JOIN claim_ever_issued cei
        ON cei.pcn_id = u.pcn_id
)

SELECT
    pcn_id,
    incident_id,
    pv_id,
    lba_id,
    claim_id,
    fine_id,
    issue_date,
    charge,
    total_payment_amount,
    current_status,
    payment_status,
    cancelled_flag,
    cancelled_reason,
    cancelled_date,
    paused_flag,
    paused_date,
    paused_reason,
    fully_paid_flag,
    fully_paid_date,
    total_paid,
    ever_paid_flag,
    collection_cycle_stage,
    discount_flag,
    discount_type,
    discount_amount,
    appeal_status,
    tracing_outcome,
    tracing_outcome_ccj,
    tracing_outcome_address_match,
    tracing_outcome_tracing_score,
    claim_status,
    lba_type,
    lba_status,
    payment_plan_type,
    payment_plan_start_date,
    ticket_type,
    dni_status,
    dni_reason,
    partially_paid_flag,
    latest_stage_key,
    source_system,
    site_id,
    site_guid,
    pv_date,
    pv_fy,
    issue_fy,
    violation_type_key,
    months_since_golive,
    debt_recovery_date,
    debt_recovery_returned_date,
    debt_recovery_failed_instalment_date,
    post_ccj_debt_recovery_returned_date,
    cpr_letter_date,
    no_send_court_date,
    no_send_court_flag,
    pcn_no_further_action_date,
    pcn_application_set_aside_date,
    scottish_pre_legal_wp_date,
    debt_recovery_scottish_lba_date,
    is_live,
    -- 4. Expose the new field
    stage_at_cancelled_key,
    claim_issued_flag
FROM pcn_with_cancelled_stage
WHERE rn_cancel = 1

model.ccp.fact_pcn_lifecycle.name: fact_pcn_lifecycle
model.ccp.fact_pcn_lifecycle.description: Unified PCN lifecycle stage and payment events.
model.ccp.fact_pcn_lifecycle.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias = 'fact_pcn_lifecycle',
    tags = ['mart', 'payment','fact_pcn_lifecycle']
) }}

WITH legacy_pcn_lifecycle AS (

    -- Was grain = 1 per payment (from core_payment_legacy), with stage_key
    -- hardcoded NULL -- "Currently stage_key is null but needs to bring the
    -- value for it". Replaced with core_pcn_lifecycle_legacy (grain = 1 per
    -- PCN per stage genuinely reached, built on int_pcn_event_scd_legacy's
    -- real event history) to match live_pcn_lifecycle's shape/grain below.
    -- This also fixes the date-range join fact_payment.sql does against
    -- this model for stage_at_payment_key -- the old payment-grain rows had
    -- no real stage_start_date/stage_end_date window to match against,
    -- which is why the large majority of Legacy stage_at_payment_key values
    -- were NULL (confirmed live 2026-09-16: 63% of rpt_fact_payment rows).
    SELECT
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), HASHBYTES('MD2',
        CONCAT(
            COALESCE(CAST(pcn_id AS VARCHAR(100)), ''),
            '|',
            COALESCE(CAST(stage_key AS VARCHAR(100)), '')
        )
        ), 2)                                    AS pcn_lifecycle_key,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                AS payment_id,
        CAST(pcn_id AS VARCHAR(100))               AS pcn_id,
        CAST(fine_id AS VARCHAR(100))              AS fine_id,

        amount_paid,

        discount_flag,
        discount_amount,

        CAST(stage_key AS VARCHAR(255))            AS lifecycle_stage,

        CAST(stage_start_date AS DATE)              AS stage_start_date,
        CAST(stage_end_date AS DATE)                AS stage_end_date,

        total_payment_amount,
        site_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(36))                  AS site_guid,
        stage_key,
        issue_date,
        reached_flag,
        paid_at_stage_flag,
        cash_at_stage,
        is_live,

        'Legacy'                                   AS source_system

    FROM {{ ref('core_pcn_lifecycle_legacy') }}

),

live_pcn_lifecycle AS (

    SELECT
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), HASHBYTES('MD2',
        CONCAT(
            COALESCE(CAST(pcn_id AS VARCHAR(100)), ''),
            '|',
            COALESCE(CAST(stage_key AS VARCHAR(100)), '')
        )
        ), 2)                                                                      AS pcn_lifecycle_key,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))              AS payment_id,
        CAST(pcn_id AS VARCHAR(100))            AS pcn_id,
        CAST(fine_id AS VARCHAR(100))           AS fine_id,

        amount_paid,

        CAST(discount_flag AS BIT)              AS discount_flag,
        discount_amount,

        CAST(stage_key AS VARCHAR(255))   AS lifecycle_stage,

        CAST(stage_start_date AS DATE)          AS stage_start_date,
        CAST(stage_end_date AS DATE)            AS stage_end_date,

        total_payment_amount,
        site_id,
        site_guid,
        stage_key,
        issue_date,
        reached_flag,
        paid_at_stage_flag,
        cash_at_stage,
        is_live,

        'Live'                                  AS source_system

    FROM {{ ref('core_pcn_lifecycle') }}

)

SELECT
    pcn_lifecycle_key,
    payment_id,
    pcn_id,
    fine_id,
    amount_paid,
    discount_flag,
    discount_amount,
    lifecycle_stage,
    stage_start_date,
    stage_end_date,
    total_payment_amount,
    site_id,
    site_guid,
    stage_key,
    issue_date,
    reached_flag,
    paid_at_stage_flag,
    cash_at_stage,
    is_live,
    source_system
FROM legacy_pcn_lifecycle

UNION ALL

SELECT
    pcn_lifecycle_key,
    payment_id,
    pcn_id,
    fine_id,
    amount_paid,
    discount_flag,
    discount_amount,
    lifecycle_stage,
    stage_start_date,
    stage_end_date,
    total_payment_amount,
    site_id,
    site_guid,
    stage_key,
    issue_date,
    reached_flag,
    paid_at_stage_flag,
    cash_at_stage,
    is_live,
    source_system
FROM live_pcn_lifecycle

model.ccp.fact_pv.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias = 'fact_pv',
    tags = ['mart', 'fact_pv','fact']
) }}

WITH legacy_pv AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(p.pair_id AS VARCHAR(100))        AS pv_id,
        CAST(s1.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))        AS site_id,
        CAST(p.pair_id AS VARCHAR(100))         AS inhouse_review_id,
        s1.processed_date                       AS pv_date,
        CAST(p.stream1_id AS VARCHAR(100))      AS stream1_id,
        CAST(p.stream2_id AS VARCHAR(100))      AS stream2_id,
        p.clean_pair_flag,
        -- Permit matching happens at PAIR grain. On stage2_plates
        -- permit_accuracy is a real score (14 values, 84-100); on plate_images
        -- the same column is a constant 100, so the read-grain fact cannot
        -- carry this. fact_pcn also declares a fuzzy_permit_flag, but reaching
        -- PCN grain needs the NewLogic-pair to TrafficGuard link that is still
        -- unresolved, so it stays NULL there.
        p.fuzzy_permit_flag,
        p.permit_accuracy                       AS permit_match_accuracy,
        CAST(p.permit_matched_plate AS VARCHAR(20)) AS permit_matched_plate,
        'Legacy'                                AS source_system,
        -- pair_id: on the Legacy side, pv_id IS the pair_id (both come from
        -- checked_plates.id) -- unlike Live, where pv_id (ccp_potentialviolationid)
        -- and pair_id (ccp_polusreference) are genuinely different keys.
        -- Was hardcoded NULL despite the value already being computed above.
        CAST(p.pair_id AS VARCHAR(100))         AS pair_id,
        -- violation_type_key and pcn_issued_flag remain NULL: both need the
        -- NewLogic-pair (checked_plates.id) to TrafficGuard PCN link, which
        -- is still unresolved -- core_pcn_legacy's only PV linkage
        -- (an_possible_violator_id -> an_possible_violators.id) is a
        -- different key space entirely, confirmed live 2026-09-16. Without
        -- that link there's no way to (a) count tickets per plate for the
        -- SV/MV classification violation_type_key's hash needs, or (b)
        -- check whether a PCN actually resulted from this specific pair.
        NULL                                    AS violation_type_key,
        NULL                                    AS pcn_issued_flag

    FROM {{ ref('core_stream_pair_legacy') }} p

    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('core_stream_legacy') }} s1
        ON s1.stream_id = p.stream1_id

),

live_pv AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(pv_id AS VARCHAR(100))             AS pv_id,
        CAST(site_id AS VARCHAR(100))           AS site_id,
        CAST(inhouse_review_id AS VARCHAR(100)) AS inhouse_review_id,
        pv_date,
        CAST(stream1_id AS VARCHAR(100))        AS stream1_id,
        CAST(stream2_id AS VARCHAR(100))        AS stream2_id,
        clean_pair_flag,
        CAST(NULL AS BIT)                       AS fuzzy_permit_flag,
        CAST(NULL AS INT)                       AS permit_match_accuracy,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(20))               AS permit_matched_plate,
        'Live'                                  AS source_system,
        pair_id,
        violation_type_key,
        pcn_issued_flag



    FROM {{ ref('core_pv') }}

)

SELECT
     pv_id, -- PV ID is the same as pair_id in legacy, but not in live, so we keep it separate
    site_id,
    inhouse_review_id,
    pv_date,
    stream1_id,
    stream2_id,
    clean_pair_flag,
    fuzzy_permit_flag,
    permit_match_accuracy,
    permit_matched_plate,
    source_system,
    pair_id,
    violation_type_key,
    pcn_issued_flag

FROM legacy_pv

UNION ALL

SELECT
    pv_id,
    site_id,
    inhouse_review_id,
    pv_date,
    stream1_id,
    stream2_id,
    clean_pair_flag,
    fuzzy_permit_flag,
    permit_match_accuracy,
    permit_matched_plate,
    source_system,
    pair_id,
    violation_type_key,
    pcn_issued_flag

FROM live_pv

model.ccp.fact_pv_month.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias        = 'fact_pv_month',
    tags         = ['mart', 'pv_month', 'fact_pv_month']
) }}

-- =========================================================================
-- Mart Model: fact_pv_month
-- Grain      : 1 row per site_id x calendar month x violation_type_key
-- Source     : fact_pv (Legacy + Live)
-- Scoped to April 2023 onward, matching the rest of the reporting layer.
--
-- violation_type_key has no Legacy source (see fact_pv.sql's legacy_pv
-- CTE -- hardcoded NULL there) -- Legacy site-months collapse into a NULL
-- violation_type_key bucket rather than a fabricated value.
-- =========================================================================

SELECT
    site_id,
    DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(pv_date), MONTH(pv_date), 1)     AS month_start_date,
    violation_type_key,
    COUNT(*)                                             AS pv_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pcn_issued_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pcn_issued_count
FROM {{ ref('fact_pv') }}
WHERE pv_date >= '2023-04-01'
GROUP BY site_id, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(pv_date), MONTH(pv_date), 1), violation_type_key

-- =========================================================================
-- Mart Model: fact_site_lifecycle
-- Grain      : 1 row per site lifecycle event / status transition / milestone
-- Sources    : core_site_lifecycle_legacy (TrafficGuard) UNION ALL core_site_lifecycle (Zeus)
-- =========================================================================

WITH

-- Mirrors dim_site.sql's dedup pattern:
-- Zeus stores the old TrafficGuard site number in ccp_sitenumber.
-- Sites that exist in both systems should only appear here under their Zeus identity.
-- Legacy lifecycle rows for migrated sites have event_type = NULL and carry no
-- useful event data -- the Zeus audit trail covers all their real lifecycle events.
live_site_legacy_numbers AS (

    -- Query ccp_site (raw staging) directly rather than core_site.
    -- core_site filters out Zeus sites where ccp_businesscategorylookup IS NULL,
    -- so those sites' ccp_legacysitenumber would be missing and their TG
    -- counterparts would slip through the NOT EXISTS as if they were TG-only.
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TRIM(UPPER(CAST(ccp_legacysitenumber AS VARCHAR(50)))) AS legacy_site_number
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }}
    WHERE ccp_legacysitenumber IS NOT NULL

),

legacy_sites AS (

    SELECT
        site_lifecycle_id,
        site_id,
        NULL AS site_guid,
        customer_id,
        contract_id,
        contract_type,
        event_date,

        monthly_free_cancel_budget,
        'Legacy' AS source_system
    FROM {{ ref('core_site_lifecycle_legacy') }} csl
    -- Exclude Legacy lifecycle rows for sites that migrated to Zeus.
    -- Those sites' full audit trail exists in core_site_lifecycle (Live side).
    -- TG-only sites (~682) are unaffected.
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM live_site_legacy_numbers ln
        WHERE ln.legacy_site_number = TRIM(UPPER(CAST(csl.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))))
    )

),

live_sites AS (

    SELECT

        revenue_share_model,
        revenue_share_pct,
        free_cancellation_limit,
        site_nature,
        site_rule_type,
        business_category,
        processed_status,
        responsible_team,
        site_technology,
        tariff_technology,
        tablet_type,
        tablet_status,
        monthly_free_cancel_budget,
        'Live' AS source_system
    FROM {{ ref('core_site_lifecycle') }}

)

SELECT
    site_lifecycle_id,
    site_id,
    site_guid,
    customer_id,
    contract_id,
    contract_type,
    event_date,
    event_type,
    is_blackout_flag,
    blackout_days_count,
    blackout_end_date,
    contract_length_years,
    quality_tier_at_event,
    churn_type,
    churn_reason,
    is_regrettable,
    spaces,
    contract_start_date,
    contract_end_date,
    renewal_date,
    revenue_share_model,
    revenue_share_pct,
    free_cancellation_limit,
    site_nature,
    site_rule_type,
    business_category,
    processed_status,
    responsible_team,
    site_technology,
    tariff_technology,
    tablet_type,
    tablet_status,
    monthly_free_cancel_budget,
    source_system

FROM legacy_sites

UNION ALL

SELECT
    site_lifecycle_id,
    site_id,
    site_guid,
    customer_id,
    contract_id,
    contract_type,
    event_date,
    event_type,
    is_blackout_flag,
    blackout_days_count,
    blackout_end_date,
    contract_length_years,
    quality_tier_at_event,
    churn_type,
    churn_reason,
    is_regrettable,
    spaces,
    contract_start_date,
    contract_end_date,
    renewal_date,
    revenue_share_model,
    revenue_share_pct,
    free_cancellation_limit,
    site_nature,
    site_rule_type,

model.ccp.fact_site_month.name: fact_site_month
model.ccp.fact_site_month.description: Monthly site status and operational metrics.
model.ccp.fact_site_month.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias        = 'fact_site_month',
    tags         = ['mart', 'site_month', 'fact_site_month']
) }}

-- =========================================================================
-- Mart Model: fact_site_month
-- Grain      : 1 row per site_id × calendar month (month_roll)
-- Sources    : core_site_month_legacy (TrafficGuard) UNION ALL core_site_month (Zeus)
-- =========================================================================

WITH

-- Mirrors dim_site.sql's dedup pattern:
-- Exclude Legacy month rows for sites that migrated to Zeus.
-- Those sites appear in core_site_month (Zeus GUID) AND core_site_month_legacy
-- (TG site number), causing double-counting in rpt_site_month.
-- TG-only sites (~682 sites that never migrated) are unaffected.
live_site_legacy_numbers AS (

    -- Query ccp_site (raw staging) directly rather than core_site.
    -- core_site filters out Zeus sites where ccp_businesscategorylookup IS NULL,
    -- so those sites' ccp_legacysitenumber would be missing and their TG
    -- counterparts would slip through the NOT EXISTS as if they were TG-only.
    -- One row per TG site number -> its Zeus GUID and the date that Zeus
    -- record was created (MIN picks a deterministic one on the rare chance
    -- of more than one Zeus record per TG number).
    SELECT
        TRIM(UPPER(CAST(ccp_legacysitenumber AS VARCHAR(50)))) AS legacy_site_number,
        MIN(ccp_siteid)                                         AS zeus_site_guid,
        MIN(CAST(createdon AS DATE))                            AS zeus_created_date
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }}
    WHERE ccp_legacysitenumber IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TRIM(UPPER(CAST(ccp_legacysitenumber AS VARCHAR(50))))

),

-- When each Zeus site record was created -- the point from which Zeus
-- becomes the system of record for that site (see live_site_month below).
zeus_site_created AS (

    SELECT
        LOWER(CAST(ccp_siteid AS VARCHAR(36)))  AS site_guid,
        CAST(createdon AS DATE)                 AS zeus_created_date
    FROM {{ ref('ccp_site') }}
    WHERE ccp_siteid IS NOT NULL

),

legacy_site_month AS (

    SELECT
        csml.site_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(36)) AS site_guid,
        csml.month_roll,
        csml.is_live,
        csml.is_live_eom,
        csml.is_live_active,
        csml.lost_this_month,
        CAST(0 AS INT)                                                  AS new_this_month,
        csml.live_days,
        csml.uptime_days,
        csml.spaces,
        csml.contract_years_remaining,
        csml.quality_tier,
        csml.quality_tier_rank,
        csml.is_renewal_due,
        csml.is_renewed,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100))                                      AS site_technology,
        csml.go_live_date,
        csml.months_since_go_live,
        'Legacy' AS source_system
    FROM {{ ref('core_site_month_legacy') }} csml
    LEFT JOIN live_site_legacy_numbers ln
        ON ln.legacy_site_number = TRIM(UPPER(CAST(csml.site_id AS VARCHAR(100))))
    -- FIX 2026-09-28: system-ownership precedence. A physical site is
    -- counted from whichever system actually operated it in that month:
    -- TrafficGuard owns the months BEFORE its Zeus record existed, Zeus
    -- owns the months after.
    --
    -- Previous rule was "exclude Legacy when Zeus has a row for this exact
    -- site + month". That looked right but isn't, because Zeus's rows for
    -- 2023/2024 are retroactive reconstructions: essentially the entire
    -- Zeus site estate has createdon in Jan/Feb 2025 (before 2025-01 the
    -- contemporaneous Zeus count is literally zero). So Zeus "covered"
    -- almost every historical month on paper, suppressing nearly all
    -- Legacy rows -- Legacy contributed just 0-2 sites/month through 2024
    -- -- and the historical count came entirely from a system that did not
    -- exist at the time. The client's own 2023/2024 figures can only have
    -- come from TrafficGuard.
    --
    -- Keying on zeus_created_date instead lets TG own the pre-migration
    -- months. Mean absolute error across 2023-05..2024-12 drops from ~33
    -- to ~14, and errors centre near zero instead of skewing positive.
    WHERE ln.zeus_site_guid IS NULL
       OR ln.zeus_created_date > EOMONTH(csml.month_roll)

),

live_site_month AS (

    -- Other half of the system-ownership rule (see legacy_site_month above):
    -- for months BEFORE a site's Zeus record existed, Zeus is not the system
    -- of record, so its LIVENESS must not count. Those rows are retroactive
    -- reconstructions -- Zeus held essentially no site records before
    -- Jan-2025 -- so without this the same physical site is counted twice for
    -- its pre-migration months: once from TrafficGuard (which really was
    -- operating it) and again from Zeus's backdated golive_date.
    --
    -- Only is_live / is_live_eom / live_days / uptime_days are zeroed. The
    -- rows are KEPT and new_this_month / lost_this_month pass through
    -- untouched: those fire on real dated events (first PCN printed, a
    -- lifecycle churn event) which happened regardless of which CRM held the
    -- record at the time. Dropping the rows instead silently lost 78 new-site
    -- events across Jun-Oct 2024 and broke the separately-validated New/Lost
    -- Sites reconciliation.
    SELECT
        csm.site_id,
        csm.site_guid,
        csm.month_roll,
        CASE WHEN zc.zeus_created_date IS NULL
                   OR zc.zeus_created_date <= EOMONTH(csm.month_roll)
             THEN csm.is_live ELSE 0 END                                AS is_live,
        CASE WHEN zc.zeus_created_date IS NULL
                   OR zc.zeus_created_date <= EOMONTH(csm.month_roll)
             THEN csm.is_live_eom ELSE 0 END                            AS is_live_eom,
        CASE WHEN zc.zeus_created_date IS NULL
                   OR zc.zeus_created_date <= EOMONTH(csm.month_roll)
             THEN csm.is_live_active ELSE 0 END                         AS is_live_active,
        csm.lost_this_month,
        csm.new_this_month,
        CASE WHEN zc.zeus_created_date IS NULL
                   OR zc.zeus_created_date <= EOMONTH(csm.month_roll)
             THEN csm.live_days ELSE 0.00 END                           AS live_days,
        CASE WHEN zc.zeus_created_date IS NULL
                   OR zc.zeus_created_date <= EOMONTH(csm.month_roll)
             THEN csm.uptime_days ELSE 0.00 END                         AS uptime_days,
        csm.spaces,
        csm.contract_years_remaining,
        csm.quality_tier,
        csm.quality_tier_rank,
        csm.is_renewal_due,
        csm.is_renewed,
        csm.site_technology,
        csm.go_live_date,
        csm.months_since_go_live,
        'Live' AS source_system
    FROM {{ ref('core_site_month') }} csm
    LEFT JOIN zeus_site_created zc
        ON zc.site_guid = csm.site_guid
)

SELECT
    site_id,
    site_guid,
    month_roll,
    is_live,
    is_live_eom,
    is_live_active,
    lost_this_month,
    new_this_month,
    live_days,
    uptime_days,
    spaces,
    contract_years_remaining,
    quality_tier,
    quality_tier_rank,
    is_renewal_due,
    is_renewed,
    site_technology,
    go_live_date,
    months_since_go_live,
    source_system

FROM legacy_site_month

UNION ALL

SELECT
    site_id,
    site_guid,
    month_roll,
    is_live,
    is_live_eom,
    is_live_active,
    lost_this_month,
    new_this_month,
    live_days,
    uptime_days,
    spaces,
    contract_years_remaining,
    quality_tier,
    quality_tier_rank,
    is_renewal_due,
    is_renewed,
    site_technology,
    go_live_date,
    months_since_go_live,
    source_system

FROM live_site_month;

model.ccp.fact_stream_month.name: fact_stream_month
model.ccp.fact_stream_month.description: Monthly stream and parking-pair aggregation by site.
model.ccp.fact_stream_month.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    alias        = 'fact_stream_month',
    tags         = ['mart', 'stream_month', 'fact_stream_month']
) }}

-- =========================================================================
-- Mart Model: fact_stream_month
-- Grain      : 1 row per site_id x calendar month
-- Source     : core_stream & core_stream_legacy
-- Scoped to April 2023 onward, matching the rest of the reporting layer's
-- date filter. Built directly on top of core models to bypass materializing
-- billions of rows in an intermediate fact_stream table.
--
-- pair_count is DISTINCT pair_id (a visit -- entry+exit reads share one
-- pair_id), not a count of paired reads -- stream_count already covers
-- total reads.
-- =========================================================================

WITH legacy_stream AS (
    SELECT
        site_id,
        stream_date,
        pair_id
    FROM {{ ref('core_stream_legacy') }}
    WHERE stream_date >= '2023-04-01'
),

live_stream AS (
    SELECT
        site_id,
        stream_date,
        pair_id
    FROM {{ ref('core_stream') }}
    WHERE stream_date >= '2023-04-01'
),

unioned_streams AS (
    SELECT * FROM legacy_stream
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM live_stream
)

SELECT
    site_id,
    DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(stream_date), MONTH(stream_date), 1) AS month_start_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT stream_id)                                                 AS stream_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pair_id)                                  AS pair_count
FROM {{ ref('fact_stream') }}
WHERE stream_date >= '2023-04-01'
GROUP BY site_id, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(stream_date), MONTH(stream_date), 1)

/*
Model Description :
    Stage model for appealpara

    Bypasses the stage_clean macro deliberately -- that macro always selects
    every physical column, and the source's `paragraph` column is a
    deprecated NTEXT-origin field, unreliable in Fabric, per the appeals
    domain build spec. Only 4 columns are selected below; `paragraph` is
    excluded on purpose, not an oversight. `shortparagraph` (NVARCHAR(255))
    is the field to use for paragraph text.

Created On : 18-08-2026
*/

{{ config(
    alias = 'appeal_para',
    tags = ['stage', 'traffic_guard']
) }}

SELECT
    TRY_CAST(id AS INT)                                        AS id,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(ref), '') AS VARCHAR(250))                AS ref,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(shortparagraph), '') AS VARCHAR(255))     AS short_paragraph,
    TRY_CAST(dateadded AS DATETIME2(6))                        AS date_added,
    CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS DATETIME2(6))                    AS load_datetime
FROM {{ source('traffic_guard', 'appealpara') }}

macro.dbt_fabric.fabric__get_catalog.name: fabric__get_catalog
macro.dbt_fabric.fabric__get_catalog.macro_sql:
{% macro fabric__get_catalog(information_schemas, schemas) -%}

    {% set query_label = apply_label() %}
    {%- call statement('catalog', fetch_result=True) -%}
        {{ get_use_database_sql(information_schemas.database) }}
        with
        principals as (
            select
                name as principal_name,
                principal_id as principal_id
            from
                sys.database_principals {{ information_schema_hints() }}
        ),

        schemas as (
            select
                name as schema_name,
                schema_id as schema_id,
                principal_id as principal_id
            from
                sys.schemas {{ information_schema_hints() }}
        ),

        tables as (
            select
                object_id,
                name as table_name,
                schema_id as schema_id,
                principal_id as principal_id,
                'BASE TABLE' as table_type
            from
                sys.tables {{ information_schema_hints() }}
        ),

        tables_with_metadata as (
            select
                object_id,
                table_name,
                schema_name,
                coalesce(tables.principal_id, schemas.principal_id) as owner_principal_id,
                table_type
            from
                tables
            join schemas on tables.schema_id = schemas.schema_id
        ),

        views as (
            select
                object_id,
                name as table_name,
                schema_id as schema_id,
                principal_id as principal_id,
                'VIEW' as table_type
            from
                sys.views {{ information_schema_hints() }}
        ),

        views_with_metadata as (
            select
                object_id,
                table_name,
                schema_name,
                coalesce(views.principal_id, schemas.principal_id) as owner_principal_id,
                table_type
            from
                views
            join schemas on views.schema_id = schemas.schema_id
        ),

        tables_and_views as (
            select
                object_id,
                table_name,
                schema_name,
                principal_name,
                table_type
            from
                tables_with_metadata
            join principals on tables_with_metadata.owner_principal_id = principals.principal_id
            union all
            select
                object_id,
                table_name,
                schema_name,
                principal_name,
                table_type
            from
                views_with_metadata
            join principals on views_with_metadata.owner_principal_id = principals.principal_id
        ),

        cols as (

            select
                c.object_id,
                c.name as column_name,
                c.column_id as column_index,
                t.name as column_type
            from sys.columns as c {{ information_schema_hints() }}
            left join sys.types as t on c.system_type_id = t.system_type_id
        )

        select
            DB_NAME() as table_database,
            tv.schema_name as table_schema,
            tv.table_name,
            tv.table_type,
            null as table_comment,
            tv.principal_name as table_owner,
            cols.column_name,
            cols.column_index,
            cols.column_type,
            null as column_comment
        from tables_and_views tv
        join cols on tv.object_id = cols.object_id
        where ({%- for schema in schemas -%}
            upper(tv.schema_name) = upper('{{ schema }}'){%- if not loop.last %} or {% endif -%}
        {%- endfor -%})

        order by column_index
        {{ query_label }}

        {%- endcall -%}

    {{ return(load_result('catalog').table) }}

{%- endmacro %}

macro.dbt_fabric.fabric__list_noncluster.macro_sql:
{% macro fabric__list_nonclustered_rowstore_indexes(relation) -%}
  {% call statement('list_nonclustered_rowstore_indexes', fetch_result=True) -%}

    SELECT i.name AS index_name
    , i.name + '__dbt_backup' as index_new_name
    , COL_NAME(ic.object_id,ic.column_id) AS column_name
    FROM sys.indexes AS i
    INNER JOIN sys.index_columns AS ic
        ON i.object_id = ic.object_id AND i.index_id = ic.index_id and i.type <> 5
    WHERE i.object_id = OBJECT_ID('{{ relation.schema }}.{{ relation.identifier }}')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT  obj.name AS index_name
    , obj.name + '__dbt_backup' as index_new_name
    , col1.name AS column_name
    FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc
    INNER JOIN sys.objects obj
        ON obj.object_id = fkc.constraint_object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.tables tab1
        ON tab1.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.schemas sch
        ON tab1.schema_id = sch.schema_id
    INNER JOIN sys.columns col1
        ON col1.column_id = parent_column_id AND col1.object_id = tab1.object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.tables tab2
        ON tab2.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.columns col2
        ON col2.column_id = referenced_column_id AND col2.object_id = tab2.object_id
    WHERE sch.name = '{{ relation.schema }}' and tab1.name = '{{ relation.identifier }}'

  {% endcall %}
  {{ return(load_result('list_nonclustered_rowstore_indexes').table) }}
{% endmacro %}

doc.dbt.__overview__.block_contents:
### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
